            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.ApplyWorldPreset(name)
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                local preset = world.WorldPresets[name]
                if not preset then
                    return
                end
                local wanted = preset.Toggles or {}
                -- Turn unused features off first, then stage values, then enable, so a
                -- feature never flashes on with the previous theme's numbers.
                for _, toggleId in ipairs(world.WorldPresetManagedToggles) do
                    local toggle = Toggles and Toggles[toggleId]
                    if toggle and wanted[toggleId] ~= true and toggle.Value then
                        toggle:SetValue(false)
                    end
                end
                for optionId, value in pairs(preset.Options or {}) do
                    local option = Options and Options[optionId]
                    if option and type(option.SetValue) == 'function' then
                        option:SetValue(value)
                    end
                end
                for optionId, rgb in pairs(preset.Colors or {}) do
                    local option = Options and Options[optionId]
                    if option and type(option.SetValueRGB) == 'function' then
                        option:SetValueRGB(Color3.fromRGB(rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3]))
                    end
                end
                for _, toggleId in ipairs(world.WorldPresetManagedToggles) do
                    local toggle = Toggles and Toggles[toggleId]
                    if toggle and wanted[toggleId] == true and not toggle.Value then
                        toggle:SetValue(true)
                    end
                end
                world.RefreshAll()
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.RefreshSkyDropdowns()
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                local presetOption = Options.P1S12D1
                local savedOption = Options.P1S12D2
                if presetOption and type(presetOption.SetValues) == 'function' then
                    pcall(function()
                        presetOption:SetValues(world.ResolveSkyPresetNames())
                    end)
                end
                if savedOption and type(savedOption.SetValues) == 'function' then
                    pcall(function()
                        savedOption:SetValues(world.ResolveCustomSkyNames())
                    end)
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.AddCustomSkybox(name, faces)
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                world.LoadCustomSkyboxes()
                name = type(name) == 'string' and (name:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') or '') or ''
                if name == '' or world.SkyPresets[name] ~= nil or world.CustomSkyboxes[name] ~= nil then
                    return false
                end
                local normalized = {}
                for property in pairs(world.SkyFaceInputs) do
                    normalized[property] = world.NormalizeAssetId(faces[property])
                    if not normalized[property] then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                world.CustomSkyboxes[name] = normalized
                if not world.SaveCustomSkyboxes() then
                    world.CustomSkyboxes[name] = nil
                    return false
                end
                world.RefreshSkyDropdowns()
                return true
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.AddCustomSkyboxFromOptions()
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                local faces = {}
                for property, optionId in pairs(world.SkyFaceInputs) do
                    faces[property] = world.ReadOption(optionId, '')
                end
                local added = world.AddCustomSkybox(world.ReadOption('P1S12I7', ''), faces)
                if added then
                    local nameOption = Options.P1S12I7
                    if nameOption and type(nameOption.SetValue) == 'function' then
                        nameOption:SetValue('')
                    end
                    for _, optionId in pairs(world.SkyFaceInputs) do
                        local option = Options[optionId]
                        if option and type(option.SetValue) == 'function' then
                            option:SetValue('')
                        end
                    end
                end
                return added
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.RemoveSelectedCustomSkybox()
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                local name = world.ReadOption('P1S12D2', nil)
                if type(name) ~= 'string' or world.CustomSkyboxes[name] == nil then
                    return false
                end
                local removed = world.CustomSkyboxes[name]
                world.CustomSkyboxes[name] = nil
                if not world.SaveCustomSkyboxes() then
                    world.CustomSkyboxes[name] = removed
                    return false
                end
                world.RefreshSkyDropdowns()
                local presetOption = Options.P1S12D1
                if presetOption and presetOption.Value == name and type(presetOption.SetValue) == 'function' then
                    presetOption:SetValue(nil)
                end
                local savedOption = Options.P1S12D2
                if savedOption and savedOption.Value == name and type(savedOption.SetValue) == 'function' then
                    savedOption:SetValue(nil)
                end
                world.RefreshSky()
                return true
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.RestoreSky()
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                local owned = world.OwnedSky
                world.OwnedSky = nil
                world.ActiveSkyName = nil
                if owned then
                    pcall(function()
                        owned:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                for sky, guard in pairs(world.NativeSkyGuards) do
                    world.DestroyGuard(guard)
                    world.NativeSkyGuards[sky] = nil
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.GuardNativeSky(sky, preset)
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                if not sky or sky == world.OwnedSky then
                    return
                end
                local guard = world.NativeSkyGuards[sky]
                if not guard then
                    guard = world.NewGuard(sky)
                    world.NativeSkyGuards[sky] = guard
                end
                world.ReconcileGuard(guard, world.SkyProperties, preset or {})
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.RefreshSky()
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                local presetName = world.ReadOption('P1S12D1', '')
                local preset = world.ReadToggle('P1S12T1', false) and world.ResolveSkyPreset(presetName) or nil
                if not preset then
                    world.RestoreSky()
                    return
                end
                local nativeSkies = {}
                for _, child in ipairs(world.Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA('Sky') and child ~= world.OwnedSky then
                        nativeSkies[#nativeSkies + 1] = child
                    end
                end
                if #nativeSkies > 0 then
                    local owned = world.OwnedSky
                    world.OwnedSky = nil
                    world.ActiveSkyName = nil
                    if owned then
                        pcall(function()
                            owned:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    for _, sky in ipairs(nativeSkies) do
                        world.GuardNativeSky(sky, preset)
                    end
                    return
                end
                if not world.OwnedSky or world.OwnedSky.Parent == nil or world.ActiveSkyName ~= presetName then
                    local previous = world.OwnedSky
                    world.OwnedSky = nil
                    if previous then
                        pcall(function()
                            previous:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    local sky = Instance.new('Sky')
                    sky.Name = 'KiciaHookWorldVisuals_Sky'
                    for property, value in pairs(preset) do
                        pcall(function()
                            sky[property] = value
                        end)
                    end
                    world.OwnedSky = sky
                    world.ActiveSkyName = presetName
                    sky.Parent = world.Lighting
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.ResolveAtmosphereValues()
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                return {
                    Color = world.ReadOption('P1S13C1', Color3.new(0.7843, 0.6667, 0.4235)),
                    Decay = world.ReadOption('P1S13C2', Color3.new(0.3608, 0.2353, 0.0549)),
                    Density = world.ReadOption('P1S13S1', 0.395),
                    Offset = world.ReadOption('P1S13S2', 0),
                    Glare = world.ReadOption('P1S13S3', 0),
                    Haze = world.ReadOption('P1S13S4', 0),
                }
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.RestoreAtmosphere()
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                local owned = world.OwnedAtmosphere
                world.OwnedAtmosphere = nil
                if owned then
                    pcall(function()
                        owned:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                for atmosphere, guard in pairs(world.NativeAtmosphereGuards) do
                    world.DestroyGuard(guard)
                    world.NativeAtmosphereGuards[atmosphere] = nil
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.GuardNativeAtmosphere(atmosphere, desired)
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                if not atmosphere or atmosphere == world.OwnedAtmosphere then
                    return
                end
                local guard = world.NativeAtmosphereGuards[atmosphere]
                if not guard then
                    guard = world.NewGuard(atmosphere)
                    world.NativeAtmosphereGuards[atmosphere] = guard
                end
                world.ReconcileGuard(guard, world.AtmosphereProperties, desired)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.RefreshAtmosphere()
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                if not world.ReadToggle('P1S13T1', false) then
                    world.RestoreAtmosphere()
                    return
                end
                local desired = world.ResolveAtmosphereValues()
                local nativeAtmospheres = {}
                for _, child in ipairs(world.Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA('Atmosphere') and child ~= world.OwnedAtmosphere then
                        nativeAtmospheres[#nativeAtmospheres + 1] = child
                    end
                end
                if #nativeAtmospheres > 0 then
                    local owned = world.OwnedAtmosphere
                    world.OwnedAtmosphere = nil
                    if owned then
                        pcall(function()
                            owned:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    for _, atmosphere in ipairs(nativeAtmospheres) do
                        world.GuardNativeAtmosphere(atmosphere, desired)
                    end
                    return
                end
                local atmosphere = world.OwnedAtmosphere
                if not atmosphere or atmosphere.Parent == nil then
                    atmosphere = Instance.new('Atmosphere')
                    atmosphere.Name = 'KiciaHookWorldVisuals_Atmosphere'
                    world.OwnedAtmosphere = atmosphere
                    atmosphere.Parent = world.Lighting
                end
                for property, value in pairs(desired) do
                    atmosphere[property] = value
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.OnLightingDescendantAdded(descendant)
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                local className = descendant.ClassName
                local definition = world.PostEffects[className]
                if definition and world.ReadToggle(definition.Toggle, false) then
                    world.GuardNativeEffect(className, descendant)
                elseif descendant:IsA('Sky') and world.ReadToggle('P1S12T1', false) then
                    world.RefreshSky()
                elseif descendant:IsA('Atmosphere') and world.ReadToggle('P1S13T1', false) then
                    world.RefreshAtmosphere()
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.OnLightingDescendantRemoving(descendant)
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                local shouldRefresh = false
                local effectGuards = world.NativeEffectGuards[descendant.ClassName]
                local effectGuard = effectGuards and effectGuards[descendant]
                if effectGuard then
                    world.DestroyGuard(effectGuard)
                    effectGuards[descendant] = nil
                end
                local skyGuard = world.NativeSkyGuards[descendant]
                if skyGuard then
                    world.DestroyGuard(skyGuard)
                    world.NativeSkyGuards[descendant] = nil
                    shouldRefresh = true
                end
                local atmosphereGuard = world.NativeAtmosphereGuards[descendant]
                if atmosphereGuard then
                    world.DestroyGuard(atmosphereGuard)
                    world.NativeAtmosphereGuards[descendant] = nil
                    shouldRefresh = true
                end
                for className, owned in pairs(world.OwnedEffects) do
                    if descendant == owned then
                        world.OwnedEffects[className] = nil
                        shouldRefresh = true
                    end
                end
                if descendant == world.OwnedSky then
                    world.OwnedSky = nil
                    shouldRefresh = true
                elseif descendant == world.OwnedAtmosphere then
                    world.OwnedAtmosphere = nil
                    shouldRefresh = true
                end
                if shouldRefresh and world.Initialized then
                    task.defer(function()
                        if world.Initialized then
                            world.RefreshAll()
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.EnsureInitialized()
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                if world.Initialized then
                    return
                end
                world.Initialized = true
                world.LoadCustomSkyboxes()
                world.LightingGuard = world.NewGuard(world.Lighting)
                world.Connections.DescendantAdded = world.Lighting.DescendantAdded:Connect(world.OnLightingDescendantAdded)
                world.Connections.DescendantRemoving = world.Lighting.DescendantRemoving:Connect(world.OnLightingDescendantRemoving)
                local preRenderSignal = RunService.PreRender or RunService.RenderStepped
                world.Connections.PreRender = preRenderSignal:Connect(world.UpdateFrame)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.RefreshAll()
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                world.EnsureInitialized()
                world.RefreshLighting()
                for className in pairs(world.PostEffects) do
                    world.RefreshPostEffect(className)
                end
                world.RefreshAmbience()
                world.RefreshWeather()
                world.RefreshStretchedResolution()
                world.RefreshSky()
                world.RefreshAtmosphere()
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.Destroy()
                local world = RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals
                if not world.Initialized then
                    return
                end
                world.Initialized = false
                for _, connection in pairs(world.Connections) do
                    connection:Disconnect()
                end
                world.Connections = {}
                world.DestroyGuard(world.LightingGuard)
                world.LightingGuard = nil
                for className in pairs(world.PostEffects) do
                    world.RestorePostEffect(className)
                end
                local ambience = world.OwnedAmbience
                world.OwnedAmbience = nil
                world.ActiveAmbienceSource = nil
                if ambience then
                    pcall(function()
                        ambience:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                world.DestroyWeather()
                world.RestoreStretchedResolution()
                world.RestoreSky()
                world.RestoreAtmosphere()
            end

            RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals = {
                AppearanceSnapshots = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' }),
                TextureSnapshots = {},
                Highlights = {},
                Crosshair = nil,
                LastReconcileAt = 0,
                FollowPosition = nil,
                MaterialMap = {
                    Ghost = Enum.Material.ForceField,
                    Flat = Enum.Material.Neon,
                    Foil = Enum.Material.Foil,
                    Custom = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
                    Reflective = Enum.Material.Glass,
                },
                MaterialNames = {'Original', 'Ghost', 'Flat', 'Foil', 'Custom', 'Reflective'},
                FontMap = {
                    Inconsolata = Enum.Font.Code,
                    Gotham = Enum.Font.Gotham,
                    ['Source Sans'] = Enum.Font.SourceSans,
                    ['Roboto Mono'] = Enum.Font.RobotoMono,
                },
            }

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.ReadToggle(optionId)
                return Toggles and Toggles[optionId] and Toggles[optionId].Value == true
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.ReadOption(optionId, fallback)
                local option = Options and Options[optionId]
                if option == nil or option.Value == nil then
                    return fallback
                end
                return option.Value
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.AppendUniqueRoot(roots, seen, root)
                if typeof(root) ~= 'Instance' or root.Parent == nil or seen[root] then
                    return
                end
                seen[root] = true
                roots[#roots + 1] = root
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.ResolveScopes()
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                local scopes = { Character = {}, Arms = {}, Item = {} }
                local seen = { Character = {}, Arms = {}, Item = {} }
                visuals.AppendUniqueRoot(scopes.Character, seen.Character, LP.Character)

                local fighter = ResolveLocalFighter()
                local equippedItem = fighter and fighter.EquippedItem or nil
                local clientViewModel = type(equippedItem) == 'table'
                    and (rawget(equippedItem, '_ViewModel') or rawget(equippedItem, 'ViewModel')) or nil
                if type(clientViewModel) == 'table' then
                    visuals.AppendUniqueRoot(scopes.Item, seen.Item, rawget(clientViewModel, 'ItemModel'))
                    visuals.AppendUniqueRoot(scopes.Arms, seen.Arms, rawget(clientViewModel, '_left_arm'))
                    visuals.AppendUniqueRoot(scopes.Arms, seen.Arms, rawget(clientViewModel, '_right_arm'))
                end

                local viewModels = Workspace:FindFirstChild('ViewModels')
                local firstPerson = viewModels and viewModels:FindFirstChild('FirstPerson') or nil
                for _, model in ipairs(firstPerson and firstPerson:GetChildren() or {}) do
                    if model:IsA('Model') then
                        visuals.AppendUniqueRoot(scopes.Item, seen.Item, model:FindFirstChild('ItemVisual'))
                        visuals.AppendUniqueRoot(scopes.Arms, seen.Arms, model:FindFirstChild('LeftArm'))
                        visuals.AppendUniqueRoot(scopes.Arms, seen.Arms, model:FindFirstChild('RightArm'))
                    end
                end
                return scopes
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.CaptureAppearance(part)
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                local snapshot = visuals.AppearanceSnapshots[part]
                if snapshot then
                    return snapshot
                end
                snapshot = {
                    Material = part.Material,
                    Color = part.Color,
                    Transparency = part.Transparency,
                    Reflectance = part.Reflectance,
                }
                visuals.AppearanceSnapshots[part] = snapshot
                return snapshot
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.RestoreAppearance(part, snapshot)
                if not part or part.Parent == nil or type(snapshot) ~= 'table' then
                    return
                end
                pcall(function()
                    part.Material = snapshot.Material
                    part.Color = snapshot.Color
                    part.Transparency = snapshot.Transparency
                    part.Reflectance = snapshot.Reflectance
                end)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.CaptureTexture(instance, property, root)
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                local snapshot = visuals.TextureSnapshots[instance]
                if snapshot then
                    return snapshot
                end
                snapshot = { Property = property, Root = root }
                if property == 'Parent' then
                    snapshot.Value = instance.Parent
                else
                    snapshot.Value = instance[property]
                end
                visuals.TextureSnapshots[instance] = snapshot
                return snapshot
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.StripTextures(root, activeTextures)
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                for instance, snapshot in pairs(visuals.TextureSnapshots) do
                    if snapshot.Root == root and snapshot.Property == 'Parent' and instance.Parent == nil then
                        activeTextures[instance] = true
                    end
                end
                local descendants = root:GetDescendants()
                if root:IsA('BasePart') then
                    table.insert(descendants, root)
                end
                for _, descendant in ipairs(descendants) do
                    local property = nil
                    local replacement = nil
                    if descendant:IsA('MeshPart') then
                        property = 'TextureID'
                        replacement = ''
                    elseif descendant:IsA('SpecialMesh') then
                        property = 'TextureId'
                        replacement = ''
                    elseif descendant:IsA('Decal') or descendant:IsA('Texture') then
                        property = 'Transparency'
                        replacement = 1
                    elseif descendant:IsA('SurfaceAppearance')
                        or descendant:IsA('Clothing') or descendant:IsA('ShirtGraphic') then
                        property = 'Parent'
                    end
                    if property then
                        visuals.CaptureTexture(descendant, property, root)
                        activeTextures[descendant] = true
                        pcall(function()
                            if property == 'Parent' then
                                descendant.Parent = nil
                            else
                                descendant[property] = replacement
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.RestoreTexture(instance, snapshot)
                if not instance or type(snapshot) ~= 'table' then
                    return
                end
                pcall(function()
                    instance[snapshot.Property] = snapshot.Value
                end)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.ApplyChamScope(roots, optionPrefix, activeParts, activeTextures)
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                if not visuals.ReadToggle(optionPrefix .. 'T1') then
                    return
                end
                local materialName = visuals.ReadOption(optionPrefix .. 'D1', 'Ghost')
                local material = visuals.MaterialMap[materialName]
                local color = visuals.ReadOption(optionPrefix .. 'C1', Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
                local transparency = math.clamp(visuals.ReadOption(optionPrefix .. 'S1', 0), 0, 1)
                local stripTextures = visuals.ReadToggle(optionPrefix .. 'T2')
                for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
                    local descendants = root:GetDescendants()
                    if root:IsA('BasePart') then
                        table.insert(descendants, root)
                    end
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(descendants) do
                        if descendant:IsA('BasePart') then
                            local snapshot = visuals.CaptureAppearance(descendant)
                            activeParts[descendant] = true
                            pcall(function()
                                descendant.Material = material or snapshot.Material
                                descendant.Color = color
                                descendant.Transparency = snapshot.Transparency < 1 and transparency or snapshot.Transparency
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    if stripTextures then
                        visuals.StripTextures(root, activeTextures)
                    end
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.ReconcileHighlights(scopeName, roots, optionPrefix)
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                local entries = visuals.Highlights[scopeName] or {}
                visuals.Highlights[scopeName] = entries
                local active = {}
                if visuals.ReadToggle(optionPrefix .. 'T1') then
                    local fillColor = visuals.ReadOption(optionPrefix .. 'C1', Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
                    local fillTransparency = math.clamp(visuals.ReadOption(optionPrefix .. 'S1', 0.5), 0, 1)
                    local outlineColor = visuals.ReadOption(optionPrefix .. 'C2', Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
                    local outlineTransparency = math.clamp(visuals.ReadOption(optionPrefix .. 'S2', 0), 0, 1)
                    for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
                        active[root] = true
                        local highlight = entries[root]
                        if not highlight or highlight.Parent == nil then
                            highlight = Instance.new('Highlight')
                            highlight.Name = 'KiciaHookViewmodelHighlight_' .. scopeName
                            highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                            highlight.Adornee = root
                            highlight.Parent = root
                            entries[root] = highlight
                        end
                        highlight.FillColor = fillColor
                        highlight.FillTransparency = fillTransparency
                        highlight.OutlineColor = outlineColor
                        highlight.OutlineTransparency = outlineTransparency
                    end
                end
                for root, highlight in pairs(entries) do
                    if not active[root] then
                        pcall(function() highlight:Destroy() end)
                        entries[root] = nil
                    end
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.ReconcileModels()
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                local scopes = visuals.ResolveScopes()
                local activeParts = {}
                local activeTextures = {}
                visuals.ApplyChamScope(scopes.Character, 'P1S19', activeParts, activeTextures)
                visuals.ApplyChamScope(scopes.Arms, 'P1S20', activeParts, activeTextures)
                visuals.ApplyChamScope(scopes.Item, 'P1S21', activeParts, activeTextures)
                for part, snapshot in pairs(visuals.AppearanceSnapshots) do
                    if not activeParts[part] then
                        visuals.RestoreAppearance(part, snapshot)
                        visuals.AppearanceSnapshots[part] = nil
                    end
                end
                for instance, snapshot in pairs(visuals.TextureSnapshots) do
                    if not activeTextures[instance] then
                        visuals.RestoreTexture(instance, snapshot)
                        visuals.TextureSnapshots[instance] = nil
                    end
                end
                visuals.ReconcileHighlights('Arms', scopes.Arms, 'P1S22')
                visuals.ReconcileHighlights('Item', scopes.Item, 'P1S23')
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.ShimmerColorAt(elapsed, fraction, baseColor, fadeColor)
                local offset = ((1 - math.abs((elapsed * 0.5) % 2 - 1)) * 2 - 1) * 0.5
                local alpha = math.clamp(fraction - offset, 0, 1)
                if alpha <= 0.5 then
                    return fadeColor:Lerp(baseColor, alpha * 2)
                end
                return baseColor:Lerp(fadeColor, (alpha - 0.5) * 2)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.PerimeterColorAt(elapsed, fraction, firstColor, secondColor)
                local alpha = ((elapsed * 0.5) + fraction) % 1
                return firstColor:Lerp(secondColor, alpha)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.PingPongColorAt(elapsed, fraction, backgroundColor, mainColor, rotation)
                local wave = math.sin(elapsed * math.pi) + 1
                local rotationOffset = rotation / 90
                local firstBand = (wave + rotationOffset) % 4
                local secondBand = (4 - wave + rotationOffset) % 4
                local position = (fraction * 4) % 4
                local firstDistance = math.abs(position - firstBand) % 4
                firstDistance = math.min(firstDistance, 4 - firstDistance)
                local secondDistance = math.abs(position - secondBand) % 4
                secondDistance = math.min(secondDistance, 4 - secondDistance)
                local influence = math.max(
                    1 - firstDistance / 0.4,
                    1 - secondDistance / 0.4,
                    0
                )
                return backgroundColor:Lerp(mainColor, math.clamp(influence, 0, 1))
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.RainbowColorAt(elapsed, fraction)
                local hue = (elapsed * 0.2 + fraction) % 1
                return Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.ResolveLineColor(baseColor, fraction, elapsed)
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                if not visuals.ReadToggle('P1S26T10') then
                    return baseColor
                end
                local speed = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S12', 1)
                local animationTime = elapsed * speed
                local kind = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26D3', 'Shimmer')
                if kind == 'Rainbow' then
                    -- whole crosshair cycles through the rainbow together (same hue on every arm)
                    return visuals.RainbowColorAt(animationTime, 0)
                elseif kind == 'Perimeter' then
                    return visuals.PerimeterColorAt(
                        animationTime, fraction,
                        visuals.ReadOption('P1S26C7', Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
                        visuals.ReadOption('P1S26C8', Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255))
                    )
                elseif kind == 'PingPong' then
                    return visuals.PingPongColorAt(
                        animationTime, fraction,
                        visuals.ReadOption('P1S26C9', Color3.new(0, 0, 0)),
                        visuals.ReadOption('P1S26C10', Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
                        visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S13', 0)
                    )
                end
                return visuals.ShimmerColorAt(
                    animationTime, fraction, baseColor,
                    visuals.ReadOption('P1S26C6', Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40))
                )
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.ResolveTextGradient(elapsed, baseColor)
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                if visuals.ReadToggle('P1S26T14') then
                    local rainbowTime = elapsed * visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S19', 1)
                    local rainbowColors = {}
                    for index = 0, 8 do
                        local fraction = index / 8
                        rainbowColors[#rainbowColors + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
                            fraction, visuals.RainbowColorAt(rainbowTime, fraction))
                    end
                    return ColorSequence.new(rainbowColors), Vector2.zero, 0
                end
                if not visuals.ReadToggle('P1S26T13') then
                    return ColorSequence.new(baseColor), Vector2.zero, 0
                end
                local speed = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S17', 1)
                local animationTime = elapsed * speed
                if visuals.ReadOption('P1S26D5', 'Shimmer') == 'PingPong' then
                    local colors = {}
                    for index = 0, 8 do
                        local fraction = index / 8
                        colors[#colors + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
                            fraction,
                            visuals.PingPongColorAt(
                                animationTime, fraction,
                                visuals.ReadOption('P1S26C14', Color3.new(0, 0, 0)),
                                visuals.ReadOption('P1S26C15', Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
                                visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S18', 0)
                            )
                        )
                    end
                    return ColorSequence.new(colors), Vector2.zero, visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S18', 0)
                end
                local fadeColor = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26C13', Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40))
                return ColorSequence.new({
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, fadeColor),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, baseColor),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, fadeColor),
                }), Vector2.new(((1 - math.abs((animationTime * 0.5) % 2 - 1)) * 2 - 1) * 0.5, 0), 45
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.CreateCrosshairArm(parent, name)
                local outline = Instance.new('Frame')
                outline.Name = name .. 'Outline'
                outline.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                outline.BorderSizePixel = 0
                outline.Parent = parent
                local fill = Instance.new('Frame')
                fill.Name = name
                fill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
                fill.Parent = parent
                return { Outline = outline, Fill = fill }
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.EnsureCrosshair()
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                if visuals.Crosshair and visuals.Crosshair.Gui and visuals.Crosshair.Gui.Parent then
                    return visuals.Crosshair
                end
                local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
                gui.Name = 'KiciaHookCustomCrosshair'
                gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
                gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
                gui.DisplayOrder = 10000
                gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
                gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
                local container = Instance.new('Frame')
                container.Name = 'Container'
                container.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                container.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
                container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                container.Parent = gui
                local image = Instance.new('ImageLabel')
                image.Name = 'Image'
                image.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                image.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
                image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                image.BorderSizePixel = 0
                image.Visible = false
                image.Parent = container
                local textLabel = Instance.new('TextLabel')
                textLabel.Name = 'Text'
                textLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
                textLabel.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
                textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                textLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
                textLabel.Text = ''
                textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                textLabel.Visible = false
                textLabel.Parent = gui
                local textGradient = Instance.new('UIGradient')
                textGradient.Name = 'ColorGradient'
                textGradient.Parent = textLabel
                local textStroke = Instance.new('UIStroke')
                textStroke.Name = 'Outline'
                textStroke.Enabled = false
                textStroke.Parent = textLabel
                visuals.Crosshair = {
                    Gui = gui,
                    Container = container,
                    Image = image,
                    Text = textLabel,
                    TextGradient = textGradient,
                    TextStroke = textStroke,
                    Top = visuals.CreateCrosshairArm(container, 'Top'),
                    Bottom = visuals.CreateCrosshairArm(container, 'Bottom'),
                    Left = visuals.CreateCrosshairArm(container, 'Left'),
                    Right = visuals.CreateCrosshairArm(container, 'Right'),
                }
                return visuals.Crosshair
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.ResolveCrosshairImage(value)
                value = type(value) == 'string' and value:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') or ''
                if value == '' then
                    return ''
                end
                if value:match('^%d+$') then
                    return 'rbxassetid://' .. value
                end
                if value:match('^rbxasset') or value:match('^https?://') then
                    return value
                end
                if isfile and isfile(value) then
                    local customAsset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
                    if type(customAsset) == 'function' then
                        local ok, asset = pcall(customAsset, value)
                        if ok and type(asset) == 'string' then
                            return asset
                        end
                    end
                end
                return value
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.ApplyCrosshairPreset(name)
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                local preset = visuals.CrosshairPresets[name]
                if not preset then
                    return
                end
                local wanted = preset.Toggles or {}
                for _, toggleId in ipairs(visuals.CrosshairPresetManagedToggles) do
                    local toggle = Toggles and Toggles[toggleId]
                    if toggle and wanted[toggleId] ~= true and toggle.Value then
                        toggle:SetValue(false)
                    end
                end
                for optionId, value in pairs(preset.Options or {}) do
                    local option = Options and Options[optionId]
                    if option and type(option.SetValue) == 'function' then
                        option:SetValue(value)
                    end
                end
                for optionId, rgb in pairs(preset.Colors or {}) do
                    local option = Options and Options[optionId]
                    if option and type(option.SetValueRGB) == 'function' then
                        option:SetValueRGB(Color3.fromRGB(rgb[1], rgb[2], rgb[3]))
                    end
                end
                for _, toggleId in ipairs(visuals.CrosshairPresetManagedToggles) do
                    local toggle = Toggles and Toggles[toggleId]
                    if toggle and wanted[toggleId] == true and not toggle.Value then
                        toggle:SetValue(true)
                    end
                end
                -- Picking a preset means the player wants to see it.
                if Toggles and Toggles.P1S26T1 and not Toggles.P1S26T1.Value then
                    Toggles.P1S26T1:SetValue(true)
                end
                visuals.RefreshAll()
            end

            -- Kicia parity: native crosshair suppression rides the game's own
            -- Crosshair._Update hook instead of walking PlayerGui on a timer.
            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.RestoreNativeCrosshairs()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.SetNativeCrosshairHidden(false)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.HideNativeCrosshairs()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.SetNativeCrosshairHidden(true)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.SetCrosshairArm(arm, position, size, color, outlineColor, outlineThickness, visible)
                arm.Fill.Visible = visible
                arm.Outline.Visible = visible and outlineThickness > 0
                arm.Fill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(position.X, position.Y)
                arm.Fill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X, size.Y)
                arm.Fill.BackgroundColor3 = color
                arm.Outline.Position = arm.Fill.Position
                arm.Outline.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size.X + outlineThickness * 2, size.Y + outlineThickness * 2)
                arm.Outline.BackgroundColor3 = outlineColor
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.ResolveCrosshairPosition(deltaTime, center)
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                -- Kicia resets the follow spring immediately while Follow Target is
                -- disabled; ordinary custom-crosshair placement is never smoothed.
                if not visuals.ReadToggle('P1S26T9') then
                    visuals.FollowPosition = center
                    return center
                end
                local targetPosition = center
                if visuals.ReadToggle('P2S1T1')
                    and type(RivalsRuntimeBridge.GetBestAimbotTarget) == 'function' then
                    -- Cosmetic follow indicator: piggyback on the aim systems' sweep
                    -- when one ran recently instead of paying a full raycast sweep
                    -- per frame just to place a crosshair (it lerps anyway).
                    local targetInfo
                    if os.clock() - (RivalsRuntimeBridge.LastAimbotSweepAt or 0) <= 0.05 then
                        targetInfo = RivalsRuntimeBridge.LastAimbotSweepTarget
                    else
                        targetInfo = RivalsRuntimeBridge.GetBestAimbotTarget(true, AimbotBridge.IsAimbotIgnoreFovEnabled())
                    end
                    local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if targetInfo and targetInfo.worldPosition and camera then
                        local projected, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetInfo.worldPosition)
                        if onScreen and projected.Z > 0 then
                            targetPosition = Vector2.new(projected.X, projected.Y)
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not visuals.FollowPosition then
                    visuals.FollowPosition = targetPosition
                end
                local alpha = math.clamp(1 - math.exp(-math.max(deltaTime or 0, 0) * 15), 0, 1)
                visuals.FollowPosition = visuals.FollowPosition:Lerp(targetPosition, alpha)
                return visuals.FollowPosition
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.UpdateCrosshair(deltaTime)
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                if not visuals.ReadToggle('P1S26T1') then
                    if visuals.Crosshair and visuals.Crosshair.Gui then
                        visuals.Crosshair.Gui.Enabled = false
                    end
                    visuals.FollowPosition = nil
                    visuals.RestoreNativeCrosshairs()
                    return
                end

                -- Kicia's active gate: the custom crosshair only draws while the game
                -- would show a native one - an equipped item with a live crosshair
                -- object. In the lobby / unspawned / holding nothing there is no
                -- equipped item, so the gui turns off. Native suppression stays armed
                -- the whole time the toggle is on (Kicia arms it once in ApplyStatic).
                visuals.HideNativeCrosshairs()
                if not RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.IsNativeCrosshairActive() then
                    if visuals.Crosshair and visuals.Crosshair.Gui then
                        visuals.Crosshair.Gui.Enabled = false
                    end
                    return
                end

                local crosshair = visuals.EnsureCrosshair()
                crosshair.Gui.Enabled = true
                -- Kicia's a5 position provider is exactly ViewportSize / 2. It does
                -- not follow the game's cosmetic viewmodel-offset reticle, because
                -- that offset grows sharply when ADS narrows the camera FOV.
                local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
                local center = Vector2.new(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y * 0.5)
                local position = visuals.ResolveCrosshairPosition(deltaTime, center)
                crosshair.Container.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.round(position.X), math.round(position.Y))
                local textPosition = center
                if visuals.ReadToggle('P1S26T9')
                    and visuals.ReadOption('P1S26D2', 'Crosshair') == 'Crosshair + Text' then
                    textPosition = position
                end
                local elapsed = os.clock()

                local angle = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S4', 0)
                if visuals.ReadToggle('P1S26T8') then
                    angle = (angle + elapsed * visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S5', 90)) % 360
                end
                crosshair.Container.Rotation = angle
                local style = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26D1', 'Lines')
                local imageMode = style == 'Image'
                crosshair.Image.Visible = imageMode
                if imageMode then
                    local size = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S6', 32)
                    crosshair.Image.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
                    crosshair.Image.Image = visuals.ResolveCrosshairImage(visuals.ReadOption('P1S26I1', ''))
                    crosshair.Image.ImageTransparency = math.clamp(visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S7', 0), 0, 1)
                    if visuals.ReadToggle('P1S26T10') and visuals.ReadOption('P1S26D3', 'Shimmer') == 'Rainbow' then
                        crosshair.Image.ImageColor3 = visuals.RainbowColorAt(elapsed * visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S12', 1), 0)
                    else
                        crosshair.Image.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                    end
                end

                local textEnabled = visuals.ReadToggle('P1S26T11')
                crosshair.Text.Visible = textEnabled
                if textEnabled then
                    local crosshairTextValue = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26I2', '')
                    crosshair.Text.Text = tostring(crosshairTextValue or '')
                    crosshair.Text.TextSize = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S14', 14)
                    crosshair.Text.ZIndex = 10003
                    crosshair.Text.Font = visuals.FontMap[visuals.ReadOption('P1S26D4', 'Inconsolata')] or Enum.Font.Code
                    crosshair.Text.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
                        math.round(textPosition.X),
                        math.round(textPosition.Y + visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S15', 24))
                    )
                    local textColor = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26C11', Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
                    local gradientColor, gradientOffset, gradientRotation = visuals.ResolveTextGradient(elapsed, textColor)
                    crosshair.TextGradient.Color = gradientColor
                    crosshair.TextGradient.Offset = gradientOffset
                    crosshair.TextGradient.Rotation = gradientRotation
                    crosshair.TextStroke.Enabled = visuals.ReadToggle('P1S26T12')
                    crosshair.TextStroke.Color = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26C12', Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
                    crosshair.TextStroke.Thickness = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S16', 1)
                end

                local length = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S1', 12)
                local thickness = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S2', 2)
                local gap = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S3', 6)
                if visuals.ReadToggle('P1S26T7') then
                    local minimum = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S8', 4)
                    local maximum = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S9', 16)
                    local wave = 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(elapsed * visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S10', 3))
                    gap = gap + minimum + (maximum - minimum) * wave
                end
                local outlineThickness = visuals.ReadToggle('P1S26T2') and visuals.ReadOption('P1S26S11', 1) or 0
                local outlineColor = visuals.ReadOption('P1S26C1', Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
                local armDefinitions = {
                    {Key = 'Top', Position = Vector2.new(0, -(gap + length * 0.5)), Size = Vector2.new(thickness, length), Toggle = 'P1S26T3', Color = 'P1S26C2', Fraction = 0},
                    {Key = 'Bottom', Position = Vector2.new(0, gap + length * 0.5), Size = Vector2.new(thickness, length), Toggle = 'P1S26T4', Color = 'P1S26C3', Fraction = 0.5},
                    {Key = 'Left', Position = Vector2.new(-(gap + length * 0.5), 0), Size = Vector2.new(length, thickness), Toggle = 'P1S26T5', Color = 'P1S26C4', Fraction = 0.75},
                    {Key = 'Right', Position = Vector2.new(gap + length * 0.5, 0), Size = Vector2.new(length, thickness), Toggle = 'P1S26T6', Color = 'P1S26C5', Fraction = 0.25},
                }
                for _, definition in ipairs(armDefinitions) do
                    local baseColor = visuals.ReadOption(definition.Color, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
                    visuals.SetCrosshairArm(
                        crosshair[definition.Key], definition.Position, definition.Size,
                        visuals.ResolveLineColor(baseColor, definition.Fraction, elapsed),
                        outlineColor, outlineThickness,
                        not imageMode and visuals.ReadToggle(definition.Toggle)
                    )
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.RefreshAll()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.LastReconcileAt = tick()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.ReconcileModels()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.UpdateCrosshair(0)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.Update(deltaTime)
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                if tick() - visuals.LastReconcileAt >= 0.25 then
                    visuals.LastReconcileAt = tick()
                    visuals.ReconcileModels()
                end
                visuals.UpdateCrosshair(deltaTime)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.Destroy()
                local visuals = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals
                visuals.RestoreNativeCrosshairs()
                for part, snapshot in pairs(visuals.AppearanceSnapshots) do
                    visuals.RestoreAppearance(part, snapshot)
                end
                visuals.AppearanceSnapshots = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' })
                for instance, snapshot in pairs(visuals.TextureSnapshots) do
                    visuals.RestoreTexture(instance, snapshot)
                end
                visuals.TextureSnapshots = {}
                for _, entries in pairs(visuals.Highlights) do
                    for _, highlight in pairs(entries) do
                        pcall(function() highlight:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
                visuals.Highlights = {}
                if visuals.Crosshair and visuals.Crosshair.Gui then
                    pcall(function() visuals.Crosshair.Gui:Destroy() end)
                end
                visuals.Crosshair = nil
                visuals.FollowPosition = nil
                visuals.LastReconcileAt = 0
            end

            -- Direct ports of Kicia's removal techniques. Each one patches the game's
            -- own drawing path once per toggle flip and restores the captured original
            -- on disable/unload, so there is no scanning and no recurring cost.
            RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals = {
                Modules = {},
                Vignette = nil,
                Tracers = nil,
                Muzzle = nil,
                Hitsound = nil,
                Scope = {
                    OverlayHidden = false,
                    ReticleHidden = false,
                    OverlayDirty = false,
                    ReticleDirty = false,
                    Restore = nil,
                },
                -- nil means "leave the native value alone", matching Kicia's
                -- _crosshairVisible / _hitmarkerVisible tri-state.
                Crosshair = {
                    CrosshairVisible = nil,
                    HitmarkerVisible = nil,
                    Restore = nil,
                },
                Animation = { Restore = nil },
            }

            -- Kicia's sentinel: the "_Tracers" constant is repointed at a name that
            -- resolves to a no-op on the same class, so the call still succeeds.
            -- Table fields, not locals: RIVALS top scope is at Luau's 200-local limit.
            RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.TracerSentinel = '_Tracers\0NoGunTracers'
            RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.MuzzleStub = { PlayParticles = function() end }

            RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.ModulePaths = {
                Other = { 'Modules', 'ClientReplicatedClasses', 'ClientFighter', 'ClientItem', 'ItemInterface', 'Other' },
                Scope = { 'Modules', 'ClientReplicatedClasses', 'ClientFighter', 'ClientItem', 'ItemInterface', 'Mouse', 'Scope' },
                Gun = { 'Modules', 'ItemTypes', 'Gun' },
                ClientViewModel = { 'Modules', 'ClientReplicatedClasses', 'ClientFighter', 'ClientItem', 'ClientViewModel' },
                Crosshair = { 'Modules', 'Crosshair' },
                ViewModelAnimator = { 'Modules', 'ClientReplicatedClasses', 'ClientFighter', 'ClientItem', 'ClientViewModel', 'ViewModelAnimator' },
            }

            -- Kicia's dummy animation track: the animator's real track is swapped for this
            -- while the game's own PlayAnimation runs, so every piece of its bookkeeping
            -- still happens and nothing is actually played.
            RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.AnimationStub = {
                Play = function() end,
                Stop = function() end,
            }

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.RequireModule(key)
                local native = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals
                local cached = native.Modules[key]
                if cached then
                    return cached
                end
                local path = native.ModulePaths[key]
                local cursor = LP:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
                for _, segment in ipairs(path or {}) do
                    cursor = cursor and cursor:FindFirstChild(segment)
                end
                if not cursor then
                    return nil
                end
                local ok, value = pcall(require, cursor)
                if not ok or type(value) ~= 'table' then
                    return nil
                end
                native.Modules[key] = value
                return value
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.ReadConstant(method, index)
                for constantIndex, constantValue in debug.getconstants(method) do
                    if constantIndex == index then
                        return constantValue
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end

            -- ItemInterface.Other.Update writes AimingVignette.ImageTransparency from
            -- (1 - CurrentAimValue). Constant 2 is that literal 1; raising it to 999
            -- pushes the transparency past fully-invisible for every aim value.
            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.SetVignetteHidden(hidden)
                local native = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals
                if hidden then
                    if native.Vignette then
                        return
                    end
                    local other = native.RequireModule('Other')
                    local update = other and rawget(other, 'Update') or nil
                    if type(update) ~= 'function' then
                        return
                    end
                    local original = native.ReadConstant(update, 2)
                    if type(original) ~= 'number' then
                        return
                    end
                    debug.setconstant(update, 2, 999)
                    native.Vignette = { method = update, index = 2, value = original }
                else
                    local record = native.Vignette
                    if not record then
                        return
                    end
                    native.Vignette = nil
                    debug.setconstant(record.method, record.index, record.value)
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.SetGunTracersHidden(hidden)
                local native = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals
                if hidden then
                    if native.Tracers then
                        return
                    end
                    local gun = native.RequireModule('Gun')
                    local localTracers = gun and rawget(gun, '_LocalTracers') or nil
                    if type(localTracers) ~= 'function' then
                        return
                    end
                    for index, value in debug.getconstants(localTracers) do
                        if value == '_Tracers' then
                            rawset(gun, native.TracerSentinel, function() end)
                            debug.setconstant(localTracers, index, native.TracerSentinel)
                            native.Tracers = { class = gun, method = localTracers, index = index, value = value }
                            return
                        end
                    end
                else
                    local record = native.Tracers
                    if not record then
                        return
                    end
                    native.Tracers = nil
                    debug.setconstant(record.method, record.index, record.value)
                    rawset(record.class, native.TracerSentinel, nil)
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.SetMuzzleFlashHidden(hidden)
                local native = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals
                if hidden then
                    if native.Muzzle then
                        return
                    end
                    local viewModel = native.RequireModule('ClientViewModel')
                    local muzzleFlash = viewModel and rawget(viewModel, 'MuzzleFlash') or nil
                    if type(muzzleFlash) ~= 'function' then
                        return
                    end
                    local original = debug.getupvalue(muzzleFlash, 2)
                    if type(original) ~= 'table' then
                        return
                    end
                    debug.setupvalue(muzzleFlash, 2, native.MuzzleStub)
                    native.Muzzle = { method = muzzleFlash, value = original }
                else
                    local record = native.Muzzle
                    if not record then
                        return
                    end
                    native.Muzzle = nil
                    debug.setupvalue(record.method, 2, record.value)
                end
            end

            -- Kicia's NoGameHitsound: the game's own hitmarker sound is played by
            -- ClientViewModel.PlayHitmarkerSound; while Disable Game Sound is on,
            -- that method is swapped for a no-op so only the custom hit sound
            -- plays, and the exact original is put back on revert.
            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.SetGameHitsoundDisabled(disabled)
                local native = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals
                if disabled then
                    if native.Hitsound then
                        return
                    end
                    local viewModel = native.RequireModule('ClientViewModel')
                    local method = viewModel and rawget(viewModel, 'PlayHitmarkerSound') or nil
                    if type(method) ~= 'function' then
                        return
                    end
                    rawset(viewModel, 'PlayHitmarkerSound', function() end)
                    native.Hitsound = { class = viewModel, method = method }
                else
                    local record = native.Hitsound
                    if not record then
                        return
                    end
                    native.Hitsound = nil
                    rawset(record.class, 'PlayHitmarkerSound', record.method)
                end
            end

            -- Kicia wraps Scope.SetActive so the overlay frames are corrected exactly
            -- when the scope turns on, using the scope object's own frame fields.
            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.EnsureScopeHook()
                local scope = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.Scope
                if scope.Restore ~= nil or not (scope.OverlayHidden or scope.ReticleHidden) then
                    return
                end
                local scopeClass = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.RequireModule('Scope')
                local setActive = scopeClass and rawget(scopeClass, 'SetActive') or nil
                if type(setActive) ~= 'function' then
                    return
                end
                local wrapped = function(scopeObject, active)
                    coroutine.wrap(setActive)(scopeObject, active)
                    if not rawget(scopeObject, '_is_scope_active') then
                        return
                    end
                    if scope.OverlayDirty then
                        local visible = not scope.OverlayHidden
                        local circleFrame = rawget(scopeObject, 'CircleFrame')
                        local blurFrame = rawget(scopeObject, 'BlurFrame')
                        if circleFrame then
                            circleFrame.Visible = visible
                        end
                        if blurFrame then
                            blurFrame.Visible = visible
                        end
                    end
                    if scope.ReticleDirty then
                        local reticleContainer = rawget(scopeObject, 'ReticleContainer')
                        if reticleContainer then
                            reticleContainer.Visible = not scope.ReticleHidden
                        end
                    end
                end
                rawset(scopeClass, 'SetActive', wrapped)
                scope.Restore = { class = scopeClass, original = setActive }
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.RevertScopeHook()
                local scope = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.Scope
                local restore = scope.Restore
                if not restore then
                    return
                end
                scope.Restore = nil
                rawset(restore.class, 'SetActive', restore.original)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.SetScopeOverlayHidden(hidden)
                local scope = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.Scope
                scope.OverlayHidden = hidden
                scope.OverlayDirty = true
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.EnsureScopeHook()
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.SetScopeReticleHidden(hidden)
                local scope = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.Scope
                scope.ReticleHidden = hidden
                scope.ReticleDirty = true
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.EnsureScopeHook()
            end

            -- Kicia wraps the game's own Crosshair._Update and re-asserts visibility
            -- immediately after the native draw, so the native path keeps ownership and
            -- there is nothing to scan. The instance field is erased in the reference
            -- decompile; build 1035's _Update reads it as 'Frame', and its own constants
            -- name Foreground / Background / Hitmarker in the same order Kicia writes.
            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.EnsureCrosshairHook()
                local crosshair = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.Crosshair
                if crosshair.Restore ~= nil then
                    return
                end
                if crosshair.CrosshairVisible == nil and crosshair.HitmarkerVisible == nil then
                    return
                end
                local class = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.RequireModule('Crosshair')
                local update = class and rawget(class, '_Update') or nil
                if type(update) ~= 'function' then
                    return
                end
                local wrapped = function(instance, ...)
                    coroutine.wrap(update)(instance, ...)
                    if rawget(instance, '_destroyed') then
                        return
                    end
                    local frame = rawget(instance, 'Frame')
                    if typeof(frame) ~= 'Instance' then
                        return
                    end
                    local visible = crosshair.CrosshairVisible
                    if visible ~= nil then
                        local foreground = frame:FindFirstChild('Foreground')
                        local background = frame:FindFirstChild('Background')
                        if foreground then
                            foreground.Visible = visible
                        end
                        if background then
                            background.Visible = visible
                        end
                    end
                    local hitmarker = crosshair.HitmarkerVisible
                    if hitmarker ~= nil then
                        local marker = frame:FindFirstChild('Hitmarker')
                        if marker then
                            marker.Visible = hitmarker
                        end
                    end
                end
                rawset(class, '_Update', wrapped)
                crosshair.Restore = { class = class, original = update }
            end

            -- The wrapper alone is not enough: the game's _Update is task.defer'd from
            -- state changes only (SetType / SetVisible / SetSpacing / SetTransparency /
            -- SetAppearance), so a crosshair already on screen never updates again and
            -- the wrapper never gets a chance to hide it. Kicia pairs the hook with a
            -- registry of every local item's Mouse.MouseCrosshair.Crosshair object and
            -- writes those frames directly on toggle; new items need no direct write
            -- because their creation Refresh runs _Update through the wrapper. The walk
            -- happens at toggle time only, so there is no recurring cost.
            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.EachItemCrosshair(callback)
                local fighter = ResolveLocalFighter()
                for _, item in pairs(type(fighter) == 'table' and rawget(fighter, 'Items') or {}) do
                    local interface = type(item) == 'table' and rawget(item, 'ItemInterface') or nil
                    local mouse = type(interface) == 'table' and rawget(interface, 'Mouse') or nil
                    local mouseCrosshair = type(mouse) == 'table' and rawget(mouse, 'MouseCrosshair') or nil
                    local object = type(mouseCrosshair) == 'table' and rawget(mouseCrosshair, 'Crosshair') or nil
                    if type(object) == 'table' and not rawget(object, '_destroyed') then
                        callback(object)
                    end
                end
            end

            -- Kicia's IsCrosshairActive: true while the equipped item resolves to a
            -- live native crosshair object. Equipped truth is the fighter's own
            -- 'EquippedItem' field (the ClientItem table), the same read Kicia's item
            -- layer uses. NOT fighter:Get('EquippedItem') - the replicated Data only
            -- carries EquippedItemID strings, so Get returns nil and the gate would
            -- never open (live-proven with Fists equipped).
            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.IsNativeCrosshairActive()
                local fighter = ResolveLocalFighter()
                if type(fighter) ~= 'table' then
                    return false
                end
                local equipped = rawget(fighter, 'EquippedItem')
                if type(equipped) ~= 'table' then
                    return false
                end
                local interface = rawget(equipped, 'ItemInterface')
                local mouse = type(interface) == 'table' and rawget(interface, 'Mouse') or nil
                local mouseCrosshair = type(mouse) == 'table' and rawget(mouse, 'MouseCrosshair') or nil
                local object = type(mouseCrosshair) == 'table' and rawget(mouseCrosshair, 'Crosshair') or nil
                return type(object) == 'table' and rawget(object, '_destroyed') ~= true
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.ApplyCrosshairFrames()
                local crosshair = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.Crosshair
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.EachItemCrosshair(function(object)
                    local frame = rawget(object, 'Frame')
                    if typeof(frame) ~= 'Instance' then
                        return
                    end
                    if crosshair.CrosshairVisible ~= nil then
                        local foreground = frame:FindFirstChild('Foreground')
                        local background = frame:FindFirstChild('Background')
                        if foreground then
                            foreground.Visible = crosshair.CrosshairVisible
                        end
                        if background then
                            background.Visible = crosshair.CrosshairVisible
                        end
                    end
                    if crosshair.HitmarkerVisible ~= nil then
                        local marker = frame:FindFirstChild('Hitmarker')
                        if marker then
                            marker.Visible = crosshair.HitmarkerVisible
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end

            -- Restoring replays the game's own _Update once per live crosshair (identity
            -- 2, like Kicia) so the native path repaints immediately instead of on its
            -- next organic redraw. Uses the stored original while the hook still holds
            -- it; if the hook never installed, nothing was hidden and this no-ops.
            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.RevertCrosshairFrames()
                local restore = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.Crosshair.Restore
                local original = restore and restore.original or nil
                if type(original) ~= 'function' then
                    return
                end
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.EachItemCrosshair(function(object)
                    task.spawn(function()
                        local previousIdentity = type(getthreadidentity) == 'function' and getthreadidentity() or nil
                        if type(setthreadidentity) == 'function' then
                            pcall(setthreadidentity, 2)
                        end
                        coroutine.wrap(original)(object)
                        if previousIdentity ~= nil and type(setthreadidentity) == 'function' then
                            pcall(setthreadidentity, previousIdentity)
                        end
                    end)
                end)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.RevertCrosshairHook()
                local crosshair = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.Crosshair
                local restore = crosshair.Restore
                if not restore then
                    return
                end
                crosshair.Restore = nil
                rawset(restore.class, '_Update', restore.original)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.SyncCrosshairHook()
                local crosshair = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.Crosshair
                if crosshair.CrosshairVisible == nil and crosshair.HitmarkerVisible == nil then
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.RevertCrosshairHook()
                    return
                end
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.EnsureCrosshairHook()
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.SetNativeCrosshairHidden(hidden)
                local crosshair = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.Crosshair
                -- Tri-state: false = force-hide, nil = leave the native value alone.
                -- NOT `hidden and false or nil` - with false as the truthy arm that
                -- idiom collapses to nil for BOTH inputs and the setter never arms.
                local target = nil
                if hidden then
                    target = false
                end
                if crosshair.CrosshairVisible == target then
                    return
                end
                crosshair.CrosshairVisible = target
                if target == nil then
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.RevertCrosshairFrames()
                    -- The replay repaints hitmarkers too; re-assert the half still hidden,
                    -- exactly like the wrapper does after a native update.
                    if crosshair.HitmarkerVisible ~= nil then
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.ApplyCrosshairFrames()
                    end
                else
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.ApplyCrosshairFrames()
                end
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.SyncCrosshairHook()
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.SetHitmarkerHidden(hidden)
                local crosshair = RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.Crosshair
                -- Tri-state: false = force-hide, nil = leave the native value alone.
                -- NOT `hidden and false or nil` - with false as the truthy arm that
                -- idiom collapses to nil for BOTH inputs and the setter never arms.
                local target = nil
                if hidden then
                    target = false
                end
                if crosshair.HitmarkerVisible == target then
                    return
                end
                crosshair.HitmarkerVisible = target
                if target == nil then
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.RevertCrosshairFrames()
                    -- The replay repaints the whole frame; re-assert the half still hidden,
                    -- exactly like the wrapper does after a native update.
                    if crosshair.CrosshairVisible ~= nil then
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.ApplyCrosshairFrames()
                    end
                else
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.ApplyCrosshairFrames()
                end
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.SyncCrosshairHook()
