                    if not self.CameraHookInstalled
                        and self.CameraController
                        and type(self.CameraController.Update) == 'function' then
                        self.CameraHookInstalled = true
                        self.OriginalCameraUpdate = self.CameraController.Update
                        local originalUpdate = self.OriginalCameraUpdate
                        local state = self
                        self.CameraController.Update = function(...)
                            if state.Desync.active
                                and state.Desync.fighter
                                and state.Desync.fighter.Entity
                                and state.Desync.fighter.Entity.RootPart
                                and state.Desync.client then
                                state.Desync.fighter.Entity.RootPart.CFrame = state.Desync.client
                            end
                            return originalUpdate(...)
                        end
                    end

                    return true
                end

                function Elisium:IsDeflecting(player)
                    return self.Deflecting[player] == true
                end

                function Elisium:HasRiotShield(player)
                    return workspace.ViewModels:FindFirstChild(player.Name .. ' - Riot Shield - Riot Shield') ~= nil
                end

                function Elisium:IsValid(player)
                    local localPlayer = self.LocalPlayer
                    if not (player
                        and player ~= localPlayer
                        and player.Character
                        and player.Character:FindFirstChild('Humanoid')
                        and player.Character.Humanoid.Health > 0
                        and player:GetAttribute('EnvironmentID') == localPlayer:GetAttribute('EnvironmentID')) then
                        return false
                    end

                    if self.Settings.ffa_mode then
                        return true
                    end

                    return localPlayer:GetAttribute('TeamID') ~= player:GetAttribute('TeamID')
                end

                function Elisium:GetClosest()
                    local localPlayer = self.LocalPlayer
                    local closest, best = nil, math.huge

                    for _, player in next, self.Players:GetPlayers() do
                        if player ~= localPlayer and self:IsValid(player) then
                            local character = player.Character
                            local root = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                            if root then
                                local localDistance = localPlayer:DistanceFromCharacter(root.Position)
                                if localDistance < best then
                                    closest, best = player, localDistance
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    return closest
                end

                function Elisium:StopDesync()
                    local d = self.Desync
                    if not d.active then
                        return
                    end

                    if d.connection then
                        d.connection:Disconnect()
                        d.connection = nil
                    end

                    if d.client and d.fighter and d.fighter.Entity and d.fighter.Entity.RootPart then
                        d.fighter.Entity.RootPart.CFrame = d.client
                    end

                    d.active = false
                    d.server = nil
                    d.client = nil
                end

                function Elisium:StartDesync(target)
                    local d = self.Desync
                    if d.active then
                        return
                    end

                    local localPlayer = self.LocalPlayer
                    local fighter = self.FighterController and self.FighterController.LocalFighter
                    if not localPlayer.Character or not fighter or not fighter.Entity or not fighter.Entity.RootPart then
                        return
                    end

                    d.active = true
                    d.fighter = fighter
                    d.connection = self.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(WrapStep(function()
                        if not d.active then
                            if d.connection then
                                d.connection:Disconnect()
                                d.connection = nil
                            end
                            return
                        end

                        if not target
                            or not target.Character
                            or not target.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                            or not d.fighter
                            or not d.fighter.Entity
                            or not d.fighter.Entity.RootPart then
                            if d.connection then
                                d.connection:Disconnect()
                                d.connection = nil
                            end
                            if d.client and d.fighter and d.fighter.Entity and d.fighter.Entity.RootPart then
                                d.fighter.Entity.RootPart.CFrame = d.client
                            end
                            d.active = false
                            d.client = nil
                            d.server = nil
                            return
                        end

                        d.client = d.fighter.Entity.RootPart.CFrame

                        local item = d.fighter.EquippedItem
                        if not item then
                            return
                        end

                        local targetPos = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position

                        if self:IsDeflecting(target) or self:HasRiotShield(target) then
                            d.server = Vector3.new(0, 2^26, 0)
                            return
                        end

                        if item.Name == 'Slingshot' then
                            d.server = Vector3.new(0, 2^26, 0)
                        else
                            d.server = targetPos + Vector3.new(
                                self.Settings.x,
                                self.Settings.y,
                                self.Settings.z
                            )
                        end

                        d.fighter.Entity.RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(d.server)
                    end))
                end

                function Elisium:FireWeapon(target)
                    if not target or not target.Character then
                        return
                    end

                    local fighter = self.FighterController.LocalFighter
                    if not fighter then
                        return
                    end

                    local item = fighter.EquippedItem
                    if not item then
                        return
                    end

                    if self:IsDeflecting(target) or self:HasRiotShield(target) then
                        return
                    end

                    local character = target.Character
                    local head = character:FindFirstChild('HitboxHead')
                        or character:FindFirstChild('HitboxTorso')
                        or character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                    if not head then
                        return
                    end

                    local localCharacter = self.LocalPlayer.Character
                    local localRoot = localCharacter and localCharacter:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                    if not localRoot then
                        return
                    end

                    local shootPos = self.Desync.active and self.Desync.server or localRoot.Position
                    local aimPos = head.Position

                    if self.Settings.prediction then
                        local targetRoot = character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                        if targetRoot then
                            local ping = 0.05
                            pcall(function()
                                ping = self.LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing()
                            end)
                            local lead = math.clamp(ping, 0, 0.4)
                                * (self.Settings.prediction_amount or 1)
                            aimPos = aimPos + targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity * lead
                        end
                    end

                    local cframe = CFrame.new(shootPos, aimPos)
                    local data = {
                        [utf8.char(1)] = {
                            [utf8.char(0)] = self.Utility:EncodeCFrame(cframe),
                            [utf8.char(1)] = self.Utility:EncodeCFrame(cframe),
                            [utf8.char(2)] = head,
                        },
                    }

                    self.UseItemRemote:FireServer(
                        item:Get('ObjectID'),
                        self.EnumLibrary:ToEnum('StartShooting'),
                        data,
                        nil
                    )
                end

                function Elisium:InstallProjectileHandler()
                    if self.ProjectileConnection then
                        return
                    end

                    self.ProjectileConnection = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(child)
                        if not self.Settings.enable then
                            return
                        end

                        if not (child:IsA('BasePart') or child:IsA('Model')) then
                            return
                        end

                        if child.Name ~= 'Slingshot'
                            and child.Name ~= 'CoreProjectile'
                            and child.Name ~= 'OuterProjectile' then
                            return
                        end

                        local generation = self.ProjectileGeneration
                        task.spawn(function()
                            task.wait(0.03)
                            if generation ~= self.ProjectileGeneration or not self.Settings.enable then
                                return
                            end

                            local projectile = child:IsA('BasePart')
                                and child
                                or child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart')
                            if not projectile then
                                return
                            end

                            projectile.CanTouch = true

                            for _ = 1, 45 do
                                if generation ~= self.ProjectileGeneration or not self.Settings.enable then
                                    break
                                end

                                local target = self:GetClosest()
                                if target and target.Character then
                                    local hitpart = target.Character:FindFirstChild('HitboxHead')
                                        or target.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')

                                    if hitpart and hitpart:IsA('BasePart')
                                        and hitpart.Parent
                                        and projectile.Parent
                                        and hitpart:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
                                        and projectile:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
                                        pcall(firetouchinterest, hitpart, projectile, 0)
                                        pcall(firetouchinterest, hitpart, projectile, 1)
                                    end
                                end

                                task.wait()
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                end

                function Elisium:Start()
                    if self.Heartbeat then
                        return
                    end
                    if not self:LoadModules() then
                        return false
                    end

                    self.Enabled = true
                    self.Settings.enable = true
                    self:InstallProjectileHandler()

                    self.Heartbeat = self.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(WrapStep(function()
                        if not self.Settings.enable then
                            self:Stop()
                            return
                        end

                        local target = self:GetClosest()
                        if not target then
                            self:StopDesync()
                            return
                        end

                        local fighter = self.FighterController.LocalFighter
                        if not fighter then
                            self:StopDesync()
                            return
                        end

                        local item = fighter.EquippedItem
                        if not item then
                            self:StopDesync()
                            return
                        end

                        local targetFighter = self.FighterController:GetFighter(target)
                        if not targetFighter then
                            self:StopDesync()
                            return
                        end

                        local viewmodel = item.ViewModel
                        if not viewmodel then
                            self:StopDesync()
                            return
                        end

                        local targetEntity = targetFighter.Entity
                        if not targetEntity or targetEntity:Get('IsInvincible') then
                            self:StopDesync()
                            return
                        end

                        local ammo = item:Get('Ammo')
                        if ammo and ammo > 0 and not viewmodel:IsAnimationPlaying('Reload') then
                            if self.Debounce == false or self.Debounce == nil then
                                self.Debounce = os.clock() + 0.5
                                return
                            end

                            if typeof(self.Debounce) == 'number' and os.clock() < self.Debounce then
                                return
                            end

                            if typeof(self.Debounce) == 'number' then
                                self.Debounce = true
                            end

                            self:StartDesync(target)

                            if not target.Character then
                                return
                            end

                            if self.Desync.server then
                                self.LastShot = os.clock()
                                self:FireWeapon(target)
                            end
                        else
                            if not viewmodel:IsAnimationPlaying('Reload') then
                                setthreadidentity(2)
                                item:Input('StartReloading')
                                setthreadidentity(7)
                            end
                        end
                    end))

                    return true
                end

                function Elisium:Stop()
                    self.Enabled = false
                    self.Settings.enable = false
                    self.Debounce = false

                    if self.Heartbeat then
                        self.Heartbeat:Disconnect()
                        self.Heartbeat = nil
                    end

                    self.ProjectileGeneration = self.ProjectileGeneration + 1
                    self:StopDesync()
                end

                function Elisium:Destroy()
                    self:Stop()
                    if self.ProjectileConnection then
                        self.ProjectileConnection:Disconnect()
                        self.ProjectileConnection = nil
                    end
                    self.Loaded = false
                end
            end

            -- -----------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- Combat > Weapon Mods: Skin Changer (from rivals_unlocker.lua)
            -- Unlocks every skin / wrap / charm in the game's own Customize menu and shows
            -- whatever you equip there on your viewmodel (client side only).
            -- The hooks are installed once on first enable; turning the toggle off makes every
            -- hook pass straight through to the original behaviour.
            -- -----------------------------------------------------------------------
            RivalsRuntimeBridge.SkinChanger = {
                Installed = false,
                Installing = false,
                Enabled = false,
            }

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.SkinChanger.Install()
                local changer = RivalsRuntimeBridge.SkinChanger
                if changer.Installed or changer.Installing then
                    return
                end
                changer.Installing = true
                task.spawn(function()
                    local ok, err = pcall(function()
                        local _http = game:GetService('HttpService')
                        local _rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
                        local _lp = LP
                        local _ctrl = _lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers
                        local _mods = _rs:WaitForChild('Modules', 10)

                        local _enumLib = require(_mods:WaitForChild('EnumLibrary', 10))
                        if _enumLib then pcall(function() _enumLib:WaitForEnumBuilder() end) end
                        local _cosLib = require(_mods:WaitForChild('CosmeticLibrary', 10))
                        local _datCtrl = require(_ctrl:WaitForChild('PlayerDataController', 10))

                        local function _on()
                            return changer.Enabled == true
                        end

                        local _eq, _favs = {}, {}
                        local _buildingWep = nil
                        local _cfgFile = 'rivals_unlocker_config.json'
                        local _saveLock = false

                        local function _mkCosmetic(nm, ctype, opts)
                            local _base = _cosLib.Cosmetics[nm]
                            if not _base then return nil end
                            local _d = {}
                            for k, v in pairs(_base) do _d[k] = v end
                            _d.Name = nm
                            _d.Type = _d.Type or ctype
                            _d.Seed = _d.Seed or math.random(1, 1000000)
                            if _enumLib then
                                local _s, _eid = pcall(_enumLib.ToEnum, _enumLib, nm)
                                if _s and _eid then
                                    _d.Enum = _eid
                                    _d.ObjectID = _d.ObjectID or _eid
                                end
                            end
                            if opts then
                                if opts.inverted ~= nil then _d.Inverted = opts.inverted end
                                if opts.favoritesOnly ~= nil then _d.OnlyUseFavorites = opts.favoritesOnly end
                            end
                            return _d
                        end

                        local function _stripForSave()
                            local _out = {}
                            for wn, cos in pairs(_eq) do
                                _out[wn] = {}
                                for ct, cd in pairs(cos) do
                                    if cd and cd.Name then
                                        _out[wn][ct] = {
                                            Name = cd.Name,
                                            Inverted = cd.Inverted,
                                            OnlyUseFavorites = cd.OnlyUseFavorites,
                                        }
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            return { equipped = _out, favorites = _favs }
                        end

                        local function _loadCfg()
                            if not isfile or not readfile then return end
                            local _ok1, _ex = pcall(isfile, _cfgFile)
                            if not _ok1 or not _ex then return end
                            local _ok2, _raw = pcall(readfile, _cfgFile)
                            if not _ok2 or not _raw or _raw == '' then return end
                            local _ok3, _dec = pcall(_http.JSONDecode, _http, _raw)
                            if not _ok3 or not _dec then return end
                            if _dec.favorites then _favs = _dec.favorites end
                            if _dec.equipped then
                                _eq = {}
                                for wn, cos in pairs(_dec.equipped) do
                                    _eq[wn] = {}
                                    for ct, sd in pairs(cos) do
                                        if sd and sd.Name and _cosLib.Cosmetics[sd.Name] then
                                            local _cloned = _mkCosmetic(sd.Name, ct, {
                                                inverted = sd.Inverted,
                                                favoritesOnly = sd.OnlyUseFavorites,
                                            })
                                            if _cloned then _eq[wn][ct] = _cloned end
                                        end
                                    end
                                    if not next(_eq[wn]) then _eq[wn] = nil end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        local function _saveCfg()
                            if not writefile or _saveLock then return end
                            _saveLock = true
                            task.spawn(function()
                                task.wait(1)
                                local _okEnc, _enc = pcall(_http.JSONEncode, _http, _stripForSave())
                                if _okEnc then pcall(writefile, _cfgFile, _enc) end
                                _saveLock = false
                            end)
                        end

                        _loadCfg()

                        local _cosTypes = { 'Skin', 'Wrap', 'Charm', 'Dance', 'Emote' }
                        local function _isCosType(cosObj)
                            if not cosObj then return false end
                            for _, t in ipairs(_cosTypes) do
                                if cosObj.Type == t then return true end
                            end
                            return false
                        end

                        -- ownership overrides
                        local _origNormally = _cosLib.OwnsCosmeticNormally
                        local _origUniversally = _cosLib.OwnsCosmeticUniversally
                        local _origForWeapon = _cosLib.OwnsCosmeticForWeapon
                        _cosLib.OwnsCosmeticNormally = function(self, inv, nm, wep)
                            if _on() then
                                local c = _cosLib.Cosmetics[nm]
                                if c and c.Type == 'Skin' then return true end
                                return false
                            end
                            return _origNormally(self, inv, nm, wep)
                        end
                        _cosLib.OwnsCosmeticUniversally = function(self, inv, nm, wep)
                            if _on() then
                                local c = _cosLib.Cosmetics[nm]
                                if c and c.Type == 'Skin' then return true end
                                return false
                            end
                            return _origUniversally(self, inv, nm, wep)
                        end
                        _cosLib.OwnsCosmeticForWeapon = function(self, inv, nm, wep)
                            if _on() then
                                local c = _cosLib.Cosmetics[nm]
                                if c and c.Type == 'Skin' then return true end
                                return false
                            end
                            return _origForWeapon(self, inv, nm, wep)
                        end

                        local _origOwns = _cosLib.OwnsCosmetic
                        _cosLib.OwnsCosmetic = function(self, inv, nm, wep)
                            if _on() then
                                if nm:find('MISSING_') or nm == 'Bubble Gun' then
                                    return _origOwns(self, inv, nm, wep)
                                end
                                local c = _cosLib.Cosmetics[nm]
                                if c and _isCosType(c) then return true end
                            end
                            return _origOwns(self, inv, nm, wep)
                        end

                        local _origGet = _datCtrl.Get
                        _datCtrl.Get = function(self, key)
                            local _val = _origGet(self, key)
                            if not _on() then
                                return _val
                            end
                            if key == 'CosmeticInventory' then
                                local _prx = {}
                                if _val then
                                    for k, v in pairs(_val) do
                                        local c = _cosLib.Cosmetics[k]
                                        if c and _isCosType(c) then _prx[k] = v end
                                    end
                                end
                                return setmetatable(_prx, {
                                    __index = function(t, k)
                                        local c = _cosLib.Cosmetics[k]
                                        if c and _isCosType(c) then return true end
                                        return nil
                                    end,
                                })
                            end
                            if key == 'FavoritedCosmetics' then
                                local _res = _val and table.clone(_val) or {}
                                for wep, fv in pairs(_favs) do
                                    _res[wep] = _res[wep] or {}
                                    for nm, isFav in pairs(fv) do
                                        local c = _cosLib.Cosmetics[nm]
                                        if c and _isCosType(c) then _res[wep][nm] = isFav end
                                    end
                                end
                                return _res
                            end
                            return _val
                        end

                        local _origGetWep = _datCtrl.GetWeaponData
                        _datCtrl.GetWeaponData = function(self, wn)
                            local _d = _origGetWep(self, wn)
                            if not _on() or not _d then return _d end
                            local _m = {}
                            for k, v in pairs(_d) do _m[k] = v end
                            _m.Name = wn
                            if _eq[wn] then
                                for ct, cd in pairs(_eq[wn]) do _m[ct] = cd end
                            end
                            return _m
                        end

                        -- equip / favourite remotes are handled locally
                        if hookmetamethod then
                            local _remotes = _rs:FindFirstChild('Remotes')
                            local _dataRem = _remotes and _remotes:FindFirstChild('Data')
                            local _equipRem = _dataRem and _dataRem:FindFirstChild('EquipCosmetic')
                            local _favRem = _dataRem and _dataRem:FindFirstChild('FavoriteCosmetic')
                            if _equipRem then
                                local _onc
                                _onc = hookmetamethod(game, '__namecall', function(self, ...)
                                    if not _on() or getnamecallmethod() ~= 'FireServer' then
                                        return _onc(self, ...)
                                    end
                                    local _a = { ... }
                                    if self == _equipRem then
                                        local _wn, _ct, _cn = _a[1], _a[2], _a[3]
                                        local _opts = _a[4] or {}
                                        if _cn and _cn ~= 'None' and _cn ~= '' then
                                            local _inv = _datCtrl:Get('CosmeticInventory')
                                            if _inv and rawget(_inv, _cn) then
                                                return _onc(self, ...)
                                            end
                                        end
                                        _eq[_wn] = _eq[_wn] or {}
                                        if not _cn or _cn == 'None' or _cn == '' then
                                            _eq[_wn][_ct] = nil
                                            if not next(_eq[_wn]) then _eq[_wn] = nil end
                                        else
                                            local _cloned = _mkCosmetic(_cn, _ct, {
                                                inverted = _opts.IsInverted,
                                                favoritesOnly = _opts.OnlyUseFavorites,
                                            })
                                            if _cloned then _eq[_wn][_ct] = _cloned end
                                        end
                                        task.defer(function()
                                            pcall(function() _datCtrl.CurrentData:Replicate('WeaponInventory') end)
                                        end)
                                        _saveCfg()
                                        return
                                    end
                                    if self == _favRem then
                                        local _cos = _cosLib.Cosmetics[_a[2]]
                                        if _cos then
                                            _favs[_a[1]] = _favs[_a[1]] or {}
                                            _favs[_a[1]][_a[2]] = _a[3] or nil
                                            task.spawn(function()
                                                pcall(function() _datCtrl.CurrentData:Replicate('FavoritedCosmetics') end)
                                            end)
                                            _saveCfg()
                                        end
                                        return
                                    end
                                    return _onc(self, ...)
                                end)
                            end
                        end

                        -- show the equipped skin / wrap / charm on the local viewmodel
                        local _cliItem
                        pcall(function()
                            _cliItem = require(_lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem)
                        end)
                        if _cliItem and _cliItem._CreateViewModel then
                            local _origCVM = _cliItem._CreateViewModel
                            _cliItem._CreateViewModel = function(self, vmRef)
                                if not _on() then
                                    return _origCVM(self, vmRef)
                                end
                                local _wn = self.Name
                                local _wp = self.ClientFighter and self.ClientFighter.Player
                                _buildingWep = (_wp == _lp) and _wn or nil
                                if _wp == _lp and _eq[_wn] then
                                    local _dk = self:ToEnum('Data')
                                    if vmRef[_dk] then
                                        if _eq[_wn].Skin then
                                            vmRef[_dk][self:ToEnum('Skin')] = _eq[_wn].Skin
                                            vmRef[_dk][self:ToEnum('Name')] = _eq[_wn].Skin.Name
                                        end
                                        if _eq[_wn].Charm then vmRef[_dk][self:ToEnum('Charm')] = _eq[_wn].Charm end
                                        if _eq[_wn].Wrap then vmRef[_dk][self:ToEnum('Wrap')] = _eq[_wn].Wrap end
                                    elseif vmRef.Data then
                                        if _eq[_wn].Skin then vmRef.Data.Skin = _eq[_wn].Skin; vmRef.Data.Name = _eq[_wn].Skin.Name end
                                        if _eq[_wn].Charm then vmRef.Data.Charm = _eq[_wn].Charm end
                                        if _eq[_wn].Wrap then vmRef.Data.Wrap = _eq[_wn].Wrap end
                                    end
                                end
                                local _r = _origCVM(self, vmRef)
                                _buildingWep = nil
                                return _r
                            end
                        end

                        local _vmMod = _lp.PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem:FindFirstChild('ClientViewModel')
                        if _vmMod then
                            local _CVM = require(_vmMod)
                            local _origNew = _CVM.new
                            _CVM.new = function(repData, cliItm)
                                if _on() then
                                    local _wp = cliItm.ClientFighter and cliItm.ClientFighter.Player
                                    local _wn = _buildingWep or cliItm.Name
                                    if _wp == _lp and _eq[_wn] then
                                        local _RC = require(_rs.Modules.ReplicatedClass)
                                        local _dk = _RC:ToEnum('Data')
                                        repData[_dk] = repData[_dk] or {}
                                        local _cos = _eq[_wn]
                                        if _cos.Skin then repData[_dk][_RC:ToEnum('Skin')] = _cos.Skin end
                                        if _cos.Charm then repData[_dk][_RC:ToEnum('Charm')] = _cos.Charm end
                                        if _cos.Wrap then repData[_dk][_RC:ToEnum('Wrap')] = _cos.Wrap end
                                    end
                                end
                                return _origNew(repData, cliItm)
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                    changer.Installing = false
                    if ok then
                        changer.Installed = true
                    else
                        changer.Enabled = false
                        pcall(function() Toggles.WM1T1:SetValue(false) end)
                        pcall(function()
                            Library:Notify({ Title = 'Skin Changer', Description = 'Could not load the game modules.', Time = 3 })
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.SkinChanger.SetEnabled(value)
                local changer = RivalsRuntimeBridge.SkinChanger
                changer.Enabled = value == true
                if changer.Enabled then
                    changer.Install()
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.SkinChanger.Destroy()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.SkinChanger.Enabled = false
            end


            -- -----------------------------------------------------------------------
            -- Main tab: Spinbot (spins your character around its vertical axis)
            -- -----------------------------------------------------------------------
            RivalsRuntimeBridge.Spinbot = {
                Active = false,
                Humanoid = nil,
                OriginalAutoRotate = nil,
                DegreesPerSpeedUnit = 60, -- slider value x 60 = degrees per second (300 = 50 turns/s)
            }

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.Spinbot.Stop()
                local spin = RivalsRuntimeBridge.Spinbot
                if spin.Humanoid and spin.Humanoid.Parent and spin.OriginalAutoRotate ~= nil then
                    spin.Humanoid.AutoRotate = spin.OriginalAutoRotate
                end
                spin.Active = false
                spin.Humanoid = nil
                spin.OriginalAutoRotate = nil
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.Spinbot.Update(deltaTime)
                local spin = RivalsRuntimeBridge.Spinbot
                local movement = RivalsRuntimeBridge.Movement
                local wanted = movement.ReadToggle('MN1T4') and movement.IsKeyActive('MN1T4K')
                local character = LP.Character
                local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') or nil
                local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') or nil
                local alive = humanoid ~= nil and rootPart ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0

                if spin.Active and (not wanted or not alive or humanoid ~= spin.Humanoid) then
                    spin.Stop()
                end
                if not wanted or not alive then
                    return
                end
                if not spin.Active then
                    spin.Active = true
                    spin.Humanoid = humanoid
                    spin.OriginalAutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
                end

                humanoid.AutoRotate = false
                local speed = math.clamp(movement.ReadNumber('MN1S2', 18), 0, 300)
                rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(speed * spin.DegreesPerSpeedUnit) * deltaTime, 0)
                rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.Spinbot.Destroy()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.Spinbot.Stop()
            end

            -- Mini Hub support features: Corner Brackets ESP, 2D Box ESP and the
            -- animated text Crosshair (ported from the Mini Hub support script).
            -- Each feature builds its GUI on first use; until then nothing runs.
            -- -----------------------------------------------------------------------

                Visual = {
                    CornerEnabled = false,
                    Box2DEnabled = false,
                    ESPName = true,
                    ESPHealth = true,
                    ESPDistance = true,
                },
                Crosshair = { Enabled = false, Name = 'Yokai.win', Scale = 1 },
                Started = {},
                Signals = {},
            }

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Connect(signal, callback)
                local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
                table.insert(RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Signals, connection)
                return connection
            end

                --==============================================================
                -- REMOVE
                --==============================================================

                local function RemoveESP(player)

                    local object =
                        ESP[player]

                    if not object then
                        return
                    end

                    if object.Holder then
                        object.Holder:Destroy()
                    end

                    ESP[player] = nil
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- CHARACTER
                --==============================================================

                local function GetCharacter(player)

                    local character =
                        player.Character

                    if not character then
                        return
                    end

                    local humanoid =
                        character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
                            "Humanoid"
                        )

                    local root =
                        character:FindFirstChild(
                            "HumanoidRootPart"
                        )

                    if not humanoid or not root then
                        return
                    end

                    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                        return
                    end

                    return character,
                        humanoid,
                        root
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- STABLE BOX
                --==============================================================

                local function GetStableBox(
                    camera,
                    character,
                    root
                )

                    local success,
                        boxCFrame,
                        boxSize =
                        pcall(function()
                            return character:GetBoundingBox()
                        end)

                    if not success
                        or not boxCFrame
                        or not boxSize then

                        return
                    end

                    local topWorld =
                        Vector3.new(
                            boxCFrame.Position.X,
                            boxCFrame.Position.Y +
                                boxSize.Y / 2,
                            boxCFrame.Position.Z
                        )

                    local bottomWorld =
                        Vector3.new(
                            boxCFrame.Position.X,
                            boxCFrame.Position.Y -
                                boxSize.Y / 2,
                            boxCFrame.Position.Z
                        )

                    local topScreen =
                        camera:WorldToViewportPoint(
                            topWorld
                        )

                    local bottomScreen =
                        camera:WorldToViewportPoint(
                            bottomWorld
                        )

                    local rootScreen =
                        camera:WorldToViewportPoint(
                            root.Position
                        )

                    if topScreen.Z <= 0
                        or bottomScreen.Z <= 0
                        or rootScreen.Z <= 0 then

                        return
                    end

                    local rawHeight =
                        math.abs(
                            bottomScreen.Y -
                            topScreen.Y
                        )

                    if rawHeight <= 0
                        or rawHeight > 1800 then

                        return
                    end

                    local height =
                        rawHeight +
                        Config.TopPadding +
                        Config.BottomPadding

                    local width =
                        height *
                        Config.WidthScale

                    return
                        rootScreen.X,
                        (
                            topScreen.Y +
                            bottomScreen.Y
                        ) / 2,
                        width,
                        height
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- ESP SIZE
                --==============================================================

                local function GetESPSize(
                    realWidth,
                    realHeight,
                    distance
                )

                    local alpha =
                        math.clamp(
                            (
                                distance -
                                Config.FarDistanceStart
                            ) /
                            (
                                Config.VeryFarDistance -
                                Config.FarDistanceStart
                            ),
                            0,
                            1
                        )

                    -- ESP全体を少し大きくする
                    local width =
                        realWidth *
                        Config.SizeBoost

                    local height =
                        realHeight *
                        Config.SizeBoost

                    --==========================================================
                    -- MIN SIZE
                    --==========================================================

                    local minHeight =
                        (
                            Config.MinHeightNear +
                            (
                                Config.MinHeightFar -
                                Config.MinHeightNear
                            ) * alpha
                        ) *
                        Config.SizeBoost

                    local minWidth =
                        (
                            Config.MinWidthNear +
                            (
                                Config.MinWidthFar -
                                Config.MinWidthNear
                            ) * alpha
                        ) *
                        Config.SizeBoost

                    width =
                        math.max(
                            width,
                            minWidth
                        )

                    height =
                        math.max(
                            height,
                            minHeight
                        )

                    --==========================================================
                    -- MAX SIZE
                    --==========================================================

                    width =
                        math.min(
                            width,
                            Config.MaxWidth
                        )

                    height =
                        math.min(
                            height,
                            Config.MaxHeight
                        )

                    return width, height, alpha
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- BRACKET DRAW
                --==============================================================

                local function UpdateBrackets(
                    object,
                    width,
                    height
                )

                    local white =
                        math.max(
                            1,
                            Config.BracketThickness
                        )

                    local black =
                        math.max(
                            0,
                            Config.BracketOutlineThickness
                        )

                    -- 白線の外側だけに黒アウトライン
                    local outerThickness =
                        white + black * 2

                    --==========================================================
                    -- LENGTH
                    --==========================================================

                    local length =
                        math.min(
                            width,
                            height
                        ) * 0.22

                    length =
                        math.clamp(
                            length,
                            Config.BracketLengthMin,
                            Config.BracketLengthMax
                        )

                    -- 外側にはみ出さないように制限
                    local maxLengthX =
                        math.max(
                            1,
                            width - outerThickness
                        )

                    local maxLengthY =
                        math.max(
                            1,
                            height - outerThickness
                        )

                    length =
                        math.min(
                            length,
                            maxLengthX,
                            maxLengthY
                        )

                    local outerLength =
                        length + black * 2

                    --==========================================================
                    -- TOP LEFT
                    --==========================================================

                    object.O_TL_H.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            0,
                            0
                        )

                    object.O_TL_H.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            outerLength,
                            outerThickness
                        )

                    object.O_TL_V.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            0,
                            0
                        )

                    object.O_TL_V.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            outerThickness,
                            outerLength
                        )

                    object.W_TL_H.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            black,
                            black
                        )

                    object.W_TL_H.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            length,
                            white
                        )

                    object.W_TL_V.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            black,
                            black
                        )

                    object.W_TL_V.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            white,
                            length
                        )

                    --==========================================================
                    -- TOP RIGHT
                    --==========================================================

                    object.O_TR_H.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            width - outerLength,
                            0
                        )

                    object.O_TR_H.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            outerLength,
                            outerThickness
                        )

                    object.O_TR_V.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            width - outerThickness,
                            0
                        )

                    object.O_TR_V.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            outerThickness,
                            outerLength
                        )

                    object.W_TR_H.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            width - length - black,
                            black
                        )

                    object.W_TR_H.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            length,
                            white
                        )

                    object.W_TR_V.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            width - white - black,
                            black
                        )

                    object.W_TR_V.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            white,
                            length
                        )

                    --==========================================================
                    -- BOTTOM LEFT
                    --==========================================================

                    object.O_BL_H.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            0,
                            height - outerThickness
                        )

                    object.O_BL_H.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            outerLength,
                            outerThickness
                        )

                    object.O_BL_V.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            0,
                            height - outerLength
                        )

                    object.O_BL_V.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            outerThickness,
                            outerLength
                        )

                    object.W_BL_H.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            black,
                            height - white - black
                        )

                    object.W_BL_H.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            length,
                            white
                        )

                    object.W_BL_V.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            black,
                            height - length - black
                        )

                    object.W_BL_V.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            white,
                            length
                        )

                    --==========================================================
                    -- BOTTOM RIGHT
                    --==========================================================

                    object.O_BR_H.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            width - outerLength,
                            height - outerThickness
                        )

                    object.O_BR_H.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            outerLength,
                            outerThickness
                        )

                    object.O_BR_V.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            width - outerThickness,
                            height - outerLength
                        )

                    object.O_BR_V.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            outerThickness,
                            outerLength
                        )

                    object.W_BR_H.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            width - length - black,
                            height - white - black
                        )

                    object.W_BR_H.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            length,
                            white
                        )

                    object.W_BR_V.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            width - white - black,
                            height - length - black
                        )

                    object.W_BR_V.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            white,
                            length
                        )
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- UPDATE ESP
                --==============================================================

                local function UpdateESP(
                    player,
                    object,
                    camera
                )

                    if not RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Visual.CornerEnabled then
                        object.Holder.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    local character,
                        humanoid,
                        root =
                        GetCharacter(player)

                    if not character then
                        object.Holder.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    local localCharacter =
                        LocalPlayer.Character

                    if not localCharacter then
                        object.Holder.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    local localRoot =
                        localCharacter:FindFirstChild(
                            "HumanoidRootPart"
                        )

                    if not localRoot then
                        object.Holder.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    --==========================================================
                    -- DISTANCE
                    --==========================================================

                    local distance =
                        (
                            localRoot.Position -
                            root.Position
                        ).Magnitude

                    if distance > Config.MaxDistance then
                        object.Holder.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    --==========================================================
                    -- BOX
                    --==========================================================

                    local centerX,
                        centerY,
                        realWidth,
                        realHeight =
                        GetStableBox(
                            camera,
                            character,
                            root
                        )

                    if not centerX then
                        object.Holder.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    local width,
                        height,
                        alpha =
                        GetESPSize(
                            realWidth,
                            realHeight,
                            distance
                        )

                    local x =
                        centerX -
                        width / 2

                    local y =
                        centerY -
                        height / 2

                    --==========================================================
                    -- VIEWPORT
                    --==========================================================

                    local viewport =
                        camera.ViewportSize

                    if x > viewport.X
                        or x + width < 0
                        or y > viewport.Y
                        or y + height < 0 then

                        object.Holder.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    --==========================================================
                    -- HOLDER
                    --==========================================================

                    object.Holder.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            math.floor(x),
                            math.floor(y)
                        )

                    object.Holder.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            math.max(
                                1,
                                math.floor(width)
                            ),
                            math.max(
                                1,
                                math.floor(height)
                            )
                        )

                    object.Holder.Visible = true

                    --==========================================================
                    -- BOX
                    --==========================================================

                    object.Box.Visible =
                        Config.BoxESP

                    if Config.BoxESP then

                        UpdateBrackets(
                            object,
                            width,
                            height
                        )
                    end

                    --==========================================================
                    -- HEALTH
                    --==========================================================

                    object.HealthOutline.Visible =
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Visual.ESPHealth

                    if RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Visual.ESPHealth then

                        local healthWidth =
                            Config.HealthWidthNear +
                            (
                                Config.HealthWidthFar -
                                Config.HealthWidthNear
                            ) * alpha

                        healthWidth =
                            math.clamp(
                                math.floor(
                                    healthWidth + 0.5
                                ),
                                Config.HealthWidthFar,
                                Config.HealthWidthNear
                            )

                        local gap =
                            Config.HealthGapNear +
                            (
                                Config.HealthGapFar -
                                Config.HealthGapNear
                            ) * alpha

                        gap =
                            math.max(
                                Config.HealthGapFar,
                                math.floor(gap + 0.5)
                            )

                        local totalWidth =
                            healthWidth +
                            Config.HealthOutline * 2

                        object.HealthOutline.Size =
                            UDim2.fromOffset(
                                totalWidth,
                                math.max(
                                    1,
                                    math.floor(height)
                                )
                            )

                        object.HealthOutline.Position =
                            UDim2.new(
                                0,
                                -(
                                    totalWidth +
                                    gap
                                ),
                                0,
                                0
                            )

                        object.HealthBack.Position =
                            UDim2.fromOffset(
                                Config.HealthOutline,
                                Config.HealthOutline
                            )

                        object.HealthBack.Size =
                            UDim2.new(
                                1,
                                -Config.HealthOutline * 2,
                                1,
                                -Config.HealthOutline * 2
                            )

                        local maxHealth =
                            math.max(
                                humanoid.MaxHealth,
                                1
                            )

                        local ratio =
                            math.clamp(
                                humanoid.Health /
                                    maxHealth,
                                0,
                                1
                            )

                        object.Health.Size =
                            UDim2.new(
                                1,
                                0,
                                ratio,
                                0
                            )

                        object.Health.BackgroundColor3 =
                            Config.HealthLowColor:Lerp(
                                Config.HealthFullColor,
                                ratio
                            )
                    end

                    --==========================================================
                    -- NAME
                    --==========================================================

                    object.Name.Visible =
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Visual.ESPName

                    object.Name.Text =
                        player.DisplayName

                    object.Name.TextSize =
                        math.floor(
                            Config.NameSizeNear +
                            (
                                Config.NameSizeFar -
                                Config.NameSizeNear
                            ) * alpha
                        )

                    object.Name.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            math.max(
                                50,
                                math.floor(width * 2)
                            ),
                            18
                        )

                    --==========================================================
                    -- DISTANCE
                    --==========================================================

                    object.Distance.Visible =
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Visual.ESPDistance

                    object.Distance.Text =
                        math.floor(distance) ..
                        "m"

                    object.Distance.TextSize =
                        math.floor(
                            Config.DistanceSizeNear +
                            (
                                Config.DistanceSizeFar -
                                Config.DistanceSizeNear
                            ) * alpha
                        )

                    object.Distance.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            math.max(
                                45,
                                math.floor(width * 1.5)
                            ),
                            16
                        )
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- INITIAL PLAYERS
                --==============================================================

                for _, player in ipairs(
                    Players:GetPlayers()
                ) do

                    if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                        CreateESP(player)
                    end
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- PLAYER ADDED
                --==============================================================

                RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Connect(Players.PlayerAdded, 
                    function(player)

                        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                            CreateESP(player)
                        end
                    end
                )

                --==============================================================
                -- PLAYER REMOVING
                --==============================================================

                RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, 
                    function(player)

                        RemoveESP(player)
                    end
                )

                --==============================================================
                -- RENDER LOOP
                --==============================================================

                RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Connect(RunService.RenderStepped, 
                    function()

                        local camera =
                            workspace.CurrentCamera

                        if not camera then
                            return
                        end

                        for player, object in pairs(ESP) do

                            if player.Parent ~= Players then

                                RemoveESP(player)

                            else

                                UpdateESP(
                                    player,
                                    object,
                                    camera
                                )
                            end
                        end
                    end
                )
            end

                -- ================= 2D Box ESP =================

                        Color3.fromRGB(70, 255, 120),

                    HealthWidthNear = 2,
                    HealthWidthFar = 1,

                    HealthOutline = 1,

                    HealthGapNear = 2,
                    HealthGapFar = 1,

                    ----------------------------------------------------------
                    -- TEXT
                    ----------------------------------------------------------

                    TextColor =
                        Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),

                    TextOutlineColor =
                        Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),

                    NameSizeNear = 12,
                    NameSizeFar = 9,

                    DistanceSizeNear = 10,
                    DistanceSizeFar = 8,

                    ----------------------------------------------------------

                    ----------------------------------------------------------

                    MaxDistance = math.huge,

                    ----------------------------------------------------------

                    ----------------------------------------------------------

                    WidthScale = 0.50,

                    TopPadding = 3,

                    MinHeightNear = 25,
                    MinHeightFar = 32,

                    MaxHeight = 800,

                    Instance.new("ScreenGui")

                    "MiniHub_2DBoxESP"

                ScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
                ScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 999999
                ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior =
                    Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

                ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui

                --==============================================================
                -- STORAGE
                --==============================================================

                local ESP = {}

                --==============================================================
                -- TEXT
                --==============================================================

                --==============================================================

                    local line =
                        Instance.new("Frame")

                    line.BackgroundColor3 =
                        color

                    line.BorderSizePixel = 0

                    line.Parent = parent

                    return line
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- CREATE ESP
                --==============================================================

                local function CreateESP(player)

                    if player == LocalPlayer then
                        return
                    end

                    if ESP[player] then
                        return ESP[player]
                    end

                    --==========================================================
                    -- HOLDER
                    --==========================================================

                        Instance.new("Frame")

                    holder.Name =
                        player.Name .. "_ESP"

                    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    holder.BorderSizePixel = 0

                    holder.ClipsDescendants = false
                    holder.Visible = false

                    holder.Parent = ScreenGui

                    --==========================================================
                    -- BOX CONTAINER
                    --==========================================================

                    local box =
                        Instance.new("Frame")

                    box.Name = "Box2D"

                    box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    box.BorderSizePixel = 0

                    box.ClipsDescendants = true

                    box.Size =
                        UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

                    box.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            0,
                            0
                        )

                    --==========================================================
                    -- OUTLINE
                    --==========================================================

                    local outlineTop =
                        CreateLine(
                            box,
                            Config.BoxOutlineColor
                        )

                    local outlineBottom =
                        CreateLine(
                            box,
                            Config.BoxOutlineColor
                        )

                    local outlineLeft =
                        CreateLine(
                            box,
                            Config.BoxOutlineColor
                        )

                    local outlineRight =
                        CreateLine(
                            box,
                            Config.BoxOutlineColor
                        )

                    --==========================================================
                    -- WHITE BOX
                    --==========================================================

                    local whiteTop =
                        CreateLine(
                            box,
                            Config.BoxColor
                        )

                    local whiteBottom =
                        CreateLine(
                            box,
                            Config.BoxColor
                        )

                    local whiteLeft =
                        CreateLine(
                            box,
                            Config.BoxColor
                        )

                    local whiteRight =
                        CreateLine(
                            box,
                            Config.BoxColor
                        )

                    --==========================================================
                    -- HEALTH
                    --==========================================================

                    local healthOutline =
                        Instance.new("Frame")

                    healthOutline.Name =
                        "HealthOutline"

                    healthOutline.BackgroundColor3 =
                        Config.BoxOutlineColor

                    healthOutline.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    healthOutline.ClipsDescendants = false

                    healthOutline.Parent = holder

                    local healthBack =
                        Instance.new("Frame")

                    healthBack.Name =
                        "HealthBackground"

                    healthBack.BackgroundColor3 =
                        Config.HealthBackgroundColor

                    healthBack.BorderSizePixel = 0

                    healthBack.Parent =
                        healthOutline

                    local health =
                        Instance.new("Frame")

                    health.Name = "Health"

                    health.BackgroundColor3 =
                        Config.HealthFullColor

                    health.BorderSizePixel = 0

                    health.AnchorPoint =
                        Vector2.new(
                            0,
                            1
                        )

                    health.Position =
                        UDim2.new(
                            0,
                            0,
                            1,
                            0
                        )

                    health.Size =
                        UDim2.new(
                            1,
                            0,
                            1,
                            0
                        )

                    health.Parent =
                        healthBack

                    --==========================================================
                    -- NAME
                    --==========================================================

                    local name =
                        CreateText(holder)

                    name.Name =
                        "Name"

                    name.AnchorPoint =
                        Vector2.new(
                            0.5,
                            1
                        )

                    name.Position =
                        UDim2.new(
                            0.5,
                            0,
                            0,
                            -4
                        )

                    name.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            240,
                            18
                        )

                    --==========================================================
                    -- DISTANCE
                    --==========================================================

                    local distance =

                    distance.Name =
                        "Distance"

                        Box = box,

                        WhiteLeft = whiteLeft,
                        WhiteRight = whiteRight,

                        -- Health
                        HealthOutline = healthOutline,

                        Health = health,

                        -- Text

                        Distance = distance,
                    }
