                --==============================================================
                -- REMOVE
                --==============================================================

                local function RemoveESP(player)

                    local object =
                        ESP[player]

                    if not object then
                        return
                    end

                    if object.Holder then
                        object.Holder:Destroy()
                    end

                    ESP[player] = nil
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- CHARACTER
                --==============================================================

                local function GetCharacter(player)

                    local character =
                        player.Character

                    if not character then
                        return
                    end

                    local humanoid =
                        character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
                            "Humanoid"
                        )

                    local root =
                        character:FindFirstChild(
                            "HumanoidRootPart"
                        )

                    if not humanoid or not root then
                        return
                    end

                    if humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                        return
                    end

                    return character,
                        humanoid,
                        root
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- STABLE BOX
                --==============================================================

                local function GetStableBox(
                    camera,
                    character,
                    root
                )

                    local success,
                        boxCFrame,
                        boxSize =
                        pcall(function()
                            return character:GetBoundingBox()
                        end)

                    if not success
                        or not boxCFrame
                        or not boxSize then

                        return
                    end

                    local topWorld =
                        Vector3.new(
                            boxCFrame.Position.X,
                            boxCFrame.Position.Y +
                                boxSize.Y / 2,
                            boxCFrame.Position.Z
                        )

                    local bottomWorld =
                        Vector3.new(
                            boxCFrame.Position.X,
                            boxCFrame.Position.Y -
                                boxSize.Y / 2,
                            boxCFrame.Position.Z
                        )

                    local topScreen =
                        camera:WorldToViewportPoint(
                            topWorld
                        )

                    local bottomScreen =
                        camera:WorldToViewportPoint(
                            bottomWorld
                        )

                    local rootScreen =
                        camera:WorldToViewportPoint(
                            root.Position
                        )

                    if topScreen.Z <= 0
                        or bottomScreen.Z <= 0
                        or rootScreen.Z <= 0 then

                        return
                    end

                    local rawHeight =
                        math.abs(
                            bottomScreen.Y -
                            topScreen.Y
                        )

                    if rawHeight <= 0
                        or rawHeight > 1800 then

                        return
                    end

                    local height =
                        rawHeight +
                        Config.TopPadding +
                        Config.BottomPadding

                    local width =
                        height *
                        Config.WidthScale

                    return
                        rootScreen.X,
                        (
                            topScreen.Y +
                            bottomScreen.Y
                        ) / 2,
                        width,
                        height
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- ESP SIZE
                --==============================================================

                local function GetESPSize(
                    realWidth,
                    realHeight,
                    distance
                )

                    local alpha =
                        math.clamp(
                            (
                                distance -
                                Config.FarDistanceStart
                            ) /
                            (
                                Config.VeryFarDistance -
                                Config.FarDistanceStart
                            ),
                            0,
                            1
                        )

                    local width =
                        realWidth *
                        Config.SizeBoost

                    local height =
                        realHeight *
                        Config.SizeBoost

                    --==========================================================
                    -- MIN SIZE
                    --==========================================================

                    local minHeight =
                        (
                            Config.MinHeightNear +
                            (
                                Config.MinHeightFar -
                                Config.MinHeightNear
                            ) * alpha
                        ) *
                        Config.SizeBoost

                    local minWidth =
                        (
                            Config.MinWidthNear +
                            (
                                Config.MinWidthFar -
                                Config.MinWidthNear
                            ) * alpha
                        ) *
                        Config.SizeBoost

                    width =
                        math.max(
                            width,
                            minWidth
                        )

                    height =
                        math.max(
                            height,
                            minHeight
                        )

                    --==========================================================
                    -- MAX SIZE
                    --==========================================================

                    width =
                        math.min(
                            width,
                            Config.MaxWidth
                        )

                    height =
                        math.min(
                            height,
                            Config.MaxHeight
                        )

                    return width, height, alpha
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- 2D BOX DRAW
                --==============================================================

                local function UpdateBox(
                    object,
                    width,
                    height
                )

                    local white =
                        math.max(
                            1,
                            Config.BoxThickness
                        )

                    local black =
                        math.max(
                            0,
                            Config.BoxOutlineThickness
                        )

                    --==========================================================
                    -- OUTER SIZE
                    --==========================================================

                    local outer =
                        white +
                        black * 2

                    --==========================================================
                    -- OUTLINE
                    --==========================================================

                    -- TOP
                    object.OutlineTop.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            0,
                            0
                        )

                    object.OutlineTop.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            width,
                            outer
                        )

                    -- BOTTOM
                    object.OutlineBottom.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            0,
                            height - outer
                        )

                    object.OutlineBottom.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            width,
                            outer
                        )

                    -- LEFT
                    object.OutlineLeft.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            0,
                            0
                        )

                    object.OutlineLeft.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            outer,
                            height
                        )

                    -- RIGHT
                    object.OutlineRight.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            width - outer,
                            0
                        )

                    object.OutlineRight.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            outer,
                            height
                        )

                    --==========================================================
                    -- WHITE BOX
                    --==========================================================

                    -- TOP
                    object.WhiteTop.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            black,
                            black
                        )

                    object.WhiteTop.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            width - black * 2,
                            white
                        )

                    -- BOTTOM
                    object.WhiteBottom.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            black,
                            height - white - black
                        )

                    object.WhiteBottom.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            width - black * 2,
                            white
                        )

                    -- LEFT
                    object.WhiteLeft.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            black,
                            black
                        )

                    object.WhiteLeft.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            white,
                            height - black * 2
                        )

                    -- RIGHT
                    object.WhiteRight.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            width - white - black,
                            black
                        )

                    object.WhiteRight.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            white,
                            height - black * 2
                        )
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- UPDATE ESP
                --==============================================================

                local function UpdateESP(
                    player,
                    object,
                    camera
                )

                    if not RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Visual.Box2DEnabled then
                        object.Holder.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    local character,
                        humanoid,
                        root =
                        GetCharacter(player)

                    if not character then
                        object.Holder.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    local localCharacter =
                        LocalPlayer.Character

                    if not localCharacter then
                        object.Holder.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    local localRoot =
                        localCharacter:FindFirstChild(
                            "HumanoidRootPart"
                        )

                    if not localRoot then
                        object.Holder.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    --==========================================================
                    -- DISTANCE
                    --==========================================================

                    local distance =
                        (
                            localRoot.Position -
                            root.Position
                        ).Magnitude

                    if distance > Config.MaxDistance then
                        object.Holder.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    --==========================================================
                    -- BOX
                    --==========================================================

                    local centerX,
                        centerY,
                        realWidth,
                        realHeight =
                        GetStableBox(
                            camera,
                            character,
                            root
                        )

                    if not centerX then
                        object.Holder.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    local width,
                        height,
                        alpha =
                        GetESPSize(
                            realWidth,
                            realHeight,
                            distance
                        )

                    local x =
                        centerX -
                        width / 2

                    local y =
                        centerY -
                        height / 2

                    --==========================================================
                    -- VIEWPORT
                    --==========================================================

                    local viewport =
                        camera.ViewportSize

                    if x > viewport.X
                        or x + width < 0
                        or y > viewport.Y
                        or y + height < 0 then

                        object.Holder.Visible = false
                        return
                    end

                    --==========================================================
                    -- HOLDER
                    --==========================================================

                    object.Holder.Position =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            math.floor(x),
                            math.floor(y)
                        )

                    object.Holder.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            math.max(
                                1,
                                math.floor(width)
                            ),
                            math.max(
                                1,
                                math.floor(height)
                            )
                        )

                    object.Holder.Visible = true

                    --==========================================================
                    -- 2D BOX
                    --==========================================================

                    object.Box.Visible =
                        Config.BoxESP

                    if Config.BoxESP then

                        UpdateBox(
                            object,
                            width,
                            height
                        )
                    end

                    --==========================================================
                    -- HEALTH
                    --==========================================================

                    object.HealthOutline.Visible =
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Visual.ESPHealth

                    if RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Visual.ESPHealth then

                        local healthWidth =
                            Config.HealthWidthNear +
                            (
                                Config.HealthWidthFar -
                                Config.HealthWidthNear
                            ) * alpha

                        healthWidth =
                            math.clamp(
                                math.floor(
                                    healthWidth + 0.5
                                ),
                                Config.HealthWidthFar,
                                Config.HealthWidthNear
                            )

                        local gap =
                            Config.HealthGapNear +
                            (
                                Config.HealthGapFar -
                                Config.HealthGapNear
                            ) * alpha

                        gap =
                            math.max(
                                Config.HealthGapFar,
                                math.floor(gap + 0.5)
                            )

                        local totalWidth =
                            healthWidth +
                            Config.HealthOutline * 2

                        object.HealthOutline.Size =
                            UDim2.fromOffset(
                                totalWidth,
                                math.max(
                                    1,
                                    math.floor(height)
                                )
                            )

                        object.HealthOutline.Position =
                            UDim2.new(
                                0,
                                -(
                                    totalWidth +
                                    gap
                                ),
                                0,
                                0
                            )

                        object.HealthBack.Position =
                            UDim2.fromOffset(
                                Config.HealthOutline,
                                Config.HealthOutline
                            )

                        object.HealthBack.Size =
                            UDim2.new(
                                1,
                                -Config.HealthOutline * 2,
                                1,
                                -Config.HealthOutline * 2
                            )

                        local maxHealth =
                            math.max(
                                humanoid.MaxHealth,
                                1
                            )

                        local ratio =
                            math.clamp(
                                humanoid.Health /
                                    maxHealth,
                                0,
                                1
                            )

                        object.Health.Size =
                            UDim2.new(
                                1,
                                0,
                                ratio,
                                0
                            )

                        object.Health.BackgroundColor3 =
                            Config.HealthLowColor:Lerp(
                                Config.HealthFullColor,
                                ratio
                            )
                    end

                    --==========================================================
                    -- NAME
                    --==========================================================

                    object.Name.Visible =
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Visual.ESPName

                    object.Name.Text =
                        player.DisplayName

                    object.Name.Font =
                        Enum.Font.GothamMedium

                    object.Name.TextSize =
                        math.floor(
                            Config.NameSizeNear +
                            (
                                Config.NameSizeFar -
                                Config.NameSizeNear
                            ) * alpha
                        )

                    object.Name.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            math.max(
                                50,
                                math.floor(width * 2)
                            ),
                            18
                        )

                    --==========================================================
                    -- DISTANCE
                    --==========================================================

                    object.Distance.Visible =
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Visual.ESPDistance

                    object.Distance.Text =
                        math.floor(distance) ..
                        "m"

                    object.Distance.Font =
                        Enum.Font.GothamMedium

                    object.Distance.TextSize =
                        math.floor(
                            Config.DistanceSizeNear +
                            (
                                Config.DistanceSizeFar -
                                Config.DistanceSizeNear
                            ) * alpha
                        )

                    object.Distance.Size =
                        UDim2.fromOffset(
                            math.max(
                                45,
                                math.floor(width * 1.5)
                            ),
                            16
                        )
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- INITIAL PLAYERS
                --==============================================================

                for _, player in ipairs(
                    Players:GetPlayers()
                ) do

                    if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                        CreateESP(player)
                    end
                end

                --==============================================================
                -- PLAYER ADDED
                --==============================================================

                RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Connect(Players.PlayerAdded, 
                    function(player)

                        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                            CreateESP(player)
                        end
                    end
                )

                --==============================================================
                -- PLAYER REMOVING
                --==============================================================

                RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, 
                    function(player)

                        RemoveESP(player)
                    end
                )

                --==============================================================
                -- RENDER LOOP
                --==============================================================

                RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Connect(RunService.RenderStepped, 
                    function()

                        local camera =
                            workspace.CurrentCamera

                        if not camera then
                            return
                        end

                        for player, object in pairs(ESP) do

                            if player.Parent ~= Players then

                                RemoveESP(player)

                            else

                                UpdateESP(
                                    player,
                                    object,
                                    camera
                                )
                            end
                        end
                    end
                )
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.StartCrosshair()
                    -- ================= Crosshair =================
                    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
                    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
                    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
                    local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

                    local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("MiniHubCrosshair")
                    if old then old:Destroy() end

                    local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
                    screenGui.Name = "MiniHubCrosshair"
                    screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
                    screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
                    screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
                    screenGui.Parent = playerGui

                    local container = Instance.new("Frame")
                    container.Name = "CrosshairContainer"
                    container.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                    container.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
                    container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    container.Parent = screenGui

                    local lines = {}
                    local numLines = 4
                    local baseDistance = 20
                    local baseLength = 18
                    local baseThickness = 2

                    for i = 1, numLines do
                        local line = Instance.new("Frame")
                        line.Name = "Line" .. i
                        line.Size = UDim2.new(0, baseThickness, 0, baseLength)
                        line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                        line.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                        line.BorderSizePixel = 0

                        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                        stroke.Thickness = 1
                        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                        stroke.Parent = line

                        line.Parent = container
                        table.insert(lines, line)
                    end

                    local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    textLabel.Name = "CrosshairText"
                    textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 30)
                    textLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
                    textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 24)
                    textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Arcade
                    textLabel.Text = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Crosshair.Name
                    textLabel.TextSize = 18.5
                    textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    textLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
                    textLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                    textLabel.Parent = container

                    local tickTime = 0
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function(dt)
                        if not screenGui.Parent then return end

                        local cfg = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Crosshair
                        screenGui.Enabled = cfg.Enabled

                        tickTime += dt
                        local hue = (tickTime * 0.4) % 1
                        local rainbowColor = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)

                        local scale = math.clamp(tonumber(cfg.Scale) or 1, 0.5, 2.5)
                        local sizeSine = math.sin(tickTime * 3)
                        local currentDistance = math.max(13 * scale, baseDistance * scale + (sizeSine * 7 * scale))
                        local currentLength = math.max(11 * scale, baseLength * scale + (sizeSine * 6 * scale))
                        local currentThickness = math.max(1, math.floor(baseThickness * scale + 0.5))
                        local currentTextSize = math.max(10, 18.5 * scale)
                        local spinRotation = (tickTime * 140) + (math.sin(tickTime * 2) * 30)

                        for i = 1, numLines do
                            local angle = (i - 1) * (360 / numLines) + spinRotation
                            local rad = math.rad(angle)
                            local x = math.cos(rad) * currentDistance
                            local y = math.sin(rad) * currentDistance
                            local line = lines[i]
                            line.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
                            line.Size = UDim2.new(0, currentThickness, 0, currentLength)
                            line.Rotation = angle + 90
                            line.BackgroundColor3 = rainbowColor
                        end

                        textLabel.Text = tostring(cfg.Name or "")
                        textLabel.TextSize = currentTextSize
                        textLabel.TextColor3 = rainbowColor
                    end)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Ensure(name)
                local support = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport
                if support.Started[name] then
                    return
                end
                support.Started[name] = true
                task.spawn(function()
                    local ok = pcall(support['Start' .. name])
                    if not ok then
                        support.Started[name] = false
                        pcall(function()
                            Library:Notify({ Title = 'Mini Hub', Description = name .. ' could not start.', Time = 3 })
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.SetEspStyle(style)
                local support = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport
                support.Visual.CornerEnabled = style == 'Corner Brackets'
                support.Visual.Box2DEnabled = style == '2D Box'
                if style == 'Corner Brackets' then
                    support.Ensure('Corner')
                elseif style == '2D Box' then
                    support.Ensure('Box2D')
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Destroy()
                local support = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport
                support.Visual.CornerEnabled = false
                support.Visual.Box2DEnabled = false
                support.Crosshair.Enabled = false
                for _, connection in ipairs(support.Signals) do
                    pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
                end
                table.clear(support.Signals)
                table.clear(support.Started)
                pcall(function()
                    local playerGui = LP:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui')
                    if playerGui then
                        for _, guiName in ipairs({ 'MiniHub_CornerESP', 'MiniHub_2DBoxESP', 'MiniHubCrosshair' }) do
                            local gui = playerGui:FindFirstChild(guiName)
                            if gui then gui:Destroy() end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.Movement.Destroy()
                local movement = RivalsRuntimeBridge.Movement
                movement.SetNoclipEnabled(false)
                movement.ClearNoclipCharacter()
                movement.DestroyFlight()
                if movement.WalkSpeedHookLoaded and movement.WalkSpeedHookGetter
                    and movement.WalkSpeedHookUpvalueIndex ~= nil and movement.WalkSpeedHookOldUpvalue ~= nil then
                    pcall(debug.setupvalue, movement.WalkSpeedHookGetter,
                        movement.WalkSpeedHookUpvalueIndex, movement.WalkSpeedHookOldUpvalue)
                end
                movement.WalkSpeedHookLoaded = false
                movement.WalkSpeedHookGetter = nil
                movement.WalkSpeedHookUpvalueIndex = nil
                movement.WalkSpeedHookOldUpvalue = nil
                movement.WalkMultiplierEnabled = false
                movement.SlidingMultiplierEnabled = false
                -- Kicia's JumpPower Destroy [91454] flags the hook destroyed; the proxies restore
                -- their original upvalues lazily on the next read instead of being torn down here.
                movement.JumpPowerHookDestroyed = true
                movement.JumpPowerHookLoaded = false
                movement.JumpPowerEnabled = false
                movement.MechanicsController = nil
                movement.PlayerModule = nil
                movement.Character = nil
                movement.Humanoid = nil
                movement.RootPart = nil
                movement.LongJumpPressed = false
            end

            -- Device Spoof: direct 1:1 port of Kicia's DeviceSpoof [17425]. Replaces the
            -- ControlsController upvalue inside FighterController._ReplicateControls with a proxy
            -- that only answers CurrentControls (kicking any other read, exactly like Kicia) and
            -- returns the spoofed device string. The game's own replication then reports that
            -- device to the server.
            RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof = {
                Hook = nil,
                Controller = nil,
                -- Kicia's frozen control map [104716]: dropdown key -> replicated Controls value.
                ControlsMap = {
                    Desktop = 'MouseKeyboard',
                    Mobile = 'Touch',
                    Console = 'Gamepad',
                    VR = 'VR',
                },
            }

            -- Kept as a bridge method (not a top-scope local) so it costs no register against
            -- Luau's 200-local ceiling on the RIVALS entry scope.
            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof.ResolveControlsController()
                local spoof = RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof
                if spoof.Controller then
                    return spoof.Controller
                end
                if not ReplicatedStateReady then
                    BeginReplicatedStateBoot()
                    return nil
                end
                local playerScripts = LP:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
                local controllers = playerScripts and playerScripts:FindFirstChild('Controllers')
                local module = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild('ControlsController')
                if not module then
                    return nil
                end
                local ok, controller = pcall(require, module)
                if ok and type(controller) == 'table' then
                    spoof.Controller = controller
                end
                return spoof.Controller
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof.ReadEnabled()
                return Toggles and Toggles.P10S7T1 and Toggles.P10S7T1.Value == true
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof.ReadSpoofType()
                local option = Options and Options.P10S7D1
                local value = option and option.Value
                return type(value) == 'string' and value or 'VR'
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof.ResolveReplicateControls()
                local fighterController = ResolveFighterController()
                if type(fighterController) ~= 'table' then
                    return nil, nil
                end
                local metatable = getmetatable(fighterController)
                local classIndex = type(metatable) == 'table' and rawget(metatable, '__index') or nil
                local replicateControls = type(classIndex) == 'table'
                    and rawget(classIndex, '_ReplicateControls') or nil
                if type(replicateControls) ~= 'function' then
                    return nil, fighterController
                end
                return replicateControls, fighterController
            end

            -- Kicia's f1277: re-run the game's own _ReplicateControls so the (now spoofed, or on
            -- unload restored) device is pushed to the server immediately instead of on the next
            -- organic replication.
            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof.ForceReplicate()
                local replicateControls, fighterController =
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof.ResolveReplicateControls()
                if replicateControls and fighterController then
                    pcall(replicateControls, fighterController)
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof.AttemptLoadHook()
                local spoof = RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof
                if spoof.Hook then
                    return true
                end
                if type(debug.getupvalues) ~= 'function' or type(debug.setupvalue) ~= 'function' then
                    return false
                end
                local controlsController = spoof.ResolveControlsController()
                if type(controlsController) ~= 'table' then
                    return false
                end
                local replicateControls = spoof.ResolveReplicateControls()
                if type(replicateControls) ~= 'function' then
                    return false
                end
                local upvalueIndex
                for index, value in pairs(debug.getupvalues(replicateControls)) do
                    if value == controlsController then
                        upvalueIndex = index
                        break
                    end
                end
                if upvalueIndex == nil then
                    return false
                end
                local originalValue = debug.getupvalue(replicateControls, upvalueIndex)
                -- Kicia's injection [17552]: swap the ControlsController upvalue for a proxy that
                -- only serves CurrentControls and keeps both of Kicia's kick guards verbatim.
                debug.setupvalue(replicateControls, upvalueIndex, setmetatable({}, {
                    __index = function(_, key)
                        if key ~= 'CurrentControls' then
                            LP:Kick('Unexpected behavior (client misc 2)')
                            return nil
                        end
                        local value = spoof.ControlsMap[spoof.ReadSpoofType()]
                        if value == nil then
                            LP:Kick('Unexpected behavior (client misc 1)')
                        end
                        return value
                    end,
                }))
                spoof.Hook = {
                    Getter = replicateControls,
                    UpvalueIndex = upvalueIndex,
                    OriginalValue = originalValue,
                }
                return true
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof.AttemptUnloadHook()
                local spoof = RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof
                local hook = spoof.Hook
                if not hook then
                    return
                end
                spoof.Hook = nil
                pcall(debug.setupvalue, hook.Getter, hook.UpvalueIndex, hook.OriginalValue)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof.RefreshAll()
                local spoof = RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof
                if spoof.ReadEnabled() then
                    -- Support notice only -- AttemptLoadHook already declines cleanly.
                    __kicia_hook_genv.KiciaHookCaps.gate('Device Spoof', 'debug.getupvalues', 'debug.setupvalue')
                    if spoof.AttemptLoadHook() then
                        spoof.ForceReplicate()
                    end
                elseif spoof.Hook then
                    spoof.AttemptUnloadHook()
                    spoof.ForceReplicate()
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof.Destroy()
                local spoof = RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof
                if spoof.Hook then
                    spoof.AttemptUnloadHook()
                    spoof.ForceReplicate()
                end
            end

            -- Player Spoofer: 1:1 port of Kicia's player_spoofer. This slice is the AttributeSink
            -- [31428] with its exact attribute binder [108644] and player registry [116985]. It
            -- writes spoofed nametag/stat attributes onto the Player instance, captures the
            -- original, re-asserts under an is-writing guard whenever the game overwrites the
            -- attribute, and restores the original on teardown. Scope (You vs Others) is chosen
            -- per player. Live-verified: these attributes exist on Player instances and are
            -- client-writable. 'const' fields write Kicia's fixed value when enabled
            -- (Influencer/RobloxEmployee true, NosniyTeam GroupRank 255); 'value' fields write the
            -- configured value.
            RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer = {
                Binders = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' }),
                LifecycleConnections = {},
                Started = false,
                Scopes = { 'You', 'Oth' },
                AttributeFields = {
                    { key = 'Winstreak', attribute = 'StatisticDuelsWinStreak', control = 'number',
                        youDefault = '999', othDefault = '0' },
                    { key = 'Level', attribute = 'Level', control = 'number',
                        youDefault = '999', othDefault = '0' },
                    { key = 'RankedElo', attribute = 'DisplayELO', control = 'number',
                        youDefault = '3600', othDefault = '0' },
                    { key = 'NametagStatus', attribute = 'PlayerStatus', control = 'text',
                        youDefault = 'Prime', othDefault = 'Prime' },
                    { key = 'Influencer', attribute = 'IsInfluencer', control = 'const', constValue = true },
                    { key = 'RobloxEmployee', attribute = 'IsRobloxEmployee', control = 'const', constValue = true },
                    { key = 'NosniyTeam', attribute = 'GroupRank', control = 'const', constValue = 255 },
                },
            }

            -- Kicia's attribute binder t78 [108648]: capture the original, re-assert the spoof
            -- whenever the game changes the attribute (guarded so our own write does not recurse),
            -- and restore on destroy.
            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.CreateBinder(instance, attribute)
                local binder = {
                    Instance = instance,
                    Attribute = attribute,
                    Original = instance:GetAttribute(attribute),
                    IsWriting = false,
                    Spoofed = nil,
                    Connection = nil,
                }
                binder.Connection = instance:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
                    if binder.IsWriting then
                        return
                    end
                    binder.Original = instance:GetAttribute(attribute)
                    binder.IsWriting = true
                    if binder.Spoofed ~= nil then
                        instance:SetAttribute(attribute, binder.Spoofed.value)
                    end
                    binder.IsWriting = false
                end)
                return binder
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.BinderSet(binder, spoofed)
                binder.Spoofed = spoofed
                binder.IsWriting = true
                if spoofed == nil then
                    binder.Instance:SetAttribute(binder.Attribute, binder.Original)
                else
                    binder.Instance:SetAttribute(binder.Attribute, spoofed.value)
                end
                binder.IsWriting = false
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.BinderDestroy(binder)
                if binder.Connection then
                    binder.Connection:Disconnect()
                end
                pcall(function()
                    binder.Instance:SetAttribute(binder.Attribute, binder.Original)
                end)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.Bind(player, attribute)
                local spoofer = RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer
                local entries = spoofer.Binders[player]
                if entries == nil then
                    entries = {}
                    spoofer.Binders[player] = entries
                end
                local binder = entries[attribute]
                if binder == nil then
                    binder = spoofer.CreateBinder(player, attribute)
                    entries[attribute] = binder
                end
                return binder
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.Unbind(player, attribute)
                local spoofer = RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer
                local entries = spoofer.Binders[player]
                if entries == nil then
                    return
                end
                local binder = entries[attribute]
                if binder ~= nil then
                    spoofer.BinderDestroy(binder)
                    entries[attribute] = nil
                end
            end

            -- Kicia _SetValue/_SetConst [31490]: bind + write when enabled, unbind (restore) when not.
            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.SetAttributeSpoof(player, attribute, enabled, value)
                local spoofer = RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer
                if enabled then
                    spoofer.BinderSet(spoofer.Bind(player, attribute), { value = value })
                else
                    spoofer.Unbind(player, attribute)
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.ScopeSuffix(player)
                return player == LP and 'You' or 'Oth'
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.ReadToggle(optionId)
                return Toggles and Toggles[optionId] and Toggles[optionId].Value == true
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.ReadOption(optionId)
                local option = Options and Options[optionId]
                return option and option.Value
            end

            -- Kicia AttributeSink _Apply [31479]: per player, for each field write the spoof (or
            -- clear it) according to that scope's toggle and value.
            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.Apply(player)
                local spoofer = RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer
                if not player or player.Parent == nil then
                    return
                end
                local suffix = spoofer.ScopeSuffix(player)
                for _, field in ipairs(spoofer.AttributeFields) do
                    local enabled = spoofer.ReadToggle('PSpoof' .. suffix .. field.key .. 'T')
                    if field.control == 'const' then
                        spoofer.SetAttributeSpoof(player, field.attribute, enabled, field.constValue)
                    else
                        local raw = spoofer.ReadOption('PSpoof' .. suffix .. field.key .. 'V')
                        local value = raw
                        if field.control == 'number' then
                            value = tonumber(raw)
                        elseif type(raw) == 'string' and raw == '' then
                            value = nil
                        end
                        spoofer.SetAttributeSpoof(player, field.attribute, enabled and value ~= nil, value)
                    end
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.Cleanup(player)
                local spoofer = RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer
                local entries = spoofer.Binders[player]
                if entries == nil then
                    return
                end
                for _, binder in pairs(entries) do
                    spoofer.BinderDestroy(binder)
                end
                spoofer.Binders[player] = nil
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.RefreshAll()
                local spoofer = RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer
                spoofer.Start()
                for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    spoofer.Apply(player)
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.Start()
                local spoofer = RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer
                if spoofer.Started then
                    return
                end
                spoofer.Started = true
                spoofer.LifecycleConnections[#spoofer.LifecycleConnections + 1] =
                    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('PlayerSpoofer_PlayerAdded', function(player)
                        spoofer.Apply(player)
                    end))
                spoofer.LifecycleConnections[#spoofer.LifecycleConnections + 1] =
                    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('PlayerSpoofer_PlayerRemoving', function(player)
                        spoofer.Cleanup(player)
                    end))
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.Destroy()
                local spoofer = RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer
                for _, connection in ipairs(spoofer.LifecycleConnections) do
                    pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
                end
                spoofer.LifecycleConnections = {}
                spoofer.Started = false
                for player in pairs(spoofer.Binders) do
                    spoofer.Cleanup(player)
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.ResolveSelection()
                local option = Options and Options.P10S6D1
                local value = option and option.Value
                if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil, nil end
                if value == 'Custom' then
                    local custom = Options and Options.P10S6I1
                    local id = custom and tostring(custom.Value or ''):match('%d+')
                    return id, value
                end
                return RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.Emotes[value], value
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.Stop()
                local player = RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer
                player.ReplayToken += 1
                if player.Track then
                    pcall(player.Track.Stop, player.Track, 0.1)
                    pcall(player.Track.Destroy, player.Track)
                end
                player.Track = nil
                player.Animator = nil
                if player.CurrentAnimation then
                    pcall(player.CurrentAnimation.Destroy, player.CurrentAnimation)
                end
                player.CurrentAnimation = nil
            end

            local function loadYokaiCatalogEmote(humanoid, animator, id)
                local description = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass('HumanoidDescription')
                if not description then return nil end
                local emoteName = 'LionAnimationPlayer'
                local captured
                local connection
                local okConn = pcall(function()
                    connection = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
                        captured = track
                    end)
                end)
                if not okConn or not connection then return nil end

                local ok = pcall(function()
                    pcall(description.RemoveEmote, description, emoteName)
                    description:AddEmote(emoteName, tonumber(id))
                    humanoid:PlayEmote(emoteName)
                end)

                local timeout = os.clock() + 2
                while ok and not captured and os.clock() < timeout do
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
                pcall(connection.Disconnect, connection)
                return captured
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.Apply()
                local player = RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer
                player.Stop()
                if not player.ReadEnabled() then return end

                local character = LP.Character
                local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                if not humanoid then return end
                local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass('Animator')
                if not animator then return end
                local id, selected = player.ResolveSelection()
                if not id or id == '' then return end

                local track
                local animation

                if selected == 'Custom' or selected == 'Floss Dance' or selected == 'Orange Justice' or selected == 'JUMP Dance' then
                    -- The three original Mini Hub dances are direct animation assets.
                    -- Loading them directly removes the old HumanoidDescription capture
                    -- delay that could make the dance take seconds to start.
                    animation = Instance.new('Animation')
                    animation.AnimationId = 'rbxassetid://' .. id
                    local ok
                    ok, track = pcall(animator.LoadAnimation, animator, animation)
                    if not ok then track = nil end
                else
                    track = loadYokaiCatalogEmote(humanoid, animator, id)
                    if not track then
                        animation = Instance.new('Animation')
                        animation.AnimationId = 'rbxassetid://' .. id
                        local ok
                        ok, track = pcall(animator.LoadAnimation, animator, animation)
                        if not ok then track = nil end
                    end
                end

                if not track then
                    if animation then pcall(animation.Destroy, animation) end
                    return
                end

                player.Character = character
                player.Humanoid = humanoid
                player.Animator = animator
                player.CurrentAnimation = animation
                player.Track = track
                player.LastReplay = os.clock()

                pcall(function() track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4 end)
                pcall(function() track.Looped = true end)
                pcall(track.Play, track, 0.03, 1, player.ReadSpeed())

                local token = player.ReplayToken
                task.spawn(function()
                    while token == player.ReplayToken and player.Track == track and player.ReadEnabled() do
                        local length = track.Length
                        local startPercent = math.clamp(player.ReadStart(), 0, 99)
                        local endPercent = math.clamp(player.ReadEnd(), 1, 100)
                        if endPercent <= startPercent then endPercent = math.min(100, startPercent + 1) end
                        if length and length > 0 then
                            local startTime = length * startPercent / 100
                            local endTime = length * endPercent / 100
                            if track.TimePosition < startTime or track.TimePosition >= endTime then
                                pcall(function() track.TimePosition = startTime end)
                            end
                        end
                        if not track.IsPlaying then
                            pcall(track.Play, track, 0.05, 1, player.ReadSpeed())
                        end
                        pcall(track.AdjustSpeed, track, player.ReadSpeed())
                        pcall(track.AdjustWeight, track, 1, 0)
                        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                    end
                end)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.AdjustSpeed()
                local player = RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer
                if player.Track then pcall(player.Track.AdjustSpeed, player.Track, player.ReadSpeed()) end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.RefreshAll()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.Apply()
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.Update()
                local player = RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer
                local character = LP.Character
                local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                if character ~= player.Character or humanoid ~= player.Humanoid then
                    player.Stop()
                    player.Character = character
                    player.Humanoid = humanoid
                    if player.ReadEnabled() then task.spawn(player.Apply) end
                    return
                end
                if player.ReadEnabled() and player.Track and not player.Track.IsPlaying then
                    task.spawn(player.Apply)
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.Destroy()
                local player = RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer
                player.Stop()
                if player.CharacterConnection then pcall(player.CharacterConnection.Disconnect, player.CharacterConnection) end
                if player.RemovingConnection then pcall(player.RemovingConnection.Disconnect, player.RemovingConnection) end
                player.CharacterConnection = nil
                player.RemovingConnection = nil
                player.Character = nil
                player.Humanoid = nil
            end

            RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.CharacterConnection = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild('Humanoid', 10)
                    if not humanoid then return end
                    humanoid:WaitForChild('Animator', 10)
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    if LP.Character == character and RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.ReadEnabled() then
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.Apply()
                    end
                end)
            end)

            RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.RemovingConnection = LP.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
                if LP.Character == character then RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.Stop() end
            end)
            RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder = {
                SavePath = 'KiciaHook/RIVALS Movement Recordings.json',
                Version = 1,
                Mode = 'Idle',
                PendingKind = nil,
                Recording = nil,
                Replay = nil,
                LastRecording = nil,
                RecordsByName = {},
                RecordsByMap = {},
                PersistenceLoaded = false,
                RefreshingOptions = false,
                InputConnections = {},
                PlayerControls = nil,
                InputLibrary = nil,
                MechanicsController = nil,
                RoundActive = nil,
                RoundToken = nil,
                RoundBindingPending = false,
                RoundBindingGeneration = 0,
                WaypointDirty = true,
                WaypointMapName = nil,
                WaypointMapModel = nil,
                WaypointAnchor = nil,
                Markers = {},
                Routes = {},
                SelectedRecording = nil,
                ActivatedRecording = nil,
            }

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.ReadToggle(optionId)
                return Toggles and Toggles[optionId] and Toggles[optionId].Value == true
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.ReadNumber(optionId, fallback)
                local option = Options and Options[optionId]
                return option and type(option.Value) == 'number' and option.Value or fallback
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.Notify(message)
                local recorder = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder
                if recorder.ReadToggle('P10S4T3') then
                    return
                end
                if Library and type(Library.Notify) == 'function' then
                    Library:Notify({Title = 'Movement Recorder', Description = message, Time = 3})
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.SetToggle(optionId, value)
                local toggle = Toggles and Toggles[optionId]
                if not toggle or toggle.Value == value or type(toggle.SetValue) ~= 'function' then
                    return
                end
                task.defer(function()
                    if Toggles and Toggles[optionId] == toggle and toggle.Value ~= value then
                        toggle:SetValue(value)
                    end
                end)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.EncodeVector3(value)
                return {value.X, value.Y, value.Z}
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.DecodeVector3(value)
                if type(value) ~= 'table' then
                    return nil
                end
                local x, y, z = tonumber(value[1]), tonumber(value[2]), tonumber(value[3])
                if not x or not y or not z then
                    return nil
                end
                return Vector3.new(x, y, z)
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.EncodeCFrame(value)
                return {value:GetComponents()}
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.DecodeCFrame(value)
                if type(value) ~= 'table' or #value ~= 12 then
                    return nil
                end
                local components = table.create(12)
                for index = 1, 12 do
                    components[index] = tonumber(value[index])
                    if components[index] == nil then
                        return nil
                    end
                end
                return CFrame.new(table.unpack(components))
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.EncodeAction(action)
                local encoded = {kind = action.kind}
                if action.kind == 'Move' then
                    encoded.direction = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.EncodeVector3(action.direction)
                elseif action.kind == 'Look' then
                    encoded.cframe = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.EncodeCFrame(action.cframe)
                elseif action.kind == 'Equip' then
                    encoded.index = action.index
                elseif action.kind == 'ItemInput' then
                    encoded.inputType = action.inputType
                elseif action.kind == 'QuickAttack' then
                    encoded.attackType = action.attackType
                elseif action.kind == 'Crouch' then
                    encoded.crouching = action.crouching == true
                end
                return encoded
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.DecodeAction(action)
                if type(action) ~= 'table' or type(action.kind) ~= 'string' then
                    return nil
                end
                local decoded = {kind = action.kind}
                if action.kind == 'Move' then
                    decoded.direction = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.DecodeVector3(action.direction)
                    return decoded.direction and decoded or nil
                elseif action.kind == 'Look' then
                    decoded.cframe = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.DecodeCFrame(action.cframe)
                    return decoded.cframe and decoded or nil
                elseif action.kind == 'Equip' then
                    decoded.index = tonumber(action.index)
                    return decoded.index and decoded or nil
                elseif action.kind == 'ItemInput' then
                    decoded.inputType = type(action.inputType) == 'string' and action.inputType or nil
                    return decoded.inputType and decoded or nil
                elseif action.kind == 'QuickAttack' then
                    decoded.attackType = type(action.attackType) == 'string' and action.attackType or nil
                    return decoded.attackType and decoded or nil
                elseif action.kind == 'Crouch' then
                    decoded.crouching = action.crouching == true
                elseif action.kind ~= 'Jump' and action.kind ~= 'Slide' then
                    return nil
                end
                return decoded
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.EncodeRecording(recording)
                local encoded = {
                    mapName = recording.mapName,
                    startCFrame = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.EncodeCFrame(recording.startCFrame),
                    displayPosition = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.EncodeVector3(recording.displayPosition),
                    startEquippedIndex = recording.startEquippedIndex,
                    startEquipCooldown = recording.startEquipCooldown,
                    loadoutRequirements = {},
                    keypoints = {},
                    positions = {},
                }
                for itemName in pairs(recording.loadoutRequirements or {}) do
                    encoded.loadoutRequirements[#encoded.loadoutRequirements + 1] = itemName
                end
                table.sort(encoded.loadoutRequirements)
                for _, keypoint in ipairs(recording.keypoints or {}) do
                    encoded.keypoints[#encoded.keypoints + 1] = {
                        offset = keypoint.offset,
                        action = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.EncodeAction(keypoint.action),
                    }
                end
                for _, position in ipairs(recording.positions or {}) do
                    encoded.positions[#encoded.positions + 1] = {
                        offset = position.offset,
                        position = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.EncodeVector3(position.position),
                    }
                end
                return encoded
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.DecodeRecording(encoded)
                if type(encoded) ~= 'table' or type(encoded.mapName) ~= 'string' then
                    return nil
                end
                local recording = {
                    mapName = encoded.mapName,
                    startCFrame = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.DecodeCFrame(encoded.startCFrame),
                    displayPosition = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.DecodeVector3(encoded.displayPosition),
                    startEquippedIndex = tonumber(encoded.startEquippedIndex),
                    startEquipCooldown = tonumber(encoded.startEquipCooldown),
                    loadoutRequirements = {},
                    keypoints = {},
                    positions = {},
                }
                if not recording.startCFrame or not recording.displayPosition then
                    return nil
                end
                for _, itemName in ipairs(type(encoded.loadoutRequirements) == 'table'
                    and encoded.loadoutRequirements or {}) do
                    if type(itemName) == 'string' and itemName ~= '' then
                        recording.loadoutRequirements[itemName] = true
                    end
                end
                for _, keypoint in ipairs(type(encoded.keypoints) == 'table' and encoded.keypoints or {}) do
                    local action = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.DecodeAction(keypoint.action)
                    local offset = tonumber(keypoint.offset)
                    if action and offset then
                        recording.keypoints[#recording.keypoints + 1] = {offset = offset, action = action}
                    end
                end
                for _, position in ipairs(type(encoded.positions) == 'table' and encoded.positions or {}) do
                    local value = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.DecodeVector3(position.position)
                    local offset = tonumber(position.offset)
                    if value and offset then
                        recording.positions[#recording.positions + 1] = {offset = offset, position = value}
                    end
                end
                if #recording.keypoints == 0 then
                    return nil
                end
                table.sort(recording.keypoints, function(left, right) return left.offset < right.offset end)
                table.sort(recording.positions, function(left, right) return left.offset < right.offset end)
                return recording
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.ReindexRecordings()
                local recorder = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder
                recorder.RecordsByMap = {}
                for name, recording in pairs(recorder.RecordsByName) do
                    recording.name = name
                    local names = recorder.RecordsByMap[recording.mapName]
                    if not names then
                        names = {}
                        recorder.RecordsByMap[recording.mapName] = names
                    end
                    names[#names + 1] = name
                end
                for _, names in pairs(recorder.RecordsByMap) do
                    table.sort(names)
                end
                recorder.WaypointDirty = true
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.LoadPersistence()
                local recorder = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder
                if recorder.PersistenceLoaded then
                    return
                end
                recorder.PersistenceLoaded = true
                recorder.RecordsByName = {}
                if type(isfile) == 'function' and isfile(recorder.SavePath) then
                    local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
                        return game:GetService('HttpService'):JSONDecode(readfile(recorder.SavePath))
                    end)
                    if ok and type(decoded) == 'table' and decoded.version == recorder.Version
                        and type(decoded.recordings) == 'table' then
                        for name, encoded in pairs(decoded.recordings) do
                            local recording = type(name) == 'string' and recorder.DecodeRecording(encoded) or nil
                            if recording then
                                recorder.RecordsByName[name] = recording
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                recorder.ReindexRecordings()
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.WritePersistence()
                local recorder = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder
                if type(writefile) ~= 'function' then
                    return false
                end
                local encoded = {}
                for name, recording in pairs(recorder.RecordsByName) do
                    encoded[name] = recorder.EncodeRecording(recording)
                end
                local ok = pcall(function()
                    if type(makefolder) == 'function' and type(isfolder) == 'function'
                        and not isfolder('KiciaHook') then
                        makefolder('KiciaHook')
                    end
                    writefile(recorder.SavePath, game:GetService('HttpService'):JSONEncode({
                        version = recorder.Version,
                        recordings = encoded,
                    }))
                end)
                return ok
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.GetMapNames()
                local recorder = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder
                recorder.LoadPersistence()
                local maps = {}
                for mapName in pairs(recorder.RecordsByMap) do
                    maps[#maps + 1] = mapName
                end
                table.sort(maps)
                return maps
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.GetRecordingNames(mapName)
                local recorder = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder
                recorder.LoadPersistence()
                return table.clone(recorder.RecordsByMap[mapName] or {})
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.RefreshRecordingOptions()
                local recorder = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder
                if recorder.RefreshingOptions then
                    return
                end
                local mapOption = Options and Options.P10S4D1
                local recordingOption = Options and Options.P10S4D2
                if not mapOption or not recordingOption then
                    return
                end
                recorder.RefreshingOptions = true
                local maps = recorder.GetMapNames()
                local currentMap = mapOption.Value
                if type(mapOption.SetValues) == 'function' then
                    mapOption:SetValues(maps)
                end
                if type(currentMap) ~= 'string' or table.find(maps, currentMap) == nil then
                    currentMap = maps[1]
                    if type(mapOption.SetValue) == 'function' then
                        mapOption:SetValue(currentMap)
                    end
                end
                local names = recorder.GetRecordingNames(currentMap)
                local selectedName = recordingOption.Value
                if type(recordingOption.SetValues) == 'function' then
                    recordingOption:SetValues(names)
                end
                if type(selectedName) ~= 'string' or table.find(names, selectedName) == nil then
                    if type(recordingOption.SetValue) == 'function' then
                        recordingOption:SetValue(names[1])
                    end
                end
                recorder.RefreshingOptions = false
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.SaveLastRecording(name)
                local recorder = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder
                recorder.LoadPersistence()
                name = type(name) == 'string' and name:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$') or ''
                if name == '' then
                    recorder.Notify('Enter a recording name first')
                    return false
                end
                if not recorder.LastRecording then
                    recorder.Notify('No recording to save')
                    return false
                end
                local previous = recorder.RecordsByName[name]
                recorder.RecordsByName[name] = recorder.LastRecording
                recorder.ReindexRecordings()
                if not recorder.WritePersistence() then
                    recorder.RecordsByName[name] = previous
                    recorder.ReindexRecordings()
                    recorder.Notify('Failed to save recording')
                    return false
                end
                recorder.LastRecording = nil
                recorder.RefreshRecordingOptions()
                recorder.Notify('Recording saved')
                return true
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.DeleteRecording(name)
                local recorder = RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder
                recorder.LoadPersistence()
                if type(name) ~= 'string' or name == '' or not recorder.RecordsByName[name] then
                    recorder.Notify('Select a recording to delete')
                    return false
                end
                local previous = recorder.RecordsByName[name]
                recorder.RecordsByName[name] = nil
                recorder.ReindexRecordings()
                if not recorder.WritePersistence() then
                    recorder.RecordsByName[name] = previous
                    recorder.ReindexRecordings()
                    recorder.Notify('Failed to delete recording')
                    return false
                end
                recorder.RefreshRecordingOptions()
                recorder.Notify('Recording deleted')
                return true
            end

            function RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.ResolveMapContext()
                local character = LP.Character
                local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') or nil
                local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') or nil
                if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not rootPart then
                    return nil
                end
                local environmentId = character:GetAttribute('EnvironmentID')
                if environmentId == nil then
                    local fighter = ResolveLocalFighter()
                    local data = type(fighter) == 'table' and rawget(fighter, 'Data') or nil
                    environmentId = type(data) == 'table' and rawget(data, 'EnvironmentID') or nil
                end
                if environmentId == nil then
