                if state.ReadyNotified then
                    return
                end
                state.ReadyNotified = true
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.LogDiagnosticEvent('Ready', 'Loaded -- ready to fight (' .. tostring(source) .. ')')
            end

            RivalsRuntimeBridge.IsLocalReadyToFight = function()
                if not IsAimbotGameReady() then
                    return false
                end

                local duel = FighterDataCache.LocalDuel
                if duel and duel.Seeded and duel.IsInShootingRange == true then
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.NotifyLocalReadyOnce('shooting range')
                    return true
                end

                local state = RivalsRuntimeBridge.LocalReadyState
                if state.ShieldSeen then
                    return true
                end

                local fighter = ResolveLocalFighter()
                if not fighter then
                    return false
                end

                -- Pre-seeded shooting-range path: AttachLocalDuelWatchers (which
                -- sets duel.Seeded=true) runs from per-spawn setup AFTER
                -- WaitForLocalReady returns, but WaitForLocalReady polls THIS
                -- function. In the shooting range there's no spawn shield, so
                -- without this branch the gate never opens until 30s timeout
                -- or the user enters a duel (which triggers the shield, which
                -- causes AttachLocalDuelWatchers to fire). Sync-read the same
                -- field the cache would have read.
                if type(fighter.Data) == 'table' and fighter.Data.IsInShootingRange == true then
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.NotifyLocalReadyOnce('shooting range (sync)')
                    return true
                end

                if state.LastSeenFighter ~= fighter then
                    state.LastSeenFighter = fighter
                end

                -- Direct sync read of the entity's Data first. Covers the case
                -- where the FighterDataCache.Track signal hadn't connected yet
                -- when IsInvincible flipped so the cache missed the transition
                -- window but the flag is still up at this poll.
                local entity = fighter.Entity
                if entity and type(entity.Data) == 'table' and entity.Data.IsInvincible == true then
                    state.ShieldSeen = true
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.NotifyLocalReadyOnce('spawn shield')
                    return true
                end

                -- Signal-driven cache as a backup path.
                if FighterDataCache.Cache[fighter] == true then
                    state.ShieldSeen = true
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.NotifyLocalReadyOnce('spawn shield (cache)')
                    return true
                end

                -- Kicia parity (mid-life execute): adopt the CURRENT life once at
                -- script start when the game itself says it is live -- entity in
                -- world with an item equipped, the same evidence Kicia's
                -- HasEquippedGun gate runs on. Without this, executing after your
                -- spawn shield expired held every aim feature dark until the next
                -- respawn. One-shot: ResetLocalShieldLatch closes the window on
                -- any new-life event, so respawns keep the proven shield latch.
                if state.InitialLifeAdoptionOpen then
                    if type(entity) == 'table' and rawget(entity, '_is_in_world') == true
                        and rawget(fighter, 'EquippedItem') ~= nil then
                        state.InitialLifeAdoptionOpen = false
                        state.ShieldSeen = true
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.NotifyLocalReadyOnce('mid-life adopt (equipped item)')
                        return true
                    end
                end

                return false
            end

            RivalsRuntimeBridge.WaitForLocalReady = function(timeoutSec)
                local deadline = timeoutSec and (tick() + timeoutSec) or nil
                while not RivalsRuntimeBridge.IsLocalReadyToFight() do
                    if deadline and tick() > deadline then
                        return false
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end
                return true
            end

            -- Subscribe to FighterController.ObjectAdded once. RIVALS creates
            -- a fresh Fighter object per-player-per-match; mid-match deaths
            -- and respawns reuse the same Fighter (just create new Entities
            -- via fighter.EntityAdded). So a new local Fighter being added is
            -- the deterministic, game-state-authoritative signal that a new
            -- match has started -- no time-gap heuristics required. Resets
            -- the initial-spawn cooldown so the new match gets the same
            -- protective wait that the first match after script load gets.
            RivalsRuntimeBridge.EnsureMatchBoundaryDetection = function()
                if RivalsRuntimeBridge.MatchBoundaryDetectionInstalled then
                    return
                end

                local controller = ResolveFighterController()
                if not controller then
                    return
                end

                local addedSignal = controller.ObjectAdded
                if type(addedSignal) ~= 'table' or type(addedSignal.Connect) ~= 'function' then
                    return
                end

                local ok, conn = pcall(function()
                    return addedSignal:Connect(function(newFighter)
                        if type(newFighter) ~= 'table' then
                            return
                        end
                        local isLocal = newFighter.IsLocalPlayer == true
                            or rawget(newFighter, 'Player') == LP
                        if not isLocal then
                            return
                        end
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.InitialSpawnCooldownComplete = false
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.ResetLocalShieldLatch()
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.LogDiagnosticEvent(
                            'MatchBoundary',
                            'New local fighter detected; readiness latch reset'
                        )
                        if RivalsRuntimeBridge.RunPickupSpawnSetup then
                            RivalsRuntimeBridge.RunPickupSpawnSetup()
                        end
                    end)
                end)

                if ok and conn then
                    if Library and type(Library.GiveSignal) == 'function' then
                        pcall(function() Library:GiveSignal(conn) end)
                    end
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.MatchBoundaryDetectionInstalled = true
                    if controller.LocalFighter and RivalsRuntimeBridge.RunPickupSpawnSetup then
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.RunPickupSpawnSetup()
                    end
                end
            end

            RivalsRuntimeBridge.LogDiagnosticEvent = function(scope, message)
                if not (Toggles.P9S3T1 and Toggles.P9S3T1.Value == true) then
                    return
                end

                local now = tick()
                local key = tostring(scope) .. '|' .. tostring(message)
                local state = RivalsRuntimeBridge.DiagnosticLogState
                local last = state.LastByMessage[key]
                if last and (now - last) < state.ThrottleSeconds then
                    return
                end
                state.LastByMessage[key] = now

                if Library and type(Library.Notify) == 'function' then
                    pcall(function()
                        Library:Notify({
                            Title = 'Character Loading Check',
                            Description = string.format('[%s] %s', tostring(scope), tostring(message)),
                            Time = 3,
                        })
                    end)
                end
            end

            RivalsRuntimeBridge.RecordCharacterLoadingCheckpoint = function(featureName, isReady, isEnabled)
                local state = RivalsRuntimeBridge.CharacterLoadingState
                local wasReady = state[featureName] == true
                state[featureName] = isReady

                if not isReady or not isEnabled or wasReady then
                    return
                end

                if not (Toggles.P9S3T1 and Toggles.P9S3T1.Value == true) then
                    return
                end

                if Library and type(Library.Notify) == 'function' then
                    pcall(function()
                        Library:Notify({
                            Title = 'Character Loading Check',
                            Description = featureName .. ' ready',
                            Time = 3,
                        })
                    end)
                end
            end

            RivalsRuntimeBridge.IsReadyToFight = function()
                if not IsAimbotCameraReady() then
                    return false
                end
                if not IsAimbotGameReady() then
                    return false
                end
                local fighter = ResolveLocalFighter()
                local entity = fighter and fighter.Entity
                if type(entity) == 'table' and rawget(entity, '_is_in_world') ~= true then
                    return false
                end

                -- NOTE (LRN-20260427-003): Do not add a `LP.Character.Parent
                -- == Workspace` check here. RIVALS parents live characters
                -- in a sub-folder of Workspace during normal matches, so a
                -- strict direct-parent check returns false during 100% of
                -- real play (verified with diagnostic: CharInWS=N while
                -- EntityInWorld/ShieldSeen/LocalReady=Y and locks succeed).
                -- The other gates above and below already cover viewport
                -- preview rigs and post-death states. If a HurtEffect-class
                -- transient ever surfaces, use IsDescendantOf(Workspace) or
                -- an explicit bad-parent blacklist -- never direct-parent.

                -- Lazy-install the match-boundary detector. Idempotent and
                -- cheap (just a flag check) once installed. We try here in
                -- case Initialize-time install missed because the
                -- FighterController wasn't ready yet.
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.EnsureMatchBoundaryDetection()

                -- C: spawn-shield latch (or shooting-range fallback). The
                -- game's IsInvincible flag flipping true is the authoritative
                -- "your character is loaded and the round is live" signal --
                -- replaces the prior 2s CharacterChangedAt heuristic which
                -- was a guess at when the camera controller had finished
                -- re-binding. Shooting range never grants a shield, so
                -- IsLocalReadyToFight falls through to its IsInShootingRange
                -- branch there.
                if not RivalsRuntimeBridge.IsLocalReadyToFight() then
                    return false
                end

                return true
            end

            RivalsRuntimeBridge.AcquireActiveCharacter = function()
                if not RivalsRuntimeBridge.IsReadyToFight() then
                    return nil
                end
                if LP.Character ~= Char then
                    return nil
                end
                if not HumanoidRootPart or HumanoidRootPart.Parent ~= Char then
                    return nil
                end
                return Char, HumanoidRootPart, Humanoid
            end
            end

            local TWO_PI = math.pi * 2

            function RivalsRagebot.IsEnabled()
                return Toggles.P8S4T1 and Toggles.P8S4T1.Value == true
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.IsRespawnEnabled()
                return Toggles.P8S4T2 and Toggles.P8S4T2.Value == true
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.ResolveWeaponRanges()
                local equipped = AimbotBridge.ResolveAimbotEquippedItem()
                local name = equipped and equipped.Name or nil
                if RivalsRagebotState.CachedRanges and name == RivalsRagebotState.LastWeaponName then
                    return RivalsRagebotState.CachedRanges
                end
                local equippedInfo = equipped and equipped.Info or nil
                local equippedIsMelee = equippedInfo and (equippedInfo.Class == 'Melee' or equippedInfo.Type == 'Melee') and true or false
                local ranges
                if name and RivalsRagebot.WeaponRanges[name] then
                    ranges = RivalsRagebot.WeaponRanges[name]
                elseif equippedIsMelee then
                    ranges = { In = MeleeFastFire.RagebotStuds, Out = MeleeFastFire.RagebotStuds }
                else
                    ranges = { In = RivalsRagebot.RadiusIn, Out = RivalsRagebot.RadiusOut }
                end
                RivalsRagebotState.LastWeaponName = name
                RivalsRagebotState.CachedRanges = ranges
                return ranges
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.ResolveRadius()
                local ranges = RivalsRagebot.ResolveWeaponRanges()
                local toggle = math.floor(tick() * RivalsRagebot.InOutToggleHz) % 2 == 0
                return toggle and ranges.In or ranges.Out
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.ResolveHeightOffset(clockSec)
                local t = clockSec or 0
                return RivalsRagebot.HeightBase + math.sin(2 * math.pi * RivalsRagebot.HeightWobbleRateHz * t) * RivalsRagebot.HeightWobbleAmp
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.ResolveRagebotCFrame(targetRootPart, radius, heightOffset, phaseRad)
                local localOffset = Vector3.new(
                    math.sin(phaseRad) * radius,
                    heightOffset,
                    math.cos(phaseRad) * radius
                )
                local worldPos = targetRootPart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(localOffset)
                return CFrame.lookAt(worldPos, targetRootPart.Position)
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.IsCandidatePositionInBounds(candidatePos, subject)
                local CollectionService = game:GetService('CollectionService')
                local insideSafePart = false
                for _, safe in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged('OutOfBoundsSafePart')) do
                    if safe:IsA('BasePart') then
                        local rel = safe.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(candidatePos)
                        local hx, hy, hz = safe.Size.X * 0.5, safe.Size.Y * 0.5, safe.Size.Z * 0.5
                        if math.abs(rel.X) <= hx and math.abs(rel.Y) <= hy and math.abs(rel.Z) <= hz then
                            insideSafePart = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not insideSafePart then
                    local oobBufferSq = RivalsRagebot.OOBBufferDistance * RivalsRagebot.OOBBufferDistance
                    for _, oob in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged('OutOfBoundsPart')) do
                        if oob:IsA('BasePart') then
                            local rel = oob.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(candidatePos)
                            local hx, hy, hz = oob.Size.X * 0.5, oob.Size.Y * 0.5, oob.Size.Z * 0.5
                            local dx = math.max(math.abs(rel.X) - hx, 0)
                            local dy = math.max(math.abs(rel.Y) - hy, 0)
                            local dz = math.max(math.abs(rel.Z) - hz, 0)
                            if (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) < oobBufferSq then
                                return false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                return true
            end

            local function IsPointInOOBVolume(pos)
                local CollectionService = game:GetService('CollectionService')
                for _, safe in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged('OutOfBoundsSafePart')) do
                    if safe:IsA('BasePart') then
                        local rel = safe.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(pos)
                        local hx, hy, hz = safe.Size.X * 0.5, safe.Size.Y * 0.5, safe.Size.Z * 0.5
                        if math.abs(rel.X) <= hx and math.abs(rel.Y) <= hy and math.abs(rel.Z) <= hz then
                            return false
                        end
                    end
                end
                for _, oob in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged('OutOfBoundsPart')) do
                    if oob:IsA('BasePart') then
                        local rel = oob.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(pos)
                        local hx, hy, hz = oob.Size.X * 0.5, oob.Size.Y * 0.5, oob.Size.Z * 0.5
                        if math.abs(rel.X) <= hx and math.abs(rel.Y) <= hy and math.abs(rel.Z) <= hz then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
                return false
            end

            local function GetOOBPartAt(pos)
                local CollectionService = game:GetService('CollectionService')
                for _, safe in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged('OutOfBoundsSafePart')) do
                    if safe:IsA('BasePart') then
                        local rel = safe.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(pos)
                        local hx, hy, hz = safe.Size.X * 0.5, safe.Size.Y * 0.5, safe.Size.Z * 0.5
                        if math.abs(rel.X) <= hx and math.abs(rel.Y) <= hy and math.abs(rel.Z) <= hz then
                            return nil
                        end
                    end
                end
                for _, oob in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged('OutOfBoundsPart')) do
                    if oob:IsA('BasePart') then
                        local rel = oob.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(pos)
                        local hx, hy, hz = oob.Size.X * 0.5, oob.Size.Y * 0.5, oob.Size.Z * 0.5
                        if math.abs(rel.X) <= hx and math.abs(rel.Y) <= hy and math.abs(rel.Z) <= hz then
                            return oob
                        end
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end

            local KILL_SEAT_SAMPLE_DIRECTIONS = (function()
                local d = {}
                local axes = {
                    Vector3.new( 1,  0,  0), Vector3.new(-1,  0,  0),
                    Vector3.new( 0,  1,  0), Vector3.new( 0, -1,  0),
                    Vector3.new( 0,  0,  1), Vector3.new( 0,  0, -1),
                    Vector3.new( 1,  1,  0), Vector3.new( 1, -1,  0),
                    Vector3.new(-1,  1,  0), Vector3.new(-1, -1,  0),
                    Vector3.new( 1,  0,  1), Vector3.new( 1,  0, -1),
                    Vector3.new(-1,  0,  1), Vector3.new(-1,  0, -1),
                    Vector3.new( 0,  1,  1), Vector3.new( 0,  1, -1),
                    Vector3.new( 0, -1,  1), Vector3.new( 0, -1, -1),
                    Vector3.new( 1,  1,  1), Vector3.new( 1,  1, -1),
                    Vector3.new( 1, -1,  1), Vector3.new( 1, -1, -1),
                    Vector3.new(-1,  1,  1), Vector3.new(-1,  1, -1),
                    Vector3.new(-1, -1,  1), Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1),
                }
                for _, v in ipairs(axes) do d[#d + 1] = v.Unit end
                return d
            end)()

            local KILL_SEAT_AXIS_OFFSETS = {
                Vector3.new( 1,  0,  0), Vector3.new(-1,  0,  0),
                Vector3.new( 0,  1,  0), Vector3.new( 0, -1,  0),
                Vector3.new( 0,  0,  1), Vector3.new( 0,  0, -1),
                Vector3.new( 1,  1,  0), Vector3.new( 1, -1,  0),
                Vector3.new(-1,  1,  0), Vector3.new(-1, -1,  0),
                Vector3.new( 1,  0,  1), Vector3.new( 1,  0, -1),
                Vector3.new(-1,  0,  1), Vector3.new(-1,  0, -1),
                Vector3.new( 0,  1,  1), Vector3.new( 0,  1, -1),
                Vector3.new( 0, -1,  1), Vector3.new( 0, -1, -1),
                Vector3.new( 1,  1,  1), Vector3.new( 1,  1, -1),
                Vector3.new( 1, -1,  1), Vector3.new( 1, -1, -1),
                Vector3.new(-1,  1,  1), Vector3.new(-1,  1, -1),
                Vector3.new(-1, -1,  1), Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1),
            }

            local KILL_SEAT_REFINE_LATTICE = (function()
                local lattice = {}
                for x = -1, 1 do
                    for y = -1, 1 do
                        for z = -1, 1 do
                            if not (x == 0 and y == 0 and z == 0) then
                                lattice[#lattice + 1] = Vector3.new(x, y, z)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                return lattice
            end)()

            function RivalsRagebot.ScoreSeatPosition(pos)
                if IsPointInOOBVolume(pos) then return -1 end
                local distinctParts = {}
                local distinctCount = 0
                local hitCount = 0
                local cardinalHits = 0
                local rayLen = RivalsRagebot.KillSeatScoreRayLength
                for _, dir in ipairs(KILL_SEAT_SAMPLE_DIRECTIONS) do
                    local samplePos = pos + dir * rayLen
                    local hitPart = GetOOBPartAt(samplePos)
                    if hitPart then
                        hitCount = hitCount + 1
                        if not distinctParts[hitPart] then
                            distinctParts[hitPart] = true
                            distinctCount = distinctCount + 1
                        end
                        if (math.abs(dir.X) + math.abs(dir.Y) + math.abs(dir.Z)) < 1.05 then
                            cardinalHits = cardinalHits + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
                if hitCount == 0 then return 0 end
                return cardinalHits * 10000 + distinctCount * 1000 + hitCount
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.RefineKillSeatPosition(seatPos)
                local step = RivalsRagebot.KillSeatRefineStep or 1.0
                local bestPos = seatPos
                local bestScore = RivalsRagebot.ScoreSeatPosition(seatPos)
                for _, offset in ipairs(KILL_SEAT_REFINE_LATTICE) do
                    local candidatePos = seatPos + offset * step
                    local s = RivalsRagebot.ScoreSeatPosition(candidatePos)
                    if s > bestScore then
                        bestScore = s
                        bestPos = candidatePos
                    end
                end
                return bestPos
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.BuildKillSeats(force)
                local now = tick()
                if not force
                    and RivalsRagebotState.KillSeats
                    and (now - RivalsRagebotState.KillSeatsBuiltAt) < RivalsRagebot.KillSeatBuildTtlSec
                then
                    return RivalsRagebotState.KillSeats
                end

                local CollectionService = game:GetService('CollectionService')
                local oobParts = CollectionService:GetTagged('OutOfBoundsPart')
                if not oobParts or #oobParts == 0 then
                    RivalsRagebotState.KillSeats = {}
                    RivalsRagebotState.KillSeatsBuiltAt = now
                    return RivalsRagebotState.KillSeats
                end

                local buffer = RivalsRagebot.KillSeatBufferDistance
                local rayLen = RivalsRagebot.KillSeatScoreRayLength
                local candidates = {}

                for _, oob in ipairs(oobParts) do
                    if oob:IsA('BasePart') then
                        local size = oob.Size
                        local cframe = oob.CFrame
                        local hx, hy, hz = size.X * 0.5, size.Y * 0.5, size.Z * 0.5
                        for _, axis in ipairs(KILL_SEAT_AXIS_OFFSETS) do
                            local localOffset = Vector3.new(
                                axis.X * (hx + buffer),
                                axis.Y * (hy + buffer),
                                axis.Z * (hz + buffer)
                            )
                            local seatPos = cframe:PointToWorldSpace(localOffset)
                            if not IsPointInOOBVolume(seatPos) then
                                local distinctParts = {}
                                local distinctCount = 0
                                local hitCount = 0
                                local cardinalHits = 0
                                local openSum = Vector3.zero
                                for _, dir in ipairs(KILL_SEAT_SAMPLE_DIRECTIONS) do
                                    local samplePos = seatPos + dir * rayLen
                                    local hitPart = GetOOBPartAt(samplePos)
                                    if hitPart then
                                        hitCount = hitCount + 1
                                        if not distinctParts[hitPart] then
                                            distinctParts[hitPart] = true
                                            distinctCount = distinctCount + 1
                                        end
                                        if (math.abs(dir.X) + math.abs(dir.Y) + math.abs(dir.Z)) < 1.05 then
                                            cardinalHits = cardinalHits + 1
                                        end
                                    else
                                        openSum = openSum + dir
                                    end
                                end
                                if hitCount > 0 then
                                    local openDir = (openSum.Magnitude > 0.001) and openSum.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
                                    table.insert(candidates, {
                                        Position = seatPos,
                                        Score = cardinalHits * 10000 + distinctCount * 1000 + hitCount,
                                        CardinalHits = cardinalHits,
                                        DistinctParts = distinctCount,
                                        HitCount = hitCount,
                                        OpenDirection = openDir,
                                    })
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
                    return a.Score > b.Score
                end)

                local maxKept = RivalsRagebot.KillSeatMaxKept
                if maxKept and #candidates > maxKept then
                    for i = #candidates, maxKept + 1, -1 do
                        candidates[i] = nil
                    end
                end

                RivalsRagebotState.KillSeats = candidates
                RivalsRagebotState.KillSeatsBuiltAt = now
                return candidates
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.PickKillSeatNearestTarget(referencePos)
                local now = tick()
                if RivalsRagebotState.CurrentKillSeat
                    and (now - RivalsRagebotState.LastKillSeatPickAt) < RivalsRagebot.KillSeatRefreshIntervalSec
                then
                    return RivalsRagebotState.CurrentKillSeat
                end

                local seats = RivalsRagebot.BuildKillSeats(false)
                if not seats or #seats == 0 then
                    RivalsRagebotState.CurrentKillSeat = nil
                    RivalsRagebotState.LastKillSeatPickAt = now
                    return nil
                end

                local bestSeat = nil
                local bestComposite = math.huge
                local distanceWeight = RivalsRagebot.KillSeatScoreDistanceWeight
                for _, seat in ipairs(seats) do
                    local dist = referencePos and (seat.Position - referencePos).Magnitude or 0
                    local composite = -seat.Score + dist * distanceWeight
                    if composite < bestComposite then
                        bestComposite = composite
                        bestSeat = seat
                    end
                end

                local picked = nil
                if bestSeat then
                    if not bestSeat.RefinedPosition then
                        bestSeat.RefinedPosition = RivalsRagebot.RefineKillSeatPosition(bestSeat.Position)
                    end
                    picked = bestSeat.RefinedPosition
                end
                RivalsRagebotState.CurrentKillSeat = picked
                RivalsRagebotState.LastKillSeatPickAt = now
                return picked
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.IsBaitModeEnabled()
                return Toggles.P8S4T3 and Toggles.P8S4T3.Value == true
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.UpdateHostileTeleportTracker(now)
                local minDt = RivalsRagebot.HostileTrackerSampleMinDt
                if (now - (RivalsRagebotState.LastHostileTrackerSampleAt or 0)) < minDt then
                    return
                end
                RivalsRagebotState.LastHostileTrackerSampleAt = now

                local hostileTeleports = RivalsRagebotState.HostileTeleports
                local fighters = LocalFighterController and LocalFighterController.Objects or {}
                for _, fighter in ipairs(fighters) do
                    local player = fighter and fighter.Player
                    if player and player ~= LP and player.Parent == Players and RivalsRagebot.IsCombatTarget(player) then
                        local char = player.Character
                        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                        if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                            local entry = hostileTeleports[player]
                            if not entry then
                                entry = { LastPos = hrp.Position, LastCheckedAt = now, Teleports = {}, Offsets = {} }
                            end
                            hostileTeleports[player] = entry
                            entry.SeenAt = now

                            local dt = now - entry.LastCheckedAt
                            if dt >= minDt then
                                local dist = (hrp.Position - entry.LastPos).Magnitude
                                if dist > RivalsRagebot.HostileTeleportDeltaStuds and (dist / dt) > RivalsRagebot.HostileTeleportMinSpeed then
                                    table.insert(entry.Teleports, now)
                                    local localChar = LP and LP.Character
                                    local localHrp = localChar and localChar:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                                    if localHrp then
                                        table.insert(entry.Offsets, { Time = now, Offset = hrp.Position - localHrp.Position })
                                    end
                                end
                                entry.LastPos = hrp.Position
                                entry.LastCheckedAt = now
                            end

                            local windowSec = RivalsRagebot.HostileTeleportWindowSec
                            for index = #entry.Teleports, 1, -1 do
                                if (now - entry.Teleports[index]) >= windowSec then
                                    table.remove(entry.Teleports, index)
                                end
                            end
                            for index = #entry.Offsets, 1, -1 do
                                if (now - entry.Offsets[index].Time) >= windowSec then
                                    table.remove(entry.Offsets, index)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                for player, entry in pairs(hostileTeleports) do
                    if entry.SeenAt ~= now then
                        hostileTeleports[player] = nil
                    end
                end
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.IsHostileCheating()
                local minCount = RivalsRagebot.HostileTeleportMinCount
                local hostileTeleports = RivalsRagebotState.HostileTeleports
                if not hostileTeleports then
                    return false
                end
                for _, entry in pairs(hostileTeleports) do
                    if entry.Teleports and #entry.Teleports >= minCount then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.GetMostActiveCheater()
                local hostileTeleports = RivalsRagebotState.HostileTeleports
                if not hostileTeleports then return nil end
                local bestPlayer, bestCount = nil, 0
                for player, entry in pairs(hostileTeleports) do
                    local count = entry.Teleports and #entry.Teleports or 0
                    if count > bestCount then
                        bestCount = count
                        bestPlayer = player
                    end
                end
                return bestPlayer, bestCount
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.GetCheaterOffsetPrediction(player)
                local entry = player and RivalsRagebotState.HostileTeleports and RivalsRagebotState.HostileTeleports[player]
                if not entry or not entry.Offsets then return nil end
                local samples = RivalsRagebot.BaitTrapOffsetSamples
                local minSamples = RivalsRagebot.BaitTrapMinSamples
                local total = #entry.Offsets
                if total < minSamples then return nil end
                local startIdx = math.max(1, total - samples + 1)
                local sum = Vector3.zero
                local count = 0
                for i = startIdx, total do
                    sum = sum + entry.Offsets[i].Offset
                    count = count + 1
                end
                if count == 0 then return nil end
                return sum / count
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.FindBaitTrapPosition(predictedOffset)
                if not predictedOffset then return nil end
                local seats = RivalsRagebot.BuildKillSeats(false)
                if not seats or #seats == 0 then return nil end
                local localChar = LP and LP.Character
                local localHrp = localChar and localChar:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                local refPos = localHrp and localHrp.Position or nil
                local maxDist = RivalsRagebot.BaitTrapMaxCandidateDist
                local bestSeat, bestComposite = nil, math.huge
                for _, seat in ipairs(seats) do
                    if seat.Position then
                        local landingPos = seat.Position + predictedOffset
                        if IsPointInOOBVolume(landingPos) then
                            local dist = refPos and (seat.Position - refPos).Magnitude or 0
                            if not refPos or dist <= maxDist then
                                local composite = dist - (seat.Score * 0.0001)
                                if composite < bestComposite then
                                    bestComposite = composite
                                    bestSeat = seat
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not bestSeat then return nil end
                if not bestSeat.RefinedPosition then
                    bestSeat.RefinedPosition = RivalsRagebot.RefineKillSeatPosition(bestSeat.Position)
                end
                return bestSeat.RefinedPosition or bestSeat.Position
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.PivotToBaitTrapOrSnug()
                local now = tick()
                if RivalsRagebotState.LastBaitTrapPos
                    and (now - (RivalsRagebotState.LastBaitTrapPickAt or 0)) < RivalsRagebot.BaitTrapHysteresisSec
                then
                    local activeChar = RivalsRuntimeBridge.AcquireActiveCharacter()
                    if activeChar then
                        local cur = activeChar:GetPivot()
                        activeChar:PivotTo(CFrame.new(RivalsRagebotState.LastBaitTrapPos) * (cur - cur.Position))
                        return true
                    end
                end

                local cheater = RivalsRagebot.GetMostActiveCheater()
                local predicted = cheater and RivalsRagebot.GetCheaterOffsetPrediction(cheater) or nil
                local trapPos = predicted and RivalsRagebot.FindBaitTrapPosition(predicted) or nil

                if not trapPos then
                    -- Snug-lock fallback: highest-scored seat (seats are pre-sorted descending by Score).
                    local seats = RivalsRagebot.BuildKillSeats(false)
                    if seats and #seats > 0 then
                        local snug = seats[1]
                        if not snug.RefinedPosition then
                            snug.RefinedPosition = RivalsRagebot.RefineKillSeatPosition(snug.Position)
                        end
                        trapPos = snug.RefinedPosition or snug.Position
                    end
                end

                if not trapPos then return false end
                RivalsRagebotState.LastBaitTrapPos = trapPos
                RivalsRagebotState.LastBaitTrapPickAt = now

                local activeChar = RivalsRuntimeBridge.AcquireActiveCharacter()
                if not activeChar then return false end
                local cur = activeChar:GetPivot()
                activeChar:PivotTo(CFrame.new(trapPos) * (cur - cur.Position))
                return true
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.ResolveRespawnRemote()
                local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('Remotes')
                local duels = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('Duels')
                local respawnNow = duels and duels:FindFirstChild('RespawnNow')
                if respawnNow and respawnNow:IsA('RemoteEvent') then
                    return respawnNow
                end
                return nil
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.TryRespawn()
                if not RivalsRagebot.IsRespawnEnabled() then
                    return false
                end

                local now = tick()
                if (now - RivalsRagebotState.LastRespawnRequestAt) < RivalsRagebot.RespawnRequestInterval then
                    return false
                end

                local respawnNow = RivalsRagebot.ResolveRespawnRemote()
                if not respawnNow then
                    return false
                end

                RivalsRagebotState.LastRespawnRequestAt = now
                task.spawn(GuardRivalsCallback('AutoRespawn_Burst', function()
                    for requestIndex = 1, RivalsRagebot.RespawnBurstCount do
                        safe_fire_server(respawnNow)
                        if requestIndex < RivalsRagebot.RespawnBurstCount then
                            task.wait(RivalsRagebot.RespawnBurstDelay)
                        end
                    end
                end))
                return true
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.QueueRespawn()
                task.defer(function()
                    RivalsRagebot.TryRespawn()
                end)
            end

            -- Kicia parity: Auto Respawn triggers on the replicated respawn-animation event
            -- for the local player, not on the death prompt appearing. Their handler is
            -- exactly `enumName == "RespawnNowAnimation" and args[1] == LocalPlayer`, then
            -- the bounded five-request burst. The event is upstream of the button, so it
            -- fires earlier and does not depend on the MainGui hierarchy rendering at all.
            function RivalsRagebot.RegisterRespawnSignals()
                local binding = RivalsRagebotState.RespawnBinding
                if not binding then
                    binding = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ReplicateHook.Reserve({ 'RespawnNowAnimation' })
                    if not binding then
                        return
                    end
                    binding:SetHandler(function(packet)
                        if packet.enumName ~= 'RespawnNowAnimation' or packet.args[1] ~= LP then
                            return
                        end
                        RivalsRagebot.QueueRespawn()
                    end)
                    RivalsRagebotState.RespawnBinding = binding
                end
                binding:SetEnabled(RivalsRagebot.IsRespawnEnabled())
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.ReplicateHook.RevertIfIdle()
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.IsCombatTarget(player)
                return IsPlayerInLocalEnvironment(player)
            end

            local SHIELD_CLAMP_RAD = math.rad(45)

            local function ResolveRagebotPriorityRank(player, fighter, rootPart)
                local priority = RivalsRagebotState.Priority
                if not priority.Active then
                    return 3
                end
                if priority.Player and player == priority.Player then
                    return 0
                end

                if not priority.Auto then
                    return 3
                end

                local rank = 3
                if priority.Voided and rootPart and rootPart.Position.Magnitude > 1000000 then
                    rank = math.min(rank, 1)
                end

                if priority.Attackers then
                    local weaponName
                    pcall(function()
                        weaponName = ResolveRivalsFighterEquippedItemName(fighter)
                    end)
                    if type(weaponName) == 'string' and weaponName ~= '' then
                        rank = math.min(rank, 2)
                    end
                end

                return rank
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.ResolveTarget(rawPhase)
                EnsureAimbotTargetTracking()

                local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not camera then
                    return nil
                end

                local mousePosition = Vector2.new(camera.ViewportSize.X * 0.5, camera.ViewportSize.Y * 0.5)
                local radius = RivalsRagebot.ResolveRadius()
                local heightOffset = RivalsRagebot.ResolveHeightOffset(RivalsRagebotState.PhaseClockSec)
                local observerPosition = HumanoidRootPart and HumanoidRootPart.Position
                local bestTarget = nil
                local bestHoverCFrame = nil
                local bestPriorityRank = math.huge

                for _, fighter in ipairs(LocalFighterController and LocalFighterController.Objects or {}) do
                    local player = fighter and fighter.Player
                    if player and player ~= LP and player.Parent == Players and ShouldShow(player, false) and RivalsRagebot.IsCombatTarget(player) then
                        local entity = fighter.Entity
                        local subject = entity and entity.Model
                        -- Spawn-shield pre-track: ragebot hovers around shielded targets so native
                        -- trigger input can resume as soon as the shield ends.
                        if subject then
                            local targetInfo = RivalsRuntimeBridge.BuildAimbotTargetInfo(subject, 'Players', 'Auto', mousePosition, player, math.huge, nil, true, camera, 'Ragebot', true)
                            if targetInfo then
                                local targetRootPart = subject:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                                if targetRootPart and targetRootPart.Parent then
                                    local effectivePhase = rawPhase or 0
                                    local shieldState = EvaluateRivalsRiotShieldChecker(player, subject or player.Character, observerPosition)
                                    if shieldState and shieldState.IsShieldEquipped == true then
                                        effectivePhase = math.clamp(effectivePhase, -SHIELD_CLAMP_RAD, SHIELD_CLAMP_RAD)
                                    elseif shieldState and shieldState.HasShieldInLoadout == true then
                                        effectivePhase = math.pi + math.clamp(effectivePhase, -SHIELD_CLAMP_RAD, SHIELD_CLAMP_RAD)
                                    end
                                    local hoverCFrame = RivalsRagebot.ResolveRagebotCFrame(targetRootPart, radius, heightOffset, effectivePhase)
                                    if RivalsRagebot.IsCandidatePositionInBounds(hoverCFrame.Position, subject) then
                                        local clearLine = shieldState and shieldState.IsShieldEquipped == true
                                        if not clearLine then
                                            local rayOrigin = hoverCFrame.Position
                                            local rayDir = targetRootPart.Position - rayOrigin
                                            if rayDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                                                RivalsRagebot.LosRaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Char, subject }
                                                clearLine = not Workspace:Raycast(rayOrigin, rayDir, RivalsRagebot.LosRaycastParams)
                                            end
                                        end
                                        -- Priority first, then world distance. This preserves the
                                        -- existing Ragebot behavior while allowing Main > Mini Rage
                                        -- to force a specific target or prioritize attackers/voided players.
                                        if clearLine then
                                            local priorityRank = ResolveRagebotPriorityRank(player, fighter, targetRootPart)
                                            if (not bestTarget)
                                                or priorityRank < bestPriorityRank
                                                or (priorityRank == bestPriorityRank and targetInfo.worldDistance < bestTarget.worldDistance) then
                                                bestTarget = targetInfo
                                                bestHoverCFrame = hoverCFrame
                                                bestPriorityRank = priorityRank
                                                RivalsRagebotState.LastKnownTargetPos = targetRootPart.Position
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                if bestTarget and RivalsRagebotState.Priority.Active and RivalsRagebotState.Priority.SendNotification then
                    local selectedPlayer = bestTarget.player
                    if selectedPlayer and selectedPlayer ~= RivalsRagebotState.Priority.LastNotifiedPlayer then
                        local now = tick()
                        if now - (RivalsRagebotState.Priority.LastNotificationAt or 0) >= 0.75 then
                            RivalsRagebotState.Priority.LastNotifiedPlayer = selectedPlayer
                            RivalsRagebotState.Priority.LastNotificationAt = now
                            pcall(function()
                                Library:Notify({
                                    Title = 'Mini Rage',
                                    Description = 'Priority target: ' .. tostring(selectedPlayer.Name),
                                    Time = 2,
                                })
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                elseif not bestTarget then
                    RivalsRagebotState.Priority.LastNotifiedPlayer = nil
                end

                return bestTarget, bestHoverCFrame
            end

            function RivalsRagebot.Update(deltaTime)
                local now = tick()
                if RivalsRagebot.IsBaitModeEnabled() then
                    RivalsRagebot.UpdateHostileTeleportTracker(now)
                    if RivalsRagebot.IsHostileCheating() then
                        -- OOB Bait takes over the root this frame; release the Kicia ragebot's
                        -- part-glue/server-CFrame so the two mechanisms do not fight.
                        if RivalsRuntimeBridge.ResetKiciaRagebot then
                            RivalsRuntimeBridge.ResetKiciaRagebot()
                        end
                        local item = AimbotBridge.ResolveAimbotEquippedItem()
                        local shotReady = AimbotBridge.IsShotImmediatelyReady(item)

                        if shotReady then
                            RivalsRagebotState.PhaseClockSec = RivalsRagebotState.PhaseClockSec + (deltaTime or 0)
                            local rawPhase = math.random() * TWO_PI
                            local targetInfo, hoverCFrame = RivalsRagebot.ResolveTarget(rawPhase)
                            if hoverCFrame then
                                RivalsRagebotState.HoldCFrame = hoverCFrame
                                RivalsRagebotState.LastHoldUpdateAt = now
                            end
                            local stale = (now - (RivalsRagebotState.LastHoldUpdateAt or 0)) > RivalsRagebot.HoldCFrameStaleTtlSec
                            local holdCFrame = hoverCFrame or (not stale and RivalsRagebotState.HoldCFrame) or nil
                            if stale then
                                RivalsRagebotState.HoldCFrame = nil
                            end
                            if holdCFrame and not RivalsRagebot.IsCandidatePositionInBounds(holdCFrame.Position, nil) then
                                RivalsRagebotState.HoldCFrame = nil
                                holdCFrame = nil
                            end
                            RivalsRagebotState.Target = targetInfo or nil
                            if holdCFrame then
                                local activeChar = RivalsRuntimeBridge.AcquireActiveCharacter()
                                if activeChar then
                                    local cur = activeChar:GetPivot()
                                    activeChar:PivotTo(CFrame.new(holdCFrame.Position) * (cur - cur.Position))
                                end
                                return
                            end
                        end

                        RivalsRagebotState.Target = nil
                        RivalsRagebotState.HoldCFrame = nil
                        RivalsRagebotState.LastHoldUpdateAt = 0
                        RivalsRagebot.PivotToBaitTrapOrSnug()
                        return
                    end
                end

                local enabled = RivalsRagebot.IsEnabled()
                if not enabled then
                    RivalsRagebotState.Target = nil
                    RivalsRagebotState.HoldCFrame = nil
                    RivalsRagebotState.LastHoldUpdateAt = 0
                    RivalsRagebotState.PhaseClockSec = 0
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.RecordCharacterLoadingCheckpoint('Ragebot', false, false)
                    -- Let the Kicia ragebot settle to its disabled state (release glue, restore FFlags).
                    if RivalsRuntimeBridge.UpdateKiciaRagebot then
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.UpdateKiciaRagebot(deltaTime)
                    end
                    return
                end

                local readyToFight = RivalsRuntimeBridge.IsReadyToFight()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.RecordCharacterLoadingCheckpoint('Ragebot', readyToFight, true)

                -- Kicia ragebot owns the main firing path: a self-contained teleport-to-void
                -- ragebot (root virtualization + hitbox part-glue + direct fighter-remote fire). It
                -- self-gates on readiness/enable and reads all Kicia settings live.
                if RivalsRuntimeBridge.UpdateKiciaRagebot then
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.UpdateKiciaRagebot(deltaTime)
                end
            end

            RivalsRuntimeBridge.UpdateRagebot = RivalsRagebot.Update
            RivalsRuntimeBridge.RegisterAutoRespawnSignals = RivalsRagebot.RegisterRespawnSignals
            end
            -- ============================================================================
            -- Kicia Ragebot (1:1 port).
            --
            -- Self-contained "teleport-to-void" ragebot copied from the Kicia RIVALS script.
            -- Each Heartbeat, while enabled and a valid target exists:
            --   * root virtualization  - HumanoidRootPart server CFrame is decoupled from the
            --     visible CFrame (RenderStep(First) restores the real CFrame; Heartbeat jumps
            --     the root to the chosen server CFrame).
            --   * part glue            - the enemy hitbox is anchored, its WeldConstraint.Part1
            --     nulled, and it is teleported to a fixed far-away void CFrame; the local root's
            --     hidden PhysicsRepRootPart is pointed at it, so the server puts you point-blank
            --     on the target in the void.
            --   * direct fire          - the game's fighter combat remote is fired with a hand-built
            --     payload (spoofed look-angles + the hitbox Instance in slot "\2").
            --   * view-angle desync    - hooks inject a fake CameraRotationRaw so the replicated
            --     camera does not visibly stare at the void.
            --   * evasion              - Off / Random / ProjectileBreaker / Translocate move the
            --     server CFrame around when there is no shootable target.
            --
            -- Wired to the existing P8S4T1 toggle.  OOB Bait Mode (P8S4T3) and Auto Respawn
            -- (P8S4T2) are preserved by RivalsRagebot.Update, which delegates its main branch here.
            -- The block is self-contained (gc-resolved game handles, own enum/remote resolution)
            -- and lives in its own shared module, initialised here via init(ctx): the RIVALS
            -- module passes RivalsRuntimeBridge/Options/Toggles/FighterDataCache by reference,
            -- the respawn-reassigned Char/HumanoidRootPart through live GetChar/GetRoot getters,
            -- and the global environment as Genv, so the kernel stays independent of where it is
            -- emitted.
            --
            -- This port reproduces Kicia's ragebot faithfully, including the parts that are loud:
            -- it resolves and directly fires the fighter combat remote and uses metatable / getgc /
            -- debug surfaces.
            -- ============================================================================
            RequireSharedModule('rivals_ragebot_kernel').init({
                RivalsRuntimeBridge = RivalsRuntimeBridge,
                Options = Options,
                Toggles = Toggles,
                FighterDataCache = FighterDataCache,
                GetChar = function() return Char end,
                GetRoot = function() return HumanoidRootPart end,
                Genv = __kicia_hook_genv,
            })

            do
            local RivalsAutoLoadout = {
                PageNames = {'PickWeapons', 'PickWeaponsList'},
                SlotOrder = {
                    { Name = 'Primary', OptionId = 'P8S5D1', SlotIndex = 1 },
                    { Name = 'Secondary', OptionId = 'P8S5D2', SlotIndex = 2 },
                    { Name = 'Melee', OptionId = 'P8S5D3', SlotIndex = 3 },
                    { Name = 'Utility', OptionId = 'P8S5D4', SlotIndex = 4 },
                },
                OpenRetryDelay = 0.05,
                OpenRetryLimit = 5,
                Unselected = 'Unselected',
                Priorities = {'1', '2', '3'},
                ConfigMetadataId = 'KiciaHook_RivalsAutoLoadoutProfiles',
                Catalog = {},
                LiveValuesBySlot = {},
                ExcludedWeaponNames = {
                    ['MISSING_WEAPON'] = true,
                },
                ExcludedWeaponsBySlot = {
                    Melee = {
                        ['Glast Shard'] = true,
                    },
                    Utility = {
                        ['Elixir'] = true,
                        ['RNG Dice'] = true,
                    },
                },
            }

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.IsEnabled()
                return Toggles.P8S5T1 and Toggles.P8S5T1.Value == true
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveItemLibrary()
                local cachedItemLibrary = RivalsAutoLoadout.Catalog.ItemLibrary
                if cachedItemLibrary then
                    return cachedItemLibrary
                end

                local modules = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('Modules')
                local itemLibraryModule = modules and modules:FindFirstChild('ItemLibrary')
                if not itemLibraryModule then
                    return nil
                end

                local ok, itemLibrary = pcall(require, itemLibraryModule)
                if not ok or type(itemLibrary) ~= 'table' then
                    return nil
                end

                RivalsAutoLoadout.Catalog.ItemLibrary = itemLibrary
                return itemLibrary
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.IsAllowedWeaponName(slotName, weaponName)
                if type(weaponName) ~= 'string' or weaponName == '' then
                    return false
                end
                if RivalsAutoLoadout.ExcludedWeaponNames[weaponName] == true then
                    return false
                end

                local slotExclusions = RivalsAutoLoadout.ExcludedWeaponsBySlot[slotName]
                return not slotExclusions or slotExclusions[weaponName] ~= true
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveSeedWeaponValues(slotName)
                local cacheKey = string.format('SeedWeaponValues_%s', slotName)
                local cachedValues = RivalsAutoLoadout.Catalog[cacheKey]
                if cachedValues then
                    return cachedValues
                end

                local values = {}
                local slotIndex = nil
                for _, slotConfig in ipairs(RivalsAutoLoadout.SlotOrder) do
                    if slotConfig.Name == slotName then
                        slotIndex = slotConfig.SlotIndex
                        break
                    end
                end

                local itemLibrary = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveItemLibrary()
                local slotToClass = itemLibrary and itemLibrary.SlotToClass or nil
                local itemsAlphabetized = itemLibrary and itemLibrary.ItemsAlphabetized or nil
                local items = itemLibrary and itemLibrary.Items or nil
                local classData = type(slotToClass) == 'table' and slotIndex and slotToClass[slotIndex] or nil
                local className = classData and classData.Name or slotName

                if type(itemsAlphabetized) == 'table' and type(items) == 'table' then
                    for _, weaponName in ipairs(itemsAlphabetized) do
                        local weaponData = items[weaponName]
                        if weaponData and weaponData.Class == className and RivalsAutoLoadout.IsAllowedWeaponName(slotName, weaponName) then
                            values[#values + 1] = weaponName
                        end
                    end
                end

                RivalsAutoLoadout.Catalog[cacheKey] = values
                return values
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveWeaponValues(slotName)
                return RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveSeedWeaponValues(slotName)
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveMapValues()
                local cachedValues = RivalsAutoLoadout.Catalog.MapValues
                if cachedValues then
                    return cachedValues
                end

                local values = {}
                local modules = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('Modules')
                local duelLibraryModule = modules and modules:FindFirstChild('DuelLibrary')
                if duelLibraryModule then
                    local ok, duelLibrary = pcall(require, duelLibraryModule)
                    if ok and type(duelLibrary) == 'table' and type(duelLibrary.MapOrder) == 'table' then
                        for _, mapName in ipairs(duelLibrary.MapOrder) do
                            if type(mapName) == 'string' and mapName ~= '' then
                                values[#values + 1] = mapName
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                RivalsAutoLoadout.Catalog.MapValues = values
                return values
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveDefaultWeapons()
                local cachedDefaults = RivalsAutoLoadout.Catalog.DefaultWeapons
                if cachedDefaults then
                    return cachedDefaults
                end

                local defaults = {}
                local modules = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('Modules')
                local constantsModule = modules and modules:FindFirstChild('Constants')
                if constantsModule then
                    local ok, constants = pcall(require, constantsModule)
                    local configuredDefaults = ok and type(constants) == 'table' and constants.DEFAULT_WEAPONS or nil
                    if type(configuredDefaults) == 'table' then
                        for _, slotConfig in ipairs(RivalsAutoLoadout.SlotOrder) do
                            local weaponName = configuredDefaults[slotConfig.SlotIndex]
                                or configuredDefaults[slotConfig.Name]
                            if RivalsAutoLoadout.IsAllowedWeaponName(slotConfig.Name, weaponName) then
                                defaults[slotConfig.Name] = weaponName
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                for _, slotConfig in ipairs(RivalsAutoLoadout.SlotOrder) do
                    if not defaults[slotConfig.Name] then
                        defaults[slotConfig.Name] = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveWeaponValues(slotConfig.Name)[1]
                            or RivalsAutoLoadout.Unselected
                    end
                end

                RivalsAutoLoadout.Catalog.DefaultWeapons = defaults
                return defaults
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveActiveProfileKeys()
                local mapKey = 'Default'
                if Toggles.P8S5T3 and Toggles.P8S5T3.Value == true then
                    local mapOption = Options.P8S5D7
                    if mapOption and type(mapOption.Value) == 'string' and mapOption.Value ~= '' then
                        mapKey = mapOption.Value
                    end
                end

                local priority = '1'
                if Toggles.P8S5T4 and Toggles.P8S5T4.Value == true then
                    local priorityOption = Options.P8S5D8
                    if priorityOption and table.find(RivalsAutoLoadout.Priorities, priorityOption.Value) then
                        priority = priorityOption.Value
                    end
                end

                return mapKey, priority
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveProfile(mapKey, priority, create)
                mapKey = type(mapKey) == 'string' and mapKey ~= '' and mapKey or 'Default'
                priority = table.find(RivalsAutoLoadout.Priorities, priority) and priority or '1'

                local mapProfiles = RivalsAutoLoadoutState.Profiles[mapKey]
                if not mapProfiles and create then
                    mapProfiles = {}
                    RivalsAutoLoadoutState.Profiles[mapKey] = mapProfiles
                end

                local profile = mapProfiles and mapProfiles[priority] or nil
                if not profile and create then
                    profile = {}
                    local defaultWeapons = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveDefaultWeapons()
                    for _, slotConfig in ipairs(RivalsAutoLoadout.SlotOrder) do
                        profile[slotConfig.Name] = mapKey == 'Default' and priority == '1'
                            and defaultWeapons[slotConfig.Name]
                            or RivalsAutoLoadout.Unselected
                    end
                    mapProfiles[priority] = profile
                end

                return profile
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveActiveProfile(create)
                local mapKey, priority = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveActiveProfileKeys()
                return RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveProfile(mapKey, priority, create), mapKey, priority
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.NormalizeSelection(slotConfig, selection, allowUnselected)
                local values = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveWeaponValues(slotConfig.Name)
                if type(selection) == 'string' then
                    if allowUnselected and selection == RivalsAutoLoadout.Unselected then
                        return selection
                    end
                    if table.find(values, selection) then
                        return selection
                    end
                elseif type(selection) == 'table' then
                    for _, weaponName in ipairs(values) do
                        if selection[weaponName] == true or table.find(selection, weaponName) then
                            return weaponName
                        end
                    end
                end

                if allowUnselected then
                    return RivalsAutoLoadout.Unselected
                end
                return RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveDefaultWeapons()[slotConfig.Name]
                    or values[1]
                    or RivalsAutoLoadout.Unselected
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResetState()
                RivalsAutoLoadoutState.HasRunThisOpen = false
                RivalsAutoLoadoutState.OpenNonce = RivalsAutoLoadoutState.OpenNonce + 1
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolvePagesFrame()
                local playerGui = LP:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui')
                local mainGui = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild('MainGui')
                local mainFrame = mainGui and mainGui:FindFirstChild('MainFrame')
                return mainFrame and mainFrame:FindFirstChild('Pages') or nil
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolvePageFrame(pageName)
                if type(pageName) ~= 'string' or pageName == '' then
                    return nil
                end

                local pagesFrame = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolvePagesFrame()
                local pageFrame = pagesFrame and pagesFrame:FindFirstChild(pageName)
                if pageFrame and pageFrame:IsA('GuiObject') then
                    return pageFrame
                end

                return nil
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.IsPageFrameVisible(pageFrame)
                return pageFrame and pageFrame.Visible == true and pageFrame.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and pageFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y > 0
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveSavedSelection(slotConfig)
                if not slotConfig then
                    return nil
                end

                local profile, mapKey, priority = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveActiveProfile(true)
                local allowUnselected = mapKey ~= 'Default' or priority ~= '1'
                local savedSelection = RivalsAutoLoadout.NormalizeSelection(
                    slotConfig,
                    profile[slotConfig.Name],
                    allowUnselected
                )
                profile[slotConfig.Name] = savedSelection
                return savedSelection
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.SyncSavedSelection(slotConfig)
                if not slotConfig then
                    return
                end

                local option = Options[slotConfig.OptionId]
                if not option then
                    return
                end

                local profile, mapKey, priority = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveActiveProfile(true)
                local allowUnselected = mapKey ~= 'Default' or priority ~= '1'
                profile[slotConfig.Name] = RivalsAutoLoadout.NormalizeSelection(
                    slotConfig,
                    option.Value,
                    allowUnselected
                )
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveVisibleSelectionValues(slotConfig, values)
                local savedSelection = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveSavedSelection(slotConfig)
                if table.find(values or {}, savedSelection) then
                    return savedSelection
                end
                return (values or {})[1]
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolvePageController(pageName)
                if type(pageName) ~= 'string' or pageName == '' then
                    return nil
                end

                local cachedPageController = RivalsAutoLoadout.Catalog[pageName]
                if cachedPageController then
                    return cachedPageController
                end

                local playerScripts = LP:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
                local modules = playerScripts and playerScripts:FindFirstChild('Modules')
                local pages = modules and modules:FindFirstChild('Pages')
                local pageModule = pages and pages:FindFirstChild(pageName)
                if not pageModule then
                    return nil
                end

                local ok, pageController = pcall(require, pageModule)
                if not ok or type(pageController) ~= 'table' then
                    return nil
                end

                RivalsAutoLoadout.Catalog[pageName] = pageController
                return pageController
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveOpenPageController()
                for _, pageName in ipairs(RivalsAutoLoadout.PageNames) do
                    local pageFrame = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolvePageFrame(pageName)
                    if RivalsAutoLoadout.IsPageFrameVisible(pageFrame) then
                        local pageController = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolvePageController(pageName)
                        if pageController then
                            return pageName, pageController
                        end
                    end
                end

                return nil, nil
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ReadVisibleWeaponValues(pageController)
                if not pageController then
                    return nil, nil
                end

                local slotConfig = RivalsAutoLoadout.SlotOrder[pageController._current_slot]
                if not slotConfig then
                    return nil, nil
                end

                local listFrame = pageController.List
                local container = listFrame and listFrame:FindFirstChild('Container')
                if not container then
                    return slotConfig, nil
                end

                local orderedValues = {}
                for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                    if child.Name == 'WeaponSlot' and child.Visible ~= false then
                        local button = child:FindFirstChild('Button')
                        local title = button and button:FindFirstChild('Title')
                        local locked = button and button:FindFirstChild('Locked')
                        local banned = button and button:FindFirstChild('Banned')
                        local weaponName = title and title.Text or nil
                        if type(weaponName) == 'string' then
                            weaponName = weaponName:match('^%s*(.-)%s*$')
                        end

                        if RivalsAutoLoadout.IsAllowedWeaponName(slotConfig.Name, weaponName) and (not locked or locked.Visible ~= true) and (not banned or banned.Visible ~= true) then
                            orderedValues[#orderedValues + 1] = {
                                Name = weaponName,
                                Order = child.LayoutOrder,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end

                table.sort(orderedValues, function(left, right)
                    if left.Order == right.Order then
                        return left.Name < right.Name
                    end

                    return left.Order < right.Order
                end)

                local seen = {}
                local values = {}
                for _, entry in ipairs(orderedValues) do
                    if seen[entry.Name] ~= true then
                        seen[entry.Name] = true
                        values[#values + 1] = entry.Name
                    end
                end

                return slotConfig, values
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.RefreshDropdownOption(slotConfig)
                if not slotConfig then
                    return
                end

                local option = Options[slotConfig.OptionId]
                if not option or type(option.SetValues) ~= 'function' then
                    return
                end

                local sourceValues = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveWeaponValues(slotConfig.Name)
                local _, mapKey, priority = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveActiveProfile(true)
                local values = {}
                if mapKey ~= 'Default' or priority ~= '1' then
                    values[#values + 1] = RivalsAutoLoadout.Unselected
                end
                for _, weaponName in ipairs(sourceValues) do
                    values[#values + 1] = weaponName
                end
                local visibleSelectionValue = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveVisibleSelectionValues(slotConfig, values)

                RivalsAutoLoadoutState.RefreshingDropdownValues = RivalsAutoLoadoutState.RefreshingDropdownValues + 1
                pcall(function()
                    option:SetValues(values)
                end)
                if type(option.SetValue) == 'function' then
                    pcall(function()
                        option:SetValue(visibleSelectionValue)
                    end)
                end
                RivalsAutoLoadoutState.RefreshingDropdownValues = RivalsAutoLoadoutState.RefreshingDropdownValues - 1
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.RefreshDropdownOptions()
                for _, slotConfig in ipairs(RivalsAutoLoadout.SlotOrder) do
                    RivalsAutoLoadout.RefreshDropdownOption(slotConfig)
                end
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.CapturePageWeaponValues(pageController)
                local slotConfig, values = RivalsAutoLoadout.ReadVisibleWeaponValues(pageController)
                if not slotConfig or type(values) ~= 'table' or #values <= 0 then
                    return false
                end

                local previousValues = RivalsAutoLoadout.LiveValuesBySlot[slotConfig.Name]
                local hasChanged = type(previousValues) ~= 'table' or #previousValues ~= #values
                if not hasChanged and previousValues then
                    for index, weaponName in ipairs(values) do
                        if previousValues[index] ~= weaponName then
                            hasChanged = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end

                if not hasChanged then
                    return false
                end

                RivalsAutoLoadout.LiveValuesBySlot[slotConfig.Name] = values
                RivalsAutoLoadout.RefreshDropdownOption(slotConfig)
                return true
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.BindChosenSlotInputs(pageName, pageController)
                local chosenWeaponSlots = pageController and pageController._chosen_weapon_slots
                if type(chosenWeaponSlots) ~= 'table' then
                    return
                end

                for slotIndex, chosenSlot in ipairs(chosenWeaponSlots) do
                    local button = chosenSlot and chosenSlot:FindFirstChild('Button')
                    if button and button:IsA('GuiButton') then
                        Connections:register(string.format('AutoLoadout_%s_ChosenSlot_%d', pageName, slotIndex), button.Activated:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback(string.format('AutoLoadout_%s_ChosenSlot_%d', pageName, slotIndex), function()
                            task.defer(function()
                                RivalsAutoLoadout.CapturePageWeaponValues(pageController)
                            end)
                        end)))
                    end
                end
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveSlotSelection(slotConfig)
                if not slotConfig then
                    return nil
                end
                local selectedWeaponName = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveSavedSelection(slotConfig)
                return selectedWeaponName ~= RivalsAutoLoadout.Unselected and selectedWeaponName or nil
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.IsWeaponSelected(slotConfig, weaponName)
                if not slotConfig or type(weaponName) ~= 'string' or weaponName == '' then
                    return false
                end

                local savedSelection = RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveSavedSelection(slotConfig)
                return savedSelection == weaponName
            end

            function RivalsAutoLoadout.ResolveCurrentMapName()
                local playerScripts = LP:FindFirstChild('PlayerScripts')
                local controllers = playerScripts and playerScripts:FindFirstChild('Controllers')
                local duelControllerModule = controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild('DuelController')
                if duelControllerModule and IsReplicatedStateReady() then
                    local ok, duelController = pcall(require, duelControllerModule)
