                RivalsCosmetics.RestoreWorldTripmines()
                for model in pairs(RivalsCosmeticsState.OriginalWrapProperties) do
                    RivalsCosmetics.ApplyWrapToModel(model, nil)
                end

                RivalsCosmeticsState.OriginalWrapProperties = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' })
                if not RivalsEmotes.IsEnabled() then
                    RivalsEmotes.RestoreEquippedEmotes()
                end
                RivalsCosmetics.RestoreWeaponViewModels()
                RivalsCosmetics.RestoreInjectedWeaponData()
                RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingSkinSelectionByWeapon = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingWrapSelectionByWeapon = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingCharmSelectionByWeapon = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingFinisherSelectionByWeapon = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.WorldTripmineEntries = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' })
                RivalsCosmeticsState.WorldTripmineApplyTokens = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' })
                RivalsCosmeticsState.SpawnedWorldCosmeticEntries = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' })
                RivalsCosmeticsState.SpawnedWorldCosmeticApplyTokens = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' })
                RivalsCosmeticsState.SpawnedWorldCosmeticRetagging = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' })
                if not RivalsEmotes.IsEnabled() then
                    RivalsCosmetics.RestorePlayerDataHook()
                    RivalsCosmetics.RestoreNativeUiBindings()
                end
                RivalsCosmetics.RestoreClientViewModelHook()
                RivalsCosmetics.RestoreFinisherHook()
                if not RivalsEmotes.IsEnabled() then
                    RivalsEmotes.RestoreEmoteControllerHook()
                end
                pcall(RivalsCosmetics.RefreshNativeCosmeticsScene)
                return true
            end

            function RivalsCosmetics.ResetState()
                RivalsCosmetics.RestoreAppliedCosmetics()
                RivalsCosmeticsState.PreviewWeaponName = nil
                RivalsCosmeticsState.SelectedEditorWeaponName = nil
                RivalsCosmeticsState.SelectedSkinByWeapon = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.SelectedWrapByWeapon = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.SelectedCharmByWeapon = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.SelectedFinisherByWeapon = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.SelectedWrapInvertedByWeapon = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.StableRandomSelectionByWeapon = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.FavoritedCosmeticsByWeapon = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.OnlyUseFavoritesByWeapon = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.RankCharmOverridesBySeason = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.SelectedRankCharmSeason = nil
                RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingApplyToken = 0
                RivalsCosmeticsState.RuntimeApplyRetryPending = false
                RivalsCosmeticsState.SavedConfigCosmeticObjects = nil
                RivalsCosmeticsState.CosmeticPresetsLoaded = false
                RivalsCosmeticsState.CosmeticPresets = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.CosmeticPresetSettings = {}
                RivalsCosmeticsState.CosmeticPresetAutoLoadApplied = false
                RivalsCosmeticsState.CosmeticPresetSaveToken = RivalsCosmeticsState.CosmeticPresetSaveToken + 1
                RivalsCosmeticsState.ApplyingCosmeticPreset = false
                RivalsCosmeticsState.CosmeticsUiLoaded = false
                RivalsCosmeticsState.CosmeticsUiLoading = false
                RivalsCosmeticsState.CosmeticsConfigName = 'RIVALS Default'
                RivalsCosmeticsState.NativeUnlockedInventory = nil
                RivalsCosmeticsState.NativeFavoritesSeeded = false
                RivalsCosmeticsState.NativeSaveToken = RivalsCosmeticsState.NativeSaveToken + 1
                if RivalsCosmeticsState.PreviewViewportModel then
                    pcall(function()
                        RivalsCosmeticsState.PreviewViewportModel:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
                RivalsCosmeticsState.PreviewViewportModel = nil
                RivalsCosmeticsState.BoundFirstPersonModels = false
            end

            function RivalsCosmetics.ApplyAll()
                if not RivalsCosmetics.ShouldUseCosmeticsRuntime() then
                    return false
                end

                pcall(RivalsCosmetics.EnsurePlayerDataHook)
                pcall(RivalsCosmetics.BuildNativeUnlockedInventory)
                pcall(RivalsCosmetics.EnsureNativeUiBindings)
                pcall(RivalsCosmetics.EnsureClientViewModelHook)
                pcall(RivalsCosmetics.BindFirstPersonModels)
                pcall(RivalsCosmetics.ApplySelectedWeaponCosmetics)
                pcall(RivalsCosmetics.ApplyActiveWeaponCosmetics)
                pcall(RivalsCosmetics.EnsureFinisherHook)
                pcall(RivalsEmotes.ApplyAll)
                pcall(RivalsCosmetics.ApplyWraps)
                pcall(RivalsCosmetics.BindSpawnedWorldCosmetics)
                pcall(RivalsCosmetics.BindWorldTripmines)
                pcall(RivalsCosmetics.UpdatePreviewViewport)
                return true
            end

            function RivalsCosmetics.ApplyPendingSelection(previewWeaponName, skinName, wrapName, charmName, finisherName)
                local previousSkinName = nil
                local previousWrapName = nil
                local previousCharmName = nil
                local previousFinisherName = nil
                local hasWeapon = type(previewWeaponName) == 'string' and previewWeaponName ~= ''
                if hasWeapon then
                    previousSkinName = RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingSkinSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName]
                    previousWrapName = RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingWrapSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName]
                    previousCharmName = RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingCharmSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName]
                    previousFinisherName = RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingFinisherSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName]
                    if skinName ~= nil then
                        RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingSkinSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = skinName
                    end
                    if wrapName ~= nil then
                        RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingWrapSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = wrapName
                    end
                    if charmName ~= nil then
                        RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingCharmSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = charmName
                    end
                    if finisherName ~= nil then
                        RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingFinisherSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = finisherName
                    end
                    RivalsCosmetics.SetPreviewWeaponName(previewWeaponName)
                end

                local previewOk, previewResult = pcall(RivalsCosmetics.UpdatePreviewViewport)

                if hasWeapon then
                    RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingSkinSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = previousSkinName
                    RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingWrapSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = previousWrapName
                    RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingCharmSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = previousCharmName
                    RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingFinisherSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = previousFinisherName
                end

                RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingApplyToken = RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingApplyToken + 1
                local pendingApplyToken = RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingApplyToken
                task.defer(GuardRivalsCallback('Cosmetics_ApplyPendingSelection_ApplyAll', function()
                    if RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingApplyToken ~= pendingApplyToken then
                        return nil
                    end

                    if hasWeapon then
                        if skinName ~= nil then
                            RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingSkinSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = skinName
                        end
                        if wrapName ~= nil then
                            RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingWrapSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = wrapName
                        end
                        if charmName ~= nil then
                            RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingCharmSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = charmName
                        end
                        if finisherName ~= nil then
                            RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingFinisherSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = finisherName
                        end
                    end

                    local applyResult = RivalsCosmetics.ApplyAll()
                    if hasWeapon then
                        RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingSkinSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = previousSkinName
                        RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingWrapSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = previousWrapName
                        RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingCharmSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = previousCharmName
                        RivalsCosmeticsState.PendingFinisherSelectionByWeapon[previewWeaponName] = previousFinisherName
                    end
                    return applyResult
                end))

                if not previewOk then
                    error(previewResult, 0)
                end

                return previewOk
            end

            -- =============================================
            -- Throwable / World Item ESP
            -- =============================================

            local WorldESPState = {}

            do
                local WORLD_ITEM_NAMES = {
                    ['Throwable - Grenade'] = {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), Label = 'GRENADE'},
                    ['Throwable - Flashbang'] = {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 100), Label = 'FLASH'},
                    ['Throwable - Molotov'] = {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 0), Label = 'MOLOTOV'},
                    ['Throwable - Smoke'] = {Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200), Label = 'SMOKE'},
                    ['Smoke Grenade'] = {Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200), Label = 'SMOKE'},
                    ['Satchel'] = {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50), Label = 'SATCHEL'},
                    ['SubspaceTripmineHitbox'] = {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50), Label = 'TRIPMINE'},
                    ['Flare Gun'] = {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50), Label = 'FLARE GUN'},
                }

                local ThrowableESP = {}

                local function IsTrackedItem(instance)
                    return instance
                        and (instance:IsA('BasePart') or instance:IsA('Model'))
                        and WORLD_ITEM_NAMES[instance.Name] ~= nil
                end

                local function CreateThrowableESP(part)
                    if ThrowableESP[part] then
                        return
                    end

                    local label = Drawing.new('Text')
                    label.Center = true
                    label.Outline = true
                    label.Font = 2
                    label.Visible = false
                    label.Size = 12
                    label.Transparency = PLAYER_CARD_THEME.ThrowableTextTransparency
                    ThrowableESP[part] = {
                        label = label,
                        lastRoundedDistance = nil,
                        lastLabelText = nil,
                        lastLabelSize = nil,
                        lastLabelColor = nil,
                        lastLabelPositionX = nil,
                        lastLabelPositionY = nil,
                        labelVisible = false,
                    }
                end

                local function DestroyThrowableESP(part)
                    local entry = ThrowableESP[part]
                    if not entry then
                        return
                    end

                    pcall(function()
                        entry.label:Remove()
                    end)
                    ThrowableESP[part] = nil
                end

                function WorldESPState.DestroyThrowable(part)
                    DestroyThrowableESP(part)
                end

                function WorldESPState.DestroyAllThrowable()
                    for part in pairs(ThrowableESP) do
                        DestroyThrowableESP(part)
                    end
                end

                function WorldESPState.RegisterThrowable(part)
                    if not IsTrackedItem(part) then
                        return
                    end

                    CreateThrowableESP(part)
                end

                function WorldESPState.UpdateThrowable()
                    local enabled = EspRenderSettings.ShowThrowable
                    if not enabled then
                        for _, entry in pairs(ThrowableESP) do
                            if entry.labelVisible then
                                entry.label.Visible = false
                                entry.labelVisible = false
                            end
                        end
                        return
                    end

                    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if not cam then
                        return
                    end

                    local maxDist = DEFAULT_ESP_MAX_DISTANCE
                    local textSize = math.max(DEFAULT_ESP_TEXT_SIZE - 2, 10)
                    local rootPosition = HumanoidRootPart and HumanoidRootPart.Position or nil
                    local maxDistSquared = maxDist * maxDist

                    for part in pairs(ThrowableESP) do
                        if not part.Parent or not part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) or not IsTrackedItem(part) then
                            DestroyThrowableESP(part)
                        end
                    end

                    for part, entry in pairs(ThrowableESP) do
                        repeat
                        local info = WORLD_ITEM_NAMES[part.Name]
                        if not info then
                            break
                        end

                        local pos = part:IsA('BasePart') and part.Position or part:GetPivot().Position
                        local screenPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
                        if not onScreen or screenPos.Z <= 0 then
                            if entry.labelVisible then
                                entry.label.Visible = false
                                entry.labelVisible = false
                            end
                            break
                        end

                        local dist = 0
                        if rootPosition then
                            local rootOffset = pos - rootPosition
                            local worldDistanceSquared = rootOffset:Dot(rootOffset)
                            if worldDistanceSquared > maxDistSquared then
                                if entry.labelVisible then
                                    entry.label.Visible = false
                                    entry.labelVisible = false
                                end
                                break
                            end
                            dist = math.sqrt(worldDistanceSquared)
                        end

                        if not entry.labelVisible then
                            entry.label.Visible = true
                            entry.labelVisible = true
                        end

                        if entry.lastLabelSize ~= textSize then
                            entry.lastLabelSize = textSize
                            entry.label.Size = textSize
                        end

                        local roundedDistance = math.floor(dist)
                        if entry.lastRoundedDistance ~= roundedDistance or entry.lastLabelText ~= info.Label then
                            entry.lastRoundedDistance = roundedDistance
                            entry.lastLabelText = info.Label
                            entry.label.Text = string.format('%s | %dm', info.Label, roundedDistance)
                        end

                        local screenX = math.round(screenPos.X)
                        local screenY = math.round(screenPos.Y)
                        if entry.lastLabelPositionX ~= screenX or entry.lastLabelPositionY ~= screenY then
                            entry.lastLabelPositionX = screenX
                            entry.lastLabelPositionY = screenY
                            entry.label.Position = Vector2.new(screenX, screenY)
                        end

                        if entry.lastLabelColor ~= info.Color then
                            entry.lastLabelColor = info.Color
                            entry.label.Color = info.Color
                        end
                        until true
                    end
                end
            end

            do
                local WORLD_HAZARD_NAMES = {
                    ['MolotovHitbox'] = {
                        Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 0),
                        BoxTransparency = 0.78,
                    },
                }

                local HazardESP = {}

                local function IsTrackedHazard(instance)
                    return instance
                        and instance:IsA('BasePart')
                        and WORLD_HAZARD_NAMES[instance.Name] ~= nil
                end

                local function HideHazardESP(entry)
                    if not entry then
                        return
                    end

                    entry.box.Visible = false
                    entry.outline.Visible = false
                end

                local function DestroyHazardAdornment(entry)
                    if not entry then
                        return
                    end

                    pcall(function()
                        entry.box:Destroy()
                    end)
                    pcall(function()
                        entry.outline:Destroy()
                    end)
                end

                local function CreateHazardESP(part)
                    if HazardESP[part] then
                        return
                    end

                    local box = Instance.new('BoxHandleAdornment')
                    box.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    box.Adornee = part
                    box.Visible = false
                    box.ZIndex = 10
                    box.Parent = HazardAdornmentContainer

                    local outline = Instance.new('SelectionBox')
                    outline.Adornee = part
                    outline.Visible = false
                    outline.LineThickness = 0.04
                    outline.Parent = HazardAdornmentContainer

                    HazardESP[part] = {
                        box = box,
                        outline = outline,
                    }
                end

                local function DestroyHazardESP(part)
                    local entry = HazardESP[part]
                    if not entry then
                        return
                    end

                    DestroyHazardAdornment(entry)
                    HazardESP[part] = nil
                end

                function WorldESPState.DestroyHazard(part)
                    DestroyHazardESP(part)
                end

                function WorldESPState.DestroyAllHazard()
                    for part in pairs(HazardESP) do
                        DestroyHazardESP(part)
                    end
                end

                function WorldESPState.RegisterHazard(part)
                    if not IsTrackedHazard(part) then
                        return
                    end

                    CreateHazardESP(part)
                end

                function WorldESPState.UpdateHazard()
                    local enabled = EspRenderSettings.ShowThrowable
                    if not enabled then
                        for _, entry in pairs(HazardESP) do
                            HideHazardESP(entry)
                        end
                        return
                    end

                    local maxDist = DEFAULT_ESP_MAX_DISTANCE
                    local rootPosition = HumanoidRootPart and HumanoidRootPart.Position or nil
                    local maxDistSquared = maxDist * maxDist
                    for part, entry in pairs(HazardESP) do
                        repeat
                        local info = WORLD_HAZARD_NAMES[part.Name]
                        if not part.Parent or not part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) or not info then
                            DestroyHazardESP(part)
                            break
                        end

                        if rootPosition then
                            local rootOffset = part.Position - rootPosition
                            local worldDistanceSquared = rootOffset:Dot(rootOffset)
                            if worldDistanceSquared > maxDistSquared then
                                HideHazardESP(entry)
                                break
                            end
                        end

                        entry.box.Adornee = part
                        entry.box.Size = part.Size
                        entry.box.Color3 = info.Color
                        entry.box.Transparency = info.BoxTransparency
                        entry.box.Visible = true

                        entry.outline.Adornee = part
                        entry.outline.Color3 = BlendColor(info.Color, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 0.18)
                        entry.outline.SurfaceTransparency = 1
                        entry.outline.Visible = true
                        until true
                    end
                end
            end

            do
                WorldESPState.SoundVisualizer = {
                    Tracked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' }),
                    ActiveEffects = {},
                    PooledEffects = {},
                    Enabled = false,
                    MaxEffects = 32,
                }

                function WorldESPState.DisconnectSound(sound)
                    local trackedSounds = WorldESPState.SoundVisualizer.Tracked
                    local tracked = trackedSounds[sound]
                    if not tracked then
                        return
                    end
                    for _, connection in pairs(tracked.Connections) do
                        pcall(function()
                            connection:Disconnect()
                        end)
                    end
                    trackedSounds[sound] = nil
                end

                function WorldESPState.ResolveSoundEmitterPart(sound)
                    local parent = sound and sound.Parent or nil
                    if not parent then
                        return nil
                    end
                    if parent:IsA('BasePart') then
                        return parent
                    end
                    if parent:IsA('Attachment') and parent.Parent and parent.Parent:IsA('BasePart') then
                        return parent.Parent
                    end
                    return parent:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA('BasePart')
                end

                function WorldESPState.ResolveSoundSourcePlayer(emitterPart)
                    local model = emitterPart and emitterPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model') or nil
                    while model do
                        local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
                        if player then
                            return player
                        end
                        model = model.Parent and model.Parent:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model') or nil
                    end
                    return nil
                end

                function WorldESPState.IsSoundSourceAllowed(sourcePlayer)
                    local sourceMode = Options.P1S3D1 and Options.P1S3D1.Value or 'Enemies'
                    if sourcePlayer and sourcePlayer ~= LP
                        and not IsPlayerInLocalEnvironment(sourcePlayer) then
                        return false
                    end
                    if sourceMode == 'All' then
                        return true
                    elseif sourceMode == 'Self' then
                        return sourcePlayer == LP
                    elseif sourceMode == 'Team' then
                        return sourcePlayer ~= nil and sourcePlayer ~= LP and not ShouldShow(sourcePlayer, false)
                    end
                    return sourcePlayer ~= nil and sourcePlayer ~= LP and ShouldShow(sourcePlayer, false)
                end

                function WorldESPState.IsFootstepSound(sound, emitterPart)
                    local descriptor = string.lower(table.concat({
                        tostring(sound and sound.Name or ''),
                        tostring(emitterPart and emitterPart.Name or ''),
                        tostring(sound and sound.Parent and sound.Parent.Name or ''),
                    }, ' '))
                    return descriptor:find('foot', 1, true) ~= nil
                        or descriptor:find('step', 1, true) ~= nil
                        or descriptor:find('running', 1, true) ~= nil
                        or descriptor:find('landing', 1, true) ~= nil
                        or (emitterPart and emitterPart.Name == 'HumanoidRootPart'
                            and sound.Looped == false
                            and sound.TimeLength > 0
                            and sound.TimeLength <= 1)
                end

                function WorldESPState.CreateSoundEffect()
                    local anchor = Instance.new('Part')
                    anchor.Name = '__KiciaHookSoundPulse'
                    anchor.Anchored = true
                    anchor.CanCollide = false
                    anchor.CanQuery = false
                    anchor.CanTouch = false
                    anchor.CastShadow = false
                    anchor.Transparency = 1
                    anchor.Size = Vector3.new(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)
                    anchor.Parent = Workspace

                    local pulse = Instance.new('SphereHandleAdornment')
                    pulse.Name = '__KiciaHookSoundPulseAdornment'
                    pulse.Adornee = anchor
                    pulse.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    pulse.Visible = false
                    pulse.ZIndex = 9
                    pulse.Parent = anchor

                    return {
                        Anchor = anchor,
                        Pulse = pulse,
                        StartedAt = 0,
                        Duration = 0,
                        StartRadius = 0,
                        EndRadius = 0,
                    }
                end

                function WorldESPState.DeactivateSoundEffect(index, destroy)
                    local soundVisualizer = WorldESPState.SoundVisualizer
                    local effect = table.remove(soundVisualizer.ActiveEffects, index)
                    if not effect then
                        return
                    end
                    effect.Pulse.Visible = false
                    if destroy then
                        effect.Anchor:Destroy()
                    else
                        soundVisualizer.PooledEffects[#soundVisualizer.PooledEffects + 1] = effect
                    end
                end

                function WorldESPState.SpawnSoundEffect(sound)
                    local soundVisualizer = WorldESPState.SoundVisualizer
                    if not soundVisualizer.Enabled or not sound or not sound.Parent then
                        return
                    end

                    local minVolume = Options.P1S3S1 and Options.P1S3S1.Value or 0.05
                    if sound.Volume < minVolume then
                        return
                    end

                    local emitterPart = WorldESPState.ResolveSoundEmitterPart(sound)
                    if not emitterPart or not WorldESPState.IsSoundSourceAllowed(WorldESPState.ResolveSoundSourcePlayer(emitterPart)) then
                        return
                    end
                    if HumanoidRootPart and sound.RollOffMaxDistance > 0
                        and (emitterPart.Position - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude > sound.RollOffMaxDistance then
                        return
                    end

                    local isFootstep = WorldESPState.IsFootstepSound(sound, emitterPart)
                    if isFootstep and not (Toggles.P1S3T2 and Toggles.P1S3T2.Value) then
                        return
                    end
                    if not isFootstep and not (Toggles.P1S3T3 and Toggles.P1S3T3.Value) then
                        return
                    end

                    if #soundVisualizer.ActiveEffects >= soundVisualizer.MaxEffects then
                        WorldESPState.DeactivateSoundEffect(1, false)
                    end
                    local effect = table.remove(soundVisualizer.PooledEffects) or WorldESPState.CreateSoundEffect()
                    local loudnessScale = math.clamp(sound.Volume, 0.25, 2)
                    effect.Anchor.CFrame = CFrame.new(emitterPart.Position)
                    effect.StartedAt = tick()
                    effect.Duration = isFootstep and 0.65 or 0.9
                    effect.StartRadius = isFootstep and 0.45 or 0.8
                    effect.EndRadius = (isFootstep and 5 or 9) * loudnessScale
                    effect.Pulse.Color3 = isFootstep
                        and (Options.P1S3C1 and Options.P1S3C1.Value or Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 80))
                        or (Options.P1S3C2 and Options.P1S3C2.Value or Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90))
                    effect.Pulse.Radius = effect.StartRadius
                    effect.Pulse.Transparency = 0.28
                    effect.Pulse.Visible = true
                    soundVisualizer.ActiveEffects[#soundVisualizer.ActiveEffects + 1] = effect
                end

                function WorldESPState.RegisterSound(instance)
                    local soundVisualizer = WorldESPState.SoundVisualizer
                    if not soundVisualizer.Enabled or not instance or not instance:IsA('Sound') or soundVisualizer.Tracked[instance] then
                        return
                    end

                    local tracked = {
                        LastPlayedAt = 0,
                        Connections = {},
                    }
                    soundVisualizer.Tracked[instance] = tracked
                    tracked.Connections.Played = instance.Played:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('SoundVisualizer_Played', function()
                        local now = tick()
                        if (now - tracked.LastPlayedAt) < 0.03 then
                            return
                        end
                        tracked.LastPlayedAt = now
                        WorldESPState.SpawnSoundEffect(instance)
                    end))
                    tracked.Connections.Destroying = instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
                        WorldESPState.DisconnectSound(instance)
                    end)
                end

                function WorldESPState.DestroySound(instance)
                    if instance and instance:IsA('Sound') then
                        WorldESPState.DisconnectSound(instance)
                    end
                end

                function WorldESPState.UpdateSoundVisualizer()
                    local soundVisualizer = WorldESPState.SoundVisualizer
                    if not soundVisualizer.Enabled then
                        return
                    end

                    local now = tick()
                    for index = #soundVisualizer.ActiveEffects, 1, -1 do
                        local effect = soundVisualizer.ActiveEffects[index]
                        local alpha = math.clamp((now - effect.StartedAt) / effect.Duration, 0, 1)
                        if alpha >= 1 then
                            WorldESPState.DeactivateSoundEffect(index, false)
                        else
                            local easedAlpha = 1 - ((1 - alpha) * (1 - alpha))
                            effect.Pulse.Radius = effect.StartRadius + ((effect.EndRadius - effect.StartRadius) * easedAlpha)
                            effect.Pulse.Transparency = 0.28 + (alpha * 0.72)
                        end
                    end
                end

                function WorldESPState.SetSoundVisualizerEnabled(enabled)
                    local soundVisualizer = WorldESPState.SoundVisualizer
                    enabled = enabled == true
                    if enabled == soundVisualizer.Enabled then
                        return
                    end

                    if enabled then
                        if not Connections then
                            return
                        end

                        soundVisualizer.Enabled = true
                        Connections:register('SoundVisualizer_Added', Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('SoundVisualizer_Added', WorldESPState.RegisterSound)))
                        Connections:register('SoundVisualizer_Removed', Workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('SoundVisualizer_Removed', WorldESPState.DestroySound)))
                        Connections:register('SoundVisualizer_Render', RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('SoundVisualizer_Render', WorldESPState.UpdateSoundVisualizer)))
                        for _, descendant in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                            WorldESPState.RegisterSound(descendant)
                        end
                        return
                    end

                    soundVisualizer.Enabled = false
                    if Connections then
                        Connections:disconnect({
                            'SoundVisualizer_Added',
                            'SoundVisualizer_Removed',
                            'SoundVisualizer_Render',
                        })
                    end
                    local sounds = {}
                    for sound in pairs(soundVisualizer.Tracked) do
                        sounds[#sounds + 1] = sound
                    end
                    for _, sound in ipairs(sounds) do
                        WorldESPState.DisconnectSound(sound)
                    end
                    while #soundVisualizer.ActiveEffects > 0 do
                        WorldESPState.DeactivateSoundEffect(#soundVisualizer.ActiveEffects, false)
                    end
                end

                function WorldESPState.DestroyAllSoundVisualizer()
                    local soundVisualizer = WorldESPState.SoundVisualizer
                    soundVisualizer.Enabled = false
                    if Connections then
                        Connections:disconnect({
                            'SoundVisualizer_Added',
                            'SoundVisualizer_Removed',
                            'SoundVisualizer_Render',
                        })
                    end
                    local sounds = {}
                    for sound in pairs(soundVisualizer.Tracked) do
                        sounds[#sounds + 1] = sound
                    end
                    for _, sound in ipairs(sounds) do
                        WorldESPState.DisconnectSound(sound)
                    end
                    while #soundVisualizer.ActiveEffects > 0 do
                        WorldESPState.DeactivateSoundEffect(#soundVisualizer.ActiveEffects, true)
                    end
                    for _, effect in ipairs(soundVisualizer.PooledEffects) do
                        effect.Anchor:Destroy()
                    end
                    table.clear(soundVisualizer.PooledEffects)
                end
            end

                SetEspPreviewSegment(segments[5], true, UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.28, 0), color)
                SetEspPreviewSegment(segments[6], true, UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.72, 0), UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.28, 0), color)
                SetEspPreviewSegment(segments[7], true, UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 0), UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.28, 0), color)
                SetEspPreviewSegment(segments[8], true, UDim2.new(1, -2, 0.72, 0), UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.28, 0), color)
            end

            RivalsRuntimeBridge.BuildEspPreview = function(groupbox)
                -- ========================================================================
                -- Bounded Kicia exception (third, alongside the No Spread
                -- InputHook and the Ragebot): Kicia's exact ESP-preview avatar builder. The
                -- model is built from the local player's own avatar and lives only inside
                -- the preview ViewportFrame; it is never applied to any live character. See
                -- anticheat-findings.md. Declared inside BuildEspPreview because the module
                -- top scope sits at Luau's 200-register -O0 ceiling.
                -- ========================================================================
                -- __KICIA_AVATAR_PREVIEW_BEGIN__
                local function BuildEspPreviewAvatarModel()
                    local descriptionOk, description = pcall(function()
                        return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserIdAsync(LP.UserId)
                    end)
                    if not descriptionOk or description == nil then
                        return nil
                    end
                    local modelOk, avatarModel = pcall(function()
                        return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescriptionAsync(description, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
                    end)
                    if not modelOk or avatarModel == nil then
                        return nil
                    end
                    avatarModel:PivotTo(CFrame.identity)
                    local animate = avatarModel:FindFirstChild('Animate')
                    if animate then
                        animate:Destroy()
                    end
                    return avatarModel
                end
                -- __KICIA_AVATAR_PREVIEW_END__

                -- Static scene: no auto-rotate, drag/zoom only.
                local EspPreviewOrbit = {
                    Rotation = math.rad(225),
                    Elevation = math.rad(20),
                    DistanceMultiplier = 4,
                    ModelCenter = Vector3.zero,
                    ModelSize = Vector3.zero,
                    ModelRadius = 4,
                }

                -- Body parts only: one oversized accessory can inflate GetBoundingBox to 3x the
                -- rig and drag its center sideways, which frames the accessory instead of the
                -- character (live-verified).
                local function MeasureEspPreviewModel(previewModel)
                    local minCorner, maxCorner
                    for _, descendant in ipairs(previewModel:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant:IsA('BasePart') and not descendant:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Accessory') then
                            local halfSize = descendant.Size * 0.5
                            local lowCorner = descendant.Position - halfSize
                            local highCorner = descendant.Position + halfSize
                            if not minCorner then
                                minCorner, maxCorner = lowCorner, highCorner
                            else
                                minCorner = Vector3.new(math.min(minCorner.X, lowCorner.X), math.min(minCorner.Y, lowCorner.Y), math.min(minCorner.Z, lowCorner.Z))
                                maxCorner = Vector3.new(math.max(maxCorner.X, highCorner.X), math.max(maxCorner.Y, highCorner.Y), math.max(maxCorner.Z, highCorner.Z))
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if not minCorner then
                        return
                    end
                    local size = maxCorner - minCorner
                    EspPreviewOrbit.ModelCenter = (minCorner + maxCorner) * 0.5
                    EspPreviewOrbit.ModelSize = size
                    EspPreviewOrbit.ModelRadius = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * 0.5
                end

                local UpdateEspPreviewOverlayRect = nil

                local function UpdateEspPreviewCamera(camera)
                    local distance = math.max(EspPreviewOrbit.ModelRadius * 2.4 * EspPreviewOrbit.DistanceMultiplier, 4)
                    local elevation = math.clamp(EspPreviewOrbit.Elevation, -math.pi / 2 + 0.1, math.pi / 2 - 0.1)
                    local planar = math.cos(elevation)
                    local offset = Vector3.new(
                        math.cos(EspPreviewOrbit.Rotation) * distance * planar,
                        math.sin(elevation) * distance,
                        math.sin(EspPreviewOrbit.Rotation) * distance * planar
                    )
                    camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(EspPreviewOrbit.ModelCenter + offset, EspPreviewOrbit.ModelCenter)
                    if UpdateEspPreviewOverlayRect then
                        UpdateEspPreviewOverlayRect()
                    end
                end

                local model, highlight = BuildEspPreviewModel()
                local viewport = groupbox:AddViewport('P1S4V1', {
                    Object = model,
                    Clone = false,
                    AutoFocus = false,
                    Interactive = false,
                    Height = 400,
                })
                if not viewport then
                    model:Destroy()
                    return
                end
                viewport.Camera.FieldOfView = 18
                MeasureEspPreviewModel(model)
                UpdateEspPreviewCamera(viewport.Camera)

                local viewportFrame = viewport.Object.Parent
                viewportFrame.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1).Unit
                viewportFrame.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                viewportFrame.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 150)
                viewportFrame.ClipsDescendants = true

                -- The avatar rig only assembles inside a WorldModel; in a bare ViewportFrame
                -- its jointed parts render scattered (live-verified).
                local previewWorldModel = Instance.new('WorldModel')
                previewWorldModel.Parent = viewportFrame
                model.Parent = previewWorldModel

                -- Kicia structure: the gradient lives on a frame BEHIND the transparent
                -- viewport. A UIGradient directly on the ViewportFrame tints the rendered 3D
                -- image toward black (live-verified).
                local backgroundFrame = Instance.new('Frame')
                backgroundFrame.Name = 'EspPreviewBackground'
                backgroundFrame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                backgroundFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                backgroundFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
                backgroundFrame.ZIndex = 0
                backgroundFrame.Parent = viewportFrame.Parent

                local backgroundGradient = Instance.new('UIGradient')
                backgroundGradient.Rotation = 90
                backgroundGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Library.Scheme.MainColor, Library.Scheme.BackgroundColor)
                backgroundGradient.Parent = backgroundFrame

                local backgroundCorner = Instance.new('UICorner')
                backgroundCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
                backgroundCorner.Parent = backgroundFrame

                local viewportCorner = Instance.new('UICorner')
                viewportCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
                viewportCorner.Parent = viewportFrame

                local orbitButton = Instance.new('TextButton')
                orbitButton.Name = 'EspPreviewOrbitButton'
                orbitButton.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                orbitButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                orbitButton.Text = ''
                orbitButton.AutoButtonColor = false
                orbitButton.ZIndex = 19
                orbitButton.Parent = viewportFrame

                local orbitDragging = false
                local orbitLastPosition = nil
                orbitButton.MouseEnter:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('EspPreview_HoverScroll', function()
                    for _, side in ipairs(groupbox.Tab.Sides) do
                        side.ScrollingEnabled = false
                    end
                end))
                orbitButton.MouseLeave:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('EspPreview_HoverScroll', function()
                    for _, side in ipairs(groupbox.Tab.Sides) do
                        side.ScrollingEnabled = true
                    end
                end))
                orbitButton.InputBegan:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('EspPreview_OrbitDrag', function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        orbitDragging = true
                        orbitLastPosition = nil
                    end
                end))
                orbitButton.InputChanged:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('EspPreview_OrbitZoom', function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
                        return
                    end
                    local direction = 1
                    if input.Position.Z > 0 then
                        direction = -1
                    end
                    EspPreviewOrbit.DistanceMultiplier = math.clamp(EspPreviewOrbit.DistanceMultiplier * 0.85 ^ (-direction), 0.2, 6)
                    UpdateEspPreviewCamera(viewport.Camera)
                end))
                Library:GiveSignal(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('EspPreview_OrbitDrag', function(input)
                    if not orbitDragging then
                        return
                    end
                    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        return
                    end
                    local position = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
                    if orbitLastPosition then
                        local delta = position - orbitLastPosition
                        EspPreviewOrbit.Rotation = EspPreviewOrbit.Rotation - delta.X * 0.012
                        EspPreviewOrbit.Elevation = math.clamp(EspPreviewOrbit.Elevation - delta.Y * 0.012, -math.pi / 2 + 0.1, math.pi / 2 - 0.1)
                        UpdateEspPreviewCamera(viewport.Camera)
                    end
                    orbitLastPosition = position
                end)))
                Library:GiveSignal(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('EspPreview_OrbitDrag', function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        orbitDragging = false
                        orbitLastPosition = nil
                    end
                end)))
                local overlay = Instance.new('Frame')
                overlay.Name = 'EspPreviewOverlay'
                overlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                overlay.ZIndex = 20
                overlay.Parent = viewportFrame

                local target = Instance.new('Frame')
                target.Name = 'TargetRect'
                target.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                target.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                target.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.6)
                target.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                target.ZIndex = 21
                target.Parent = overlay

                -- The sample ESP tracks the preview humanoid like the live renderer: project
                -- the measured body bounds through the viewport camera and fit the target
                -- rect to them, instead of Kicia's fixed centered 0.3 x 0.6 rectangle.
                UpdateEspPreviewOverlayRect = function()
                    local viewportSize = viewportFrame.AbsoluteSize
                    if viewportSize.X < 1 or viewportSize.Y < 1 then
                        return
                    end
                    local camera = viewport.Camera
                    local cameraCFrame = camera.CFrame
                    local tanHalfFov = math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView) * 0.5)
                    local aspect = viewportSize.X / viewportSize.Y
                    local center = EspPreviewOrbit.ModelCenter
                    local halfSize = EspPreviewOrbit.ModelSize * 0.5
                    local minX, minY, maxX, maxY
                    for xSign = -1, 1, 2 do
                        for ySign = -1, 1, 2 do
                            for zSign = -1, 1, 2 do
                                local corner = center + Vector3.new(halfSize.X * xSign, halfSize.Y * ySign, halfSize.Z * zSign)
                                local relative = cameraCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(corner)
                                local depth = math.max(-relative.Z, 0.05)
                                local screenX = (relative.X / (depth * tanHalfFov * aspect) * 0.5 + 0.5) * viewportSize.X
                                local screenY = (0.5 - relative.Y / (depth * tanHalfFov) * 0.5) * viewportSize.Y
                                if not minX or screenX < minX then minX = screenX end
                                if not maxX or screenX > maxX then maxX = screenX end
                                if not minY or screenY < minY then minY = screenY end
                                if not maxY or screenY > maxY then maxY = screenY end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    target.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.round((minX + maxX) * 0.5), math.round((minY + maxY) * 0.5))
                    target.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.round(maxX - minX), math.round(maxY - minY))
                end
                UpdateEspPreviewOverlayRect()
                viewportFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsoluteSize'):Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('EspPreview_Layout', UpdateEspPreviewOverlayRect))

                local boxSegments = table.create(8)
                for segmentIndex = 1, 8 do
                    boxSegments[segmentIndex] = CreateEspPreviewSegment(target)
                end

                local topPane = CreateEspPreviewPane(
                    target,
                    Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
                    UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -2),
                    UDim2.new(3, 0, 0, 18),
                    Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
                    Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom
                )
                local bottomPane = CreateEspPreviewPane(
                    target,
                    Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
                    UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 3),
                    UDim2.new(3, 0, 0, 48),
                    Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
                    Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
                )
                local rightPane = CreateEspPreviewPane(
                    target,
                    Vector2.new(0, 0),
                    UDim2.new(1, 6, 0, 0),
                    UDim2.new(2, 0, 1, 0),
                    Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
                    Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
                )

                local healthRail = Instance.new('Frame')
                healthRail.BackgroundColor3 = PLAYER_CARD_THEME.BarBackgroundColor
                healthRail.BorderColor3 = PLAYER_CARD_THEME.Classic.BoxOutlineColor
                healthRail.BorderSizePixel = 1
                healthRail.ZIndex = 23
                healthRail.Parent = target
                local healthFill = Instance.new('Frame')
                healthFill.BackgroundColor3 = EspClassic.GetReactiveBarColor(0.75)
                healthFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
                healthFill.ZIndex = 24
                healthFill.Parent = healthRail
                local healthRailCorner = Instance.new('UICorner')
                healthRailCorner.Parent = healthRail
                local healthFillCorner = Instance.new('UICorner')
                healthFillCorner.Parent = healthFill
                local healthNumber = CreateEspPreviewLabel(target, 0, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)

                local lookDirectionLine = Instance.new('Frame')
                lookDirectionLine.Name = 'LookDirectionLine'
                lookDirectionLine.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
                lookDirectionLine.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.16, 0)
                lookDirectionLine.Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 2)
                lookDirectionLine.Rotation = -12
                lookDirectionLine.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
                lookDirectionLine.BorderSizePixel = 0
                lookDirectionLine.ZIndex = 25
                lookDirectionLine.Parent = target

                RivalsRuntimeBridge.EspPreviewState = {
                    Viewport = viewport,
                    Overlay = overlay,
                    Target = target,
                    Highlight = highlight,
                    BoxSegments = boxSegments,
                    TopPane = topPane,
                    BottomPane = bottomPane,
                    RightPane = rightPane,
                    Name = CreateEspPreviewLabel(topPane, 1),
                    AmmoNumber = CreateEspPreviewLabel(bottomPane, 1),
                    HeldWeapon = CreateEspPreviewLabel(bottomPane, 2),
                    Distance = CreateEspPreviewLabel(bottomPane, 3),
                    Deflecting = CreateEspPreviewLabel(rightPane, 1, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left),
                    Rank = CreateEspPreviewLabel(rightPane, 2, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left),
                    WinStreak = CreateEspPreviewLabel(rightPane, 3, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left),
                    HealthRail = healthRail,
                    HealthFill = healthFill,
                    HealthRailCorner = healthRailCorner,
                    HealthFillCorner = healthFillCorner,
                    HealthNumber = healthNumber,
                    LookDirectionLine = lookDirectionLine,
                }
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.UpdateEspPreview()

                task.spawn(GuardRivalsCallback('EspPreview_Avatar', function()
                    local avatarModel = BuildEspPreviewAvatarModel()
                    if avatarModel == nil then
                        return
                    end
                    if Library.Unloaded or viewport.Destroyed then
                        avatarModel:Destroy()
                        return
                    end
                    viewport:SetObject(avatarModel)
                    avatarModel.Parent = previewWorldModel
                    avatarModel:PivotTo(CFrame.identity)
                    local avatarHighlight = Instance.new('Highlight')
                    avatarHighlight.Name = 'PreviewHighlight'
                    avatarHighlight.Adornee = avatarModel
                    avatarHighlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    avatarHighlight.Parent = avatarModel
                    local state = RivalsRuntimeBridge.EspPreviewState
                    if state then
                        state.Highlight = avatarHighlight
                    end
                    task.wait(0.2)
                    MeasureEspPreviewModel(avatarModel)
                    EspPreviewOrbit.Rotation = math.rad(225)
                    UpdateEspPreviewCamera(viewport.Camera)
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.UpdateEspPreview()
                end))
            end
            end

local cloneref = clonereference or cloneref or function(x) return x end
local _CR = (getgenv and getgenv().__LH_CloneRef == true)
local function cr(x) if _CR and x then return cloneref(x) else return x end end
local Players           = cr(game:GetService("Players"))
local RunService        = cr(game:GetService("RunService"))
local UserInputService  = cr(game:GetService("UserInputService"))
local VirtualInputMgr   = cr(game:GetService("VirtualInputManager"))

workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
    Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
end)
local lp                 = Players.LocalPlayer
local _safePlayersCache = nil
local function getSafePlayers()
    if _safePlayersCache then return _safePlayersCache end
    local list = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetChildren()) do
        if p:IsA("Player") then list[#list+1] = p end
    end
    _safePlayersCache = list
    return list
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function() _safePlayersCache = nil end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function() _safePlayersCache = nil end)
local function waitForGameReady()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
    repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded()
    if not lp then
        repeat task.wait() until Players.LocalPlayer
        lp = Players.LocalPlayer
    end
    if not lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts") then
        repeat task.wait() until lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    end
    local deadline = tick() + 5
    while lp.Character == nil and tick() < deadline do task.wait() end
    return true
end
waitForGameReady()
local function safeRequire(path, timeout)
    if not path then return nil end
    timeout = timeout or 5
    local start = tick()
    while tick() - start < timeout do
        local ok, result = pcall(require, path)
        if ok then return result end
        task.wait(0.2)
    end
    return nil
end
local function waitModule(root, names, timeout)
    timeout = timeout or 10
    local obj = root
    for _, n in ipairs(names) do
        if not obj then return nil end
        local ok, child = pcall(function() return obj:WaitForChild(n, timeout) end)
        obj = ok and child or nil
    end
    return obj
end
local isMobile = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
local function isMouseButtonDown()
    if isMobile then
        return true
    else
        return UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
    end
end
local function isInputActive(key)
    if key == "MB1" then return isMouseButtonDown() end
    if key == "MB2" then
        if isMobile then return true end
        return UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2)
    end
    if key == "Always" then return true end
    local kc = Enum.KeyCode[key]
    if kc and not isMobile then
        return UserInputService:IsKeyDown(kc)
    end
    return false
end
local function awaitGameLoaded(moduleInst, timeout)
    if not moduleInst or type(getloadedmodules) ~= "function" then return end
    local deadline = tick() + (timeout or 15)
    repeat
        local ok, loaded = pcall(getloadedmodules)
        if ok and type(loaded) == "table" then
            for _, m in ipairs(loaded) do
                if m == moduleInst then return end
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
    until tick() >= deadline
end
local function loadGameModule(root, names)
    local inst = waitModule(root, names)
    awaitGameLoaded(inst, 15)
    return safeRequire(inst)
end
local Rivals = { Ready = false }
local hookGunModule
local function resolveAll(jobs, timeout)
    local pending = #jobs
    for _, job in ipairs(jobs) do
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(job)
            pending = pending - 1
        end)
    end
    local deadline = tick() + (timeout or 25)
    while pending > 0 and tick() < deadline do task.wait() end
    return pending == 0
end
resolveAll({
    function() Rivals.Util    = loadGameModule(ReplicatedStorage, {"Modules","Utility"}) end,
    function() Rivals.Fighter = loadGameModule(lp.PlayerScripts,  {"Controllers","FighterController"}) end,
    function() Rivals.Enums   = loadGameModule(ReplicatedStorage, {"Modules","EnumLibrary"}) end,
    function() Rivals.Cosmetics = loadGameModule(ReplicatedStorage, {"Modules","CosmeticLibrary"}) end,
    function() Rivals.ItemLib   = loadGameModule(ReplicatedStorage, {"Modules","ItemLibrary"}) end,
})
Rivals.Ready = (Rivals.Util ~= nil and Rivals.Fighter ~= nil)
local _weaponResolving = false
local function resolveWeaponModules()
    if _weaponResolving then return end
    if Rivals.Gun ~= nil and Rivals.Melee ~= nil and Rivals.Knife ~= nil then return end
    _weaponResolving = true
    task.spawn(function()
        resolveAll({
            function() if Rivals.Gun   == nil then Rivals.Gun   = loadGameModule(lp.PlayerScripts, {"Modules","ItemTypes","Gun"})   end end,
            function() if Rivals.Melee == nil then Rivals.Melee = loadGameModule(lp.PlayerScripts, {"Modules","ItemTypes","Melee"}) end end,
            function() if Rivals.Knife == nil then Rivals.Knife = loadGameModule(lp.PlayerScripts, {"Modules","Items","Knife"})     end end,
        })
        _weaponResolving = false
        if Rivals.Gun ~= nil and hookGunModule ~= nil then pcall(hookGunModule) end
    end)
end
resolveWeaponModules()
lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(0.5)
    resolveWeaponModules()
    if Rivals.Ready and hookGunModule then
        hookGunModule()
    end
end)
local function getEquippedItem()
    if not Rivals.Ready then return nil end
    local f = Rivals.Fighter and Rivals.Fighter.LocalFighter
    return f and f.EquippedItem or nil
end
local ConstPatch = {}
;(function()
local _getconstants = getconstants or (debug and debug.getconstants)
local _setconstant  = setconstant  or (debug and debug.setconstant)
local _getprotos    = getprotos    or (debug and debug.getprotos)
local _getproto     = getproto     or (debug and debug.getproto)
local HAVE_CONST  = type(_getconstants) == "function" and type(_setconstant) == "function"
local HAVE_PROTOS = type(_getprotos) == "function" and type(_getproto) == "function"
local _sets = {}
local function ledger(create)
    if not getgenv then
        return nil
    end
    local g = getgenv()
    local t = rawget(g, "__LH_ConstLedger")
    if not t and create then
        t = {}
        g.__LH_ConstLedger = t
    end
    return t
end
local HASH_SEED = 5381
local STR_CAP   = 256
local function hashByte(h, b)
    return bit32.band(bit32.lshift(h, 5) + h + b, 0xFFFFFFFF)
end
local function hashString(h, s)
    local n = #s
    h = hashByte(h, bit32.band(n, 0xFF))
    h = hashByte(h, bit32.band(bit32.rshift(n, 8), 0xFF))
    local upto = math.min(n, STR_CAP)
    for i = 1, upto do
        h = hashByte(h, string.byte(s, i))
    end
    return h
end
local function hashValue(h, v)
    local t = typeof(v)
    h = hashString(h, t)
    if t == "string" then
        return hashString(h, v)
    end
    if t == "number" then
        return hashString(h, string.format("%.17g", v))
    end
    if t == "boolean" then
        if v then
            return hashByte(h, 1)
        end
        return hashByte(h, 0)
    end
    return h
end
function ConstPatch.fingerprint(fn)
    if not HAVE_CONST or type(fn) ~= "function" then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        local consts = _getconstants(fn)
        if type(consts) ~= "table" then
            return nil
        end
        local h = HASH_SEED
        for i, v in consts do
            h = hashValue(h, i)
            h = hashValue(h, v)
        end
        if HAVE_PROTOS then
            local protos = _getprotos(fn)
            if type(protos) == "table" then
                h = hashValue(h, #protos)
            end
        end
        return h
    end)
    if not ok then
        return nil
    end
    return result
end
local function resolveFn(src)
    if type(src.fn) == "function" then
        return src.fn
    end
    if type(src.holder) ~= "table" then
        return nil
    end
    local v = rawget(src.holder, src.name)
    if type(v) ~= "function" then
        return nil
    end
    return v
end
local function candidates(fn, src)
    if src.scan ~= "protos" then
        return { fn }
    end
    if not HAVE_PROTOS then
        return nil, "executor lacks getprotos/getproto"
    end
    local ok, protos = pcall(_getprotos, fn)
    if not ok or type(protos) ~= "table" then
        return nil, "getprotos failed"
    end
    local out = {}
    for i in protos do
        local okG, live = pcall(_getproto, fn, i, true)
        if okG and type(live) == "table" and type(live[1]) == "function" then
            out[#out + 1] = live[1]
        end
    end
    return out
end
local function collectMatches(fn, src)
    local ok, consts = pcall(_getconstants, fn)
    if not ok or type(consts) ~= "table" then
        return nil, "getconstants failed"
    end
    if src.index ~= nil then
        if src.expect == nil then
            return nil, "index mode requires `expect`"
        end
        local cur = consts[src.index]
        if cur == nil then
            return nil, "no constant at index " .. tostring(src.index)
        end
        if cur ~= src.expect then
            return nil, string.format("index %s holds %s, expected %s",
                tostring(src.index), tostring(cur), tostring(src.expect))
        end
        return { { index = src.index, old = cur } }
    end
    local hits = {}
    for i, v in consts do
        if v == src.target then
            hits[#hits + 1] = { index = i, old = v }
        end
    end
    return hits
end
local function validateSource(src)
    if type(src) ~= "table" then
        return "source is not a table"
    end
    if type(src.name) ~= "string" then
        return "needs `name`"
    end
    if type(src.fn) ~= "function" and type(src.holder) ~= "table" then
        return "needs `fn`, or `holder` + `name`"
    end
    if (src.target == nil) == (src.index == nil) then
        return "needs exactly one of `target` or `index`"
    end
    if src.new == nil then
        return "needs `new`"
    end
    if src.scan ~= nil and src.scan ~= "self" and src.scan ~= "protos" then
        return "`scan` must be \"self\" or \"protos\""
    end
    if src.index ~= nil and src.scan == "protos" then
        return "`index` mode cannot be combined with scan=\"protos\""
    end
    return nil
end
local Set = {}
Set.__index = Set
function ConstPatch.new(name, sources)
    local set = setmetatable({
        name     = name,
        sources  = sources,
        restores = nil,
    }, Set)
    _sets[#_sets + 1] = set
    return set
end
function Set:Apply()
    if not HAVE_CONST then
        return false, "executor lacks debug.getconstants/debug.setconstant"
    end
    if self.restores then
        return false, self.name .. ": already applied"
    end
    local plan = {}
    for _, src in self.sources do
        local label = self.name .. "/" .. tostring(src.name or "?")
        local shapeErr = validateSource(src)
        if shapeErr then
            return false, label .. ": " .. shapeErr
        end
        local fn = resolveFn(src)
        if not fn then
            return false, label .. ": cannot resolve target function"
        end
        if src.fingerprint ~= nil then
            local got = ConstPatch.fingerprint(fn)
            if got ~= src.fingerprint then
                return false, string.format("%s: VERSION GATE — fingerprint %s, expected %s",
                    label, tostring(got), tostring(src.fingerprint))
            end
        end
        local cands, cerr = candidates(fn, src)
        if not cands then
            return false, label .. ": " .. cerr
        end
        local found = 0
        for _, cand in cands do
            local hits, herr = collectMatches(cand, src)
            if not hits then
                return false, label .. ": " .. herr
            end
            if #hits > 1 then
                return false, string.format("%s: AMBIGUOUS — %d occurrences in one function; refusing to guess",
                    label, #hits)
            end
            if #hits == 1 then
                local hit = hits[1]
                if typeof(src.new) ~= typeof(hit.old) then
                    return false, string.format("%s: type change %s -> %s refused",
                        label, typeof(hit.old), typeof(src.new))
                end
                found = found + 1
                plan[#plan + 1] = { fn = cand, index = hit.index, old = hit.old, new = src.new }
            end
        end
        local exact = src.count
        if exact == nil and src.scan ~= "protos" then
            exact = 1
        end
        if exact ~= nil then
            if found ~= exact then
                return false, string.format("%s: found %d target sites, expected %d", label, found, exact)
            end
        elseif found == 0 then
            return false, label .. ": found no target sites"
        end
    end
    local restores = {}
    self.restores = restores
    local led = ledger(true)
    for _, p in plan do
        local ok = pcall(_setconstant, p.fn, p.index, p.new)
        if not ok then
            self:Revert()
            return false, string.format("%s: setconstant failed at index %s", self.name, tostring(p.index))
        end
        local rec = { fn = p.fn, index = p.index, old = p.old }
        restores[#restores + 1] = rec
        if led then
            led[#led + 1] = rec
        end
    end
    return true
end
function Set:Revert()
    local restores = self.restores
    if not restores then
        return
    end
    self.restores = nil
    local led = ledger()
    for i = #restores, 1, -1 do
        local rec = restores[i]
        pcall(_setconstant, rec.fn, rec.index, rec.old)
        if led then
            for j = #led, 1, -1 do
                if led[j] == rec then
                    table.remove(led, j)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
function Set:IsApplied()
    return self.restores ~= nil
end
function ConstPatch.revertAll()
    for _, set in _sets do
        pcall(function() set:Revert() end)
    end
    local led = ledger()
    if not led or not _setconstant then
        return
    end
    for i = #led, 1, -1 do
        local rec = led[i]
        if type(rec) == "table" and type(rec.fn) == "function" then
            pcall(_setconstant, rec.fn, rec.index, rec.old)
        end
        led[i] = nil
    end
end
function ConstPatch.available()
    if not HAVE_CONST then
        return false, "no debug.getconstants/debug.setconstant"
    end
    if not HAVE_PROTOS then
        return true, "no getprotos/getproto — scan=\"protos\" sources will fail"
    end
    return true, "ok"
end
function ConstPatch.learn(sources)
    local out = {}
    for _, src in sources do
        local fn = resolveFn(src)
        if fn then
            out[#out + 1] = string.format("%s = %s", tostring(src.name), tostring(ConstPatch.fingerprint(fn)))
        else
            out[#out + 1] = string.format("%s = <unresolved>", tostring(src.name))
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out, "\n")
end
function ConstPatch.dump(fn, includeProtos)
    if not HAVE_CONST or type(fn) ~= "function" then
        return "<not a function, or executor lacks debug.getconstants>"
    end
    local out = {}
    local function poolOf(f, tag)
        local ok, consts = pcall(_getconstants, f)
        if not ok or type(consts) ~= "table" then
            out[#out + 1] = tag .. ": <unreadable>"
            return
        end
        out[#out + 1] = string.format("%s  fingerprint=%s", tag, tostring(ConstPatch.fingerprint(f)))
        for i, v in consts do
            out[#out + 1] = string.format("  [%s] %s %s", tostring(i), typeof(v), string.sub(tostring(v), 1, 120))
        end
    end
    poolOf(fn, "self")
    if includeProtos and HAVE_PROTOS then
        local ok, protos = pcall(_getprotos, fn)
        if ok and type(protos) == "table" then
            for i in protos do
                local okG, live = pcall(_getproto, fn, i, true)
                if okG and type(live) == "table" and type(live[1]) == "function" then
                    poolOf(live[1], "proto[" .. tostring(i) .. "]")
                else
                    out[#out + 1] = "proto[" .. tostring(i) .. "]: <no live closure>"
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out, "\n")
end
ConstPatch.revertAll()
end)()
