                        local function getFC()
                            if fcCtrl then return fcCtrl end
                            pcall(function()
                                fcCtrl = require(lp.PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController)
                            end)
                            return fcCtrl
                        end
                        local function itemName(item)
                            local t = typeof(item)
                            if t == 'string' then return item ~= '' and item or nil end
                            if t == 'Instance' then return item.Name end
                            if t ~= 'table' then return nil end
                            if type(item.Get) == 'function' then
                                local ok, n = pcall(item.Get, item, 'Name')
                                if ok and type(n) == 'string' and n ~= '' then return n end
                            end
                            if type(item.Name) == 'string' and item.Name ~= '' then return item.Name end
                            if type(item.Info) == 'table' and type(item.Info.Name) == 'string' then return item.Info.Name end
                            if type(item.ItemName) == 'string' and item.ItemName ~= '' then return item.ItemName end
                            return nil
                        end
                        local function itemImage(name)
                            local L = getIlib()
                            local d = L and L.Items and L.Items[name]
                            if not d then return '' end
                            return d.ImageHighResolution or d.Image or d.Icon or ''
                        end
                        local function getFighter(plr)
                            local fc = getFC()
                            if not (fc and type(fc.GetFighter) == 'function') then return nil end
                            local ok, f = pcall(fc.GetFighter, fc, plr)
                            if ok and f then return f end
                            if plr.Character then
                                ok, f = pcall(fc.GetFighter, fc, plr.Character)
                                if ok then return f end
                            end
                            return nil
                        end
                        local function loadoutNames(fighter)
                            local names, seen = {}, {}
                            local inv = fighter and (fighter.Loadout or fighter.Slots or fighter.Items or fighter.EquippedItems)
                            if type(inv) == 'table' then
                                local tmp = {}
                                for k, it in pairs(inv) do
                                    local nm = itemName(it)
                                    if nm and not seen[nm] then
                                        seen[nm] = true
                                        local slot = tonumber(k)
                                        if not slot and type(it) == 'table' and type(it.Get) == 'function' then
                                            pcall(function() slot = tonumber(it:Get('Slot') or it:Get('Index')) end)
                                        end
                                        tmp[#tmp + 1] = { slot or 99, nm }
                                    end
                                end
                                table.sort(tmp, function(a, b) return a[1] < b[1] end)
                                for i, e in ipairs(tmp) do names[i] = e[2] end
                            end
                            if #names == 0 then
                                local lpw = fighter and fighter.Data and fighter.Data.LastPickedWeapons
                                if type(lpw) == 'table' then
                                    for i, n in ipairs(lpw) do names[i] = n end
                                end
                            end
                            return names
                        end
                        local DEVICE_NAMES = {
                            MouseKeyboard = 'pc', Touch = 'mobile', Gamepad = 'console', VR = 'virtual reality',
                        }
                        local function deviceOf(plr, fighter)
                            local v = plr:GetAttribute('Controls') or plr:GetAttribute('Device') or plr:GetAttribute('Platform')
                            if not v and fighter then
                                pcall(function()
                                    v = fighter.Entity and fighter.Entity:GetAttribute('Controls')
                                end)
                                if not v then v = fighter.Controls end
                                if not v and type(fighter.Get) == 'function' then
                                    pcall(function() v = fighter:Get('Controls') end)
                                end
                            end
                            if type(v) == 'string' then return DEVICE_NAMES[v] or v:lower() end
                            return 'unknown'
                        end
                        local function hex(c)
                            return string.format('#%02x%02x%02x', math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5),
                                math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))
                        end

                        -- ---------------- target resolution ----------------
                        local RAGE_TOGGLES = {
                            { 'Instance', 'IRB_TargetOn' }, { 'Grief', 'GRF_TargetOn' },
                            { 'Elisium', 'MN1E1' }, { 'Mini Rage', 'MN1R1' },
                            { 'Luahook', 'MN1LH_RAGE' }, { 'Lunar', 'RagebotEnabled' },
                            { 'Combat', 'P8S4T1' },
                        }
                        local function activeRage()
                            local sel = Options.MN1E0 and Options.MN1E0.Value
                            local first
                            for _, e in ipairs(RAGE_TOGGLES) do
                                local t = Toggles[e[2]]
                                if t and t.Value then
                                    if e[1] == sel then return e[1] end
                                    first = first or e[1]
                                end
                            end
                            return first
                        end
                        local lastScan, cachedClosest = 0, nil
                        local function closestEnemy()
                            local now = os.clock()
                            if now - lastScan < 0.2 then return cachedClosest end
                            lastScan = now
                            cachedClosest = nil
                            local myChar = lp.Character
                            local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                            if not myRoot then return nil end
                            local best = math.huge
                            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                                if p ~= lp and p.Character
                                    and p:GetAttribute('TeamID') ~= lp:GetAttribute('TeamID') then
                                    local r = p.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
                                    local h = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                                    if r and h and h.Health > 0 then
                                        local d = (r.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                                        if d < best then best = d; cachedClosest = p end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            return cachedClosest
                        end

                        local trackPlr, lastHp, lastMyHp, dealt, taken = nil, nil, nil, 0, 0
                        local appliedAccent, appliedText

                        local function applyColors()
                            local a = Options.TH_ACCENT and Options.TH_ACCENT.Value or Color3.fromRGB(80, 120, 255)
                            local t = Options.TH_TEXT and Options.TH_TEXT.Value or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                            if a == appliedAccent and t == appliedText then return end
                            appliedAccent, appliedText = a, t
                            for _, s in ipairs(accentStrokes) do s.Color = a end
                            for _, s in ipairs(slots) do s.stroke.Color = a end
                            for _, f in ipairs(accentFills) do f.BackgroundColor3 = a end
                            nameLbl.TextColor3 = t
                            hpVal.TextColor3 = t
                        end

                        local function setSlot(slot, name, equipped)
                            slot.img.Image = name and itemImage(name) or ''
                            slot.stroke.Thickness = equipped and 2 or 1
                            slot.stroke.Transparency = equipped and 0 or 0.55
                        end

                        local function updateHud(target)
                            local a = appliedAccent
                            local t = appliedText
                            local ah, grey = hex(a), '#8a8f9c'
                            if not target then
                                nameLbl.Text = 'no target'
                                infoLbl.Text = ''
                                hpLbl.Text = '<font color="' .. grey .. '">health</font>'
                                hpVal.Text = '0 / 0'
                                hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
                                dmgLbl.Text = '<font color="' .. grey .. '">damage ratio</font>'
                                dmgVal.Text = '0 <font color="#ff4646">▲</font> 0 <font color="#ff4646">▼</font>'
                                for _, s in ipairs(slotList) do setSlot(s, nil, false) end
                                trackPlr = nil
                                return
                            end
                            local fighter = getFighter(target)
                            nameLbl.Text = target.DisplayName ~= '' and target.Name or target.Name
                            local level = tonumber(target:GetAttribute('Level')) or 0
                            local rank = 'unranked'
                            pcall(function()
                                local f = RivalsRuntimeBridge.ResolveRankName
                                if f then rank = tostring(f(target:GetAttribute('DisplayELO'))):lower() end
                            end)
                            local streak = tonumber(target:GetAttribute('StatisticDuelsWinStreak')) or 0
                            infoLbl.Text = string.format(
                                '<font color="%s">level</font> <font color="%s">%d</font>  <font color="%s">rank</font> <font color="%s">%s</font>  <font color="%s">device</font> <font color="%s">%s</font>  <font color="%s">streak</font> <font color="%s">%d</font>',
                                grey, ah, level, grey, ah, rank, grey, ah, deviceOf(target, fighter), grey, ah, streak)
                            local hum = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                            local hp = hum and hum.Health or 0
                            local mhp = hum and hum.MaxHealth or 100
                            if mhp <= 0 then mhp = 100 end
                            hpLbl.Text = '<font color="' .. grey .. '">health</font>'
                            hpVal.Text = string.format('%d / %d', math.floor(hp + 0.5), math.floor(mhp + 0.5))
                            hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(hp / mhp, 0, 1), 1)
                            -- damage ratio (reset whenever the target changes)
                            local myHum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
                            local myHp = myHum and myHum.Health or 0
                            if trackPlr ~= target then
                                trackPlr, lastHp, lastMyHp, dealt, taken = target, hp, myHp, 0, 0
                            end
                            if lastHp and hp < lastHp then dealt = dealt + (lastHp - hp) end
                            if lastMyHp and myHp < lastMyHp then taken = taken + (lastMyHp - myHp) end
                            lastHp, lastMyHp = hp, myHp
                            dmgLbl.Text = '<font color="' .. grey .. '">damage ratio</font>'
                            dmgVal.Text = string.format('%d <font color="#ff4646">▲</font> %d <font color="#ff4646">▼</font>',
                                math.floor(dealt + 0.5), math.floor(taken + 0.5))
                            -- weapons
                            local names = loadoutNames(fighter)
                            local eq = fighter and itemName(fighter.EquippedItem)
                            for i, s in ipairs(slotList) do
                                local n = names[i]
                                setSlot(s, n, n ~= nil and n == eq)
                            end
                        end

                        -- ---------------- Ragebot status text (GUI labels) ----------------
                        local TextService = game:GetService('TextService')
                        local STATUS_FONT = Enum.Font.RobotoMono
                        local function mkStatusLabel()
                            local l = Instance.new('TextLabel')
                            l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                            l.Font = STATUS_FONT
                            l.TextSize = 16
                            l.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
                            l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                            l.Text = ''
                            l.Visible = false
                            l.Parent = host
                            local st = Instance.new('UIStroke')
                            st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
                            st.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
                            st.Parent = l
                            return l, st
                        end
                        local stA, strokeA = mkStatusLabel()   -- "ragebot:"
                        local stB, strokeB = mkStatusLabel()   -- target name
                        local stC, strokeC = mkStatusLabel()   -- ammo
                        local function lum(c) return 0.299 * c.R + 0.587 * c.G + 0.114 * c.B end
                        local function ammoText()
                            local fc = getFC()
                            local lf = fc and fc.LocalFighter
                            local item = lf and lf.EquippedItem
                            if not item or type(item.Get) ~= 'function' then return nil end
                            local cur
                            pcall(function() cur = item:Get('CurrentAmmo') or item:Get('Ammo') end)
                            if type(cur) ~= 'number' then return nil end
                            return tostring(math.floor(cur))
                        end
                        local function hideStatus()
                            stA.Visible = false; stB.Visible = false; stC.Visible = false
                        end
                        local function textW(txt, size)
                            local ok, v = pcall(TextService.GetTextSize, TextService, txt, size, STATUS_FONT, Vector2.new(1000, 1000))
                            return ok and v.X or (#txt * size * 0.6)
                        end
                        local function updateStatus(act, target)
                            if Toggles.RS_FORCE and Toggles.RS_FORCE.Value then act = act or 'test' end
                            if not (Toggles.RS_ENABLED and Toggles.RS_ENABLED.Value) or not act then
                                hideStatus(); return
                            end
                            local lc = Options.RS_LABEL and Options.RS_LABEL.Value or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                            local vc = Options.RS_VALUE and Options.RS_VALUE.Value or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                            local tsize = (Options.RS_SIZE and Options.RS_SIZE.Value) or 16
                            local oOn = not (Toggles.RS_OUTLINE and not Toggles.RS_OUTLINE.Value)
                            local oThick = (Options.RS_OUTLINE_T and Options.RS_OUTLINE_T.Value) or 1
                            local yoff = (Options.RS_YOFF and Options.RS_YOFF.Value) or 60
                            local oAlpha = (Options.RS_OUTLINE_A and Options.RS_OUTLINE_A.Value) or 0
                            local oAuto = not (Toggles.RS_OUTLINE_AUTO and not Toggles.RS_OUTLINE_AUTO.Value)
                            local oColor = (Options.RS_OUTLINE_C and Options.RS_OUTLINE_C.Value) or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                            -- Each text gets its own outline, picked to contrast with its own color.
                            local function style(lbl, stroke, col)
                                lbl.TextSize = tsize
                                lbl.TextColor3 = col
                                stroke.Enabled = oOn
                                stroke.Thickness = oThick
                                stroke.Transparency = oAlpha
                                if oAuto then
                                    stroke.Color = lum(col) < 0.5 and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                                else
                                    stroke.Color = oColor
                                end
                            end
                            style(stA, strokeA, lc); style(stB, strokeB, vc); style(stC, strokeC, vc)
                            local ta = 'ragebot: '
                            local tb = target and target.Name or 'no target'
                            stA.Text = ta; stB.Text = tb
                            local wA, wB = textW(ta, tsize), textW(tb, tsize)
                            local h = tsize + 4
                            stA.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(wA + 2, h); stB.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(wB + 2, h)
                            local x0 = -(wA + wB) / 2
                            stA.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x0, 0.5, yoff)
                            stB.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x0 + wA, 0.5, yoff)
                            stA.Visible = true; stB.Visible = true
                            local ammo = ammoText()
                            if ammo then
                                local wC = textW(ammo, tsize)
                                stC.Text = ammo
                                stC.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(wC + 2, h)
                                stC.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -wC / 2, 0.5, yoff + h)
                                stC.Visible = true
                            else
                                stC.Visible = false
                            end
                        end

                        -- ---------------- main loop ----------------
                        local THWarned, RSWarned = false, false
                        local conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                            local menuOpen = Library.Toggled == true
                            if not menuOpen then dragging = false end
                            local act = activeRage()
                            local needTarget = act ~= nil or (Toggles.TH_ENABLED and Toggles.TH_ENABLED.Value)
                            local target
                            if needTarget then
                                local prov = act and Providers[act]
                                if prov then
                                    local ok, p = pcall(prov)
                                    if ok then target = p end
                                else
                                    target = closestEnemy()
                                end
                                if not prov and not target then target = closestEnemy() end
                            end
                            if typeof(target) == 'Instance' and target:IsA('Model') then
                                target = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
                            end
                            if typeof(target) ~= 'Instance' or not target:IsA('Player') then target = nil end

                            local hudOn = Toggles.TH_ENABLED and Toggles.TH_ENABLED.Value
                            if hudOn and (target or menuOpen) then
                                applyColors()
                                hudScale.Scale = (Options.TH_SCALE and Options.TH_SCALE.Value) or 1.6
                                root.Visible = true
                                root.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
                                local okH, errH = pcall(updateHud, target)
                                if not okH and not THWarned then THWarned = true; warn('[Target HUD] ' .. tostring(errH)) end
                            else
                                root.Visible = false
                            end
                            local okS, errS = pcall(updateStatus, act, target)
                            if not okS then
                                hideStatus()
                                if not RSWarned then RSWarned = true; warn('[Ragebot Status] ' .. tostring(errS)) end
                            end
                        end)
                        pcall(function()
                            Library:OnUnload(function()
                                conn:Disconnect()
                                host:Destroy()
                            end)
                        end)
                    end)
                    if not okTH then
                        warn('[Target HUD] failed to build: ' .. tostring(errTH))
                    end
                end

                    local __IRB_RAGE_GB, __IRB_VIS_GB = InstanceRageGb, InstanceVisGb
                    local __ok, __err = pcall(function()
                        local getgenv = getgenv or function() return _G end
                        local cloneref = cloneref or function(o) return o end
                        local Drawing = (function()
                            local okD = type(Drawing) == 'table' and pcall(function() Drawing.new('Line'):Remove() end)
                            if okD then return Drawing end
                            local dummy = setmetatable({}, { __index = function() return function() end end, __newindex = function() end })
                            return { new = function() return dummy end }
                        end)()
                        getgenv().InstanceModuleCache = getgenv().InstanceModuleCache or {}
                        getgenv().InstanceDrawingTextPool = getgenv().InstanceDrawingTextPool or {}
                        if not getgenv().InstanceTrackDrawingText then
                            getgenv().InstanceTrackDrawingText = function(obj)
                                table.insert(getgenv().InstanceDrawingTextPool, obj)
                                return obj

                        local function instanceSafeRequire(moduleRef, timeoutSec)
                            local cache = getgenv().InstanceModuleCache
                            local key = typeof(moduleRef) == "Instance" and moduleRef:GetFullName() or tostring(moduleRef)
                            if cache[key] ~= nil then return cache[key] end
                            local deadline = os.clock() + (timeoutSec or 20)
                            local lastErr
                            while os.clock() < deadline do
                                if typeof(moduleRef) == "Instance" and not moduleRef.Parent then
                                    task.wait(0.1)
                                else
                                    local ok, result = pcall(require, moduleRef)
                                    if ok then cache[key] = result return result end
                                    lastErr = result
                                    task.wait(0.1)
                                end
                            end
                            error("module load failed: " .. key .. " (" .. tostring(lastErr) .. ")")
                        end
                        local function shouldSuppressGameplayOverlays()
                            return Library.Toggled == true

                        local function worldToScreen(worldPos, cam)
                            cam = cam or workspace.CurrentCamera
                            if not cam or not worldPos then return nil, false end
                            local v, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
                            if not onScreen or v.Z <= 0 then return v, false end
                            return v, true
                        end

                        local MATCH_ID_ATTRS = {"MatchId", "DuelId", "RoundId", "GameId", "MatchUUID", "ArenaId", "InstanceId"}
                        local DUEL_STATE_ATTRS = {"InDuel", "InMatch", "InRound", "InGame", "InFight", "IsInMatch", "IsInDuel", "MatchActive", "Fighting"}
                        local SPAWN_SAFE_ATTRS = {"InSpawn", "InLobby", "IsSpectating", "InSafeZone", "InIntermission", "IsRespawning"}

                        local function inLive(targetPlr)
                            if not targetPlr then return false end
                            local live = workspace:FindFirstChild("Live")
                            if not live then return false end
                            if live:FindFirstChild(targetPlr.Name) then return true end
                            if live:FindFirstChild(tostring(targetPlr.UserId)) then return true end
                            for _, child in ipairs(live:GetChildren()) do
                                if child.Name == targetPlr.Name or child.Name == tostring(targetPlr.UserId) then
                                    return true
                                end
                            end
                            local char = targetPlr.Character
                            if char and (char.Parent == live or char:IsDescendantOf(live)) then
                                return true
                            end
                            local fc = modules.fighter
                            if fc and type(fc.GetFighter) == "function" then
                                local ok, fighter = pcall(fc.GetFighter, fc, targetPlr)
                                if ok and fighter and fighter.Entity and fighter.Entity.Parent then
                                    if fighter.Entity.Parent == live or fighter.Entity:IsDescendantOf(live) then
                                        return true
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            return false
                        end

                        local function plrMid(targetPlr)
                            if not targetPlr then return nil end
                            for _, key in ipairs(MATCH_ID_ATTRS) do
                                local v = targetPlr:GetAttribute(key)
                                if v ~= nil and v ~= "" and v ~= 0 and v ~= false then
                                    return tostring(v)
                                end
                            end
                            local char = targetPlr.Character
                            if char then
                                for _, key in ipairs(MATCH_ID_ATTRS) do
                                    local v = char:GetAttribute(key)
                                    if v ~= nil and v ~= "" and v ~= 0 and v ~= false then
                                        return tostring(v)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            return nil
                        end

                        local function liveMatch()
                            local lp = player
                            if not lp then return false end
                            for _, key in ipairs(SPAWN_SAFE_ATTRS) do
                                local v = lp:GetAttribute(key)
                                if v == true or v == 1 or v == "true" then
                                    return false
                                end
                            end
                            local char = lp.Character
                            if not char then return false end
                            for _, key in ipairs(SPAWN_SAFE_ATTRS) do
                                local cv = char:GetAttribute(key)
                                if cv == true or cv == 1 or cv == "true" then
                                    return false
                                end
                            end
                            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            local myRoot = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not myRoot then return false end
                            for _, key in ipairs(DUEL_STATE_ATTRS) do
                                local v = lp:GetAttribute(key)
                                if v == true or v == 1 or v == "true" then
                                    return true
                                end
                                local cv = char:GetAttribute(key)
                                if cv == true or cv == 1 or cv == "true" then
                                    return true
                                end
                            end
                            if inLive(lp) then
                                return true
                            end
                            local fc = modules.fighter
                            if fc and fc.LocalFighter and fc.LocalFighter.Entity and fc.LocalFighter.Entity.Parent then
                                return true
                            end
                            local myMatchId = plrMid(lp)
                            if myMatchId then
                                for _, plr in players:GetPlayers() do
                                    if plr ~= lp and plrMid(plr) == myMatchId then
                                        return true
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            if fc then
                                for _, list in ipairs({ fc.Fighters, fc.AllFighters }) do
                                    if list then
                                        for _, f in pairs(list) do
                                            if f and f.Player and f.Player ~= lp and (f.IsEnemy or f.Enemy) then
                                                local fChar = f.Player.Character
                                                local fHum = fChar and fChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                                if fHum and fHum.Health > 0 then
                                                    return true
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            return false
                        end

                        local _instanceLobbyCache = { t = 0, v = true }

                            if now - _instanceLobbyCache.t < 0.15 then
                                return _instanceLobbyCache.v
                            end
                            _instanceLobbyCache.t = now
                            _instanceLobbyCache.v = not liveMatch()
                            return _instanceLobbyCache.v
                        end
