                local StaffDetector = {
                    Notifications = {},
                    Connections = {},
                    RoleCache = {},
                    FriendCache = {},
                    Detections = {},
                    ActionCache = {},
                    ClassificationInFlight = {},
                    RetryGeneration = {},
                    StaffUserIds = {},
                    GroupId = 3461453,
                    MinimumRank = 100,
                    LobbyPlaceId = 17625359962,
                    RoleCacheLifetime = 300,
                    FriendCacheLifetime = 300,
                    StaffSetLifetime = 900,
                    FailureRetryDelay = 15,
                    MaxStaffRoles = 32,
                    MaxGroupPagesPerRole = 10,
                    MaxFriendPages = 5,
                    StaffSetExpiresAt = 0,
                    StaffSetReady = false,
                    StaffSetComplete = false,
                    StaffSetLoading = false,
                    EscapeCooldownUntil = 0,
                    Enabled = false,
                    Unloaded = false,
                    Generation = 0,
                    HttpService = game:GetService('HttpService'),
                    TeleportService = game:GetService('TeleportService'),
                }

                function StaffDetector.IsStaff(player)
                    if not player or player == LP then return false end
                    local cached = StaffDetector.RoleCache[player.UserId]
                    if cached and cached.ExpiresAt > os.clock() then
                        return cached.Value
                    end

                    local ok, rank = pcall(function()
                        return player:GetRankInGroup(StaffDetector.GroupId)
                    end)
                    if not ok or type(rank) ~= 'number' then
                        return nil
                    end

                    local isStaff = rank >= StaffDetector.MinimumRank
                    StaffDetector.RoleCache[player.UserId] = {
                        Value = isStaff,
                        ExpiresAt = os.clock() + StaffDetector.RoleCacheLifetime,
                    }
                    if isStaff then
                        StaffDetector.StaffUserIds[player.UserId] = true
                    end
                    return isStaff
                end

                function StaffDetector.FetchJson(url)
                    local requestOk, response = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, url)
                    if not requestOk or type(response) ~= 'string' then
                        return nil
                    end

                    local decodeOk, decoded = pcall(StaffDetector.HttpService.JSONDecode, StaffDetector.HttpService, response)
                    return decodeOk and type(decoded) == 'table' and decoded or nil
                end

                function StaffDetector.EnsureStaffUserIds()
                    local now = os.clock()
                    if StaffDetector.StaffSetReady and StaffDetector.StaffSetExpiresAt > now then
                        return true
                    end

                    if StaffDetector.StaffSetLoading then
                        local waitUntil = now + 5
                        repeat
                            task.wait(0.05)
                        until not StaffDetector.StaffSetLoading or os.clock() >= waitUntil or StaffDetector.Unloaded
                        return StaffDetector.StaffSetReady
                    end

                    StaffDetector.StaffSetLoading = true
                    local roles = StaffDetector.FetchJson(string.format(
                        'https://groups.roblox.com/v1/groups/%d/roles',
                        StaffDetector.GroupId
                    ))
                    local nextStaffUserIds = {}
                    local complete = roles ~= nil and type(roles.roles) == 'table'
                    local staffRoleCount = 0

                    if complete then
                        for _, role in ipairs(roles.roles) do
                            if type(role) == 'table' and type(role.rank) == 'number'
                                and role.rank >= StaffDetector.MinimumRank and tonumber(role.id) then
                                staffRoleCount = staffRoleCount + 1
                                if staffRoleCount > StaffDetector.MaxStaffRoles then
                                    complete = false
                                    break
                                end

                                local cursor = nil
                                local pageCount = 0
                                repeat
                                    pageCount = pageCount + 1
                                    local url = string.format(
                                        'https://groups.roblox.com/v1/groups/%d/roles/%d/users?limit=100&sortOrder=Asc',
                                        StaffDetector.GroupId,
                                        tonumber(role.id)
                                    )
                                    if cursor and cursor ~= '' then
                                        url = url .. '&cursor=' .. StaffDetector.HttpService:UrlEncode(cursor)
                                    end

                                    local page = StaffDetector.FetchJson(url)
                                    if not page or type(page.data) ~= 'table' then
                                        complete = false
                                        break
                                    end

                                    for _, member in ipairs(page.data) do
                                        local userId = type(member) == 'table' and tonumber(member.userId or member.id) or nil
                                        if userId then
                                            nextStaffUserIds[userId] = true
                                        end
                                    end

                                    cursor = page.nextPageCursor
                                until not cursor or cursor == '' or pageCount >= StaffDetector.MaxGroupPagesPerRole

                                if cursor and cursor ~= '' then
                                    complete = false
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if complete then
                        StaffDetector.StaffUserIds = nextStaffUserIds
                        StaffDetector.StaffSetReady = true
                        StaffDetector.StaffSetComplete = true
                    else
                        for userId in pairs(nextStaffUserIds) do
                            StaffDetector.StaffUserIds[userId] = true
                        end
                        StaffDetector.StaffSetReady = StaffDetector.StaffSetReady or next(StaffDetector.StaffUserIds) ~= nil
                        StaffDetector.StaffSetComplete = false
                    end

                    StaffDetector.StaffSetExpiresAt = os.clock()
                        + (complete and StaffDetector.StaffSetLifetime or StaffDetector.FailureRetryDelay)
                    StaffDetector.StaffSetLoading = false
                    return StaffDetector.StaffSetReady
                end

                function StaffDetector.IsModFriend(player)
                    if not player or player == LP then return false end
                    local cached = StaffDetector.FriendCache[player.UserId]
                    if cached and cached.ExpiresAt > os.clock() then
                        return cached.Value, cached.StaffFriendName
                    end

                    if not StaffDetector.EnsureStaffUserIds() then
                        return nil
                    end

                    local friendsOk, friendPages = pcall(Players.GetFriendsAsync, Players, player.UserId)
                    if not friendsOk or not friendPages then
                        return nil
                    end

                    local matchedName = nil
                    local pageCount = 0
                    local complete = true
                    repeat
                        pageCount = pageCount + 1
                        local pageOk, friends = pcall(friendPages.GetCurrentPage, friendPages)
                        if not pageOk or type(friends) ~= 'table' then
                            complete = false
                            break
                        end

                        for _, friend in ipairs(friends) do
                            local friendUserId = type(friend) == 'table' and tonumber(friend.Id or friend.UserId or friend.id) or nil
                            if friendUserId and StaffDetector.StaffUserIds[friendUserId] then
                                matchedName = friend.Username or friend.DisplayName or tostring(friendUserId)
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if matchedName or friendPages.IsFinished then
                            break
                        end

                        if pageCount >= StaffDetector.MaxFriendPages then
                            complete = false
                            break
                        end
                        local advanceOk = pcall(friendPages.AdvanceToNextPageAsync, friendPages)
                        if not advanceOk then
                            complete = false
                            break
                        end
                    until false

                    if not matchedName and (not complete or not StaffDetector.StaffSetComplete) then
                        return nil
                    end

                    local isModFriend = matchedName ~= nil
                    StaffDetector.FriendCache[player.UserId] = {
                        Value = isModFriend,
                        StaffFriendName = matchedName,
                        ExpiresAt = os.clock() + StaffDetector.FriendCacheLifetime,
                    }
                    return isModFriend, matchedName
                end

                function StaffDetector.IsActionSelected(kind, action)
                    local option = Options[kind == 'Moderator' and 'P10S2D1' or 'P10S2D2']
                    return option and type(option.Value) == 'table' and option.Value[action] == true
                end

                function StaffDetector.DestroyNotification(kind)
                    local notification = StaffDetector.Notifications[kind]
                    if not notification then return end
                    pcall(function()
                        if type(notification.Destroy) == 'function' then
                            notification:Destroy()
                        elseif type(notification.Remove) == 'function' then
                            notification:Remove()
                        end
                    end)
                    StaffDetector.Notifications[kind] = nil
                end

                function StaffDetector.UpdateNotifications()
                    for _, kind in ipairs({'Moderator', 'ModFriend'}) do
                        local names = {}
                        if StaffDetector.Enabled and StaffDetector.IsActionSelected(kind, 'Notify') then
                            for _, detection in pairs(StaffDetector.Detections) do
                                if detection.Kind == kind and detection.Player and detection.Player.Parent == Players then
                                    local name = detection.Player.DisplayName or detection.Player.Name
                                    if kind == 'ModFriend' and detection.StaffFriendName then
                                        name = string.format('%s (friend of %s)', name, detection.StaffFriendName)
                                    end
                                    table.insert(names, name)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        table.sort(names)

                        if #names == 0 then
                            StaffDetector.DestroyNotification(kind)
                        else
                            local description = (kind == 'Moderator' and 'In server: ' or 'In server: ')
                                .. table.concat(names, ', ')
                            local notification = StaffDetector.Notifications[kind]
                            if notification then
                                local changed = pcall(function()
                                    notification:ChangeDescription(description)
                                end)
                                if not changed then
                                    StaffDetector.DestroyNotification(kind)
                                end
                            end

                            if not StaffDetector.Notifications[kind] then
                                local ok, created = pcall(function()
                                    return Library:Notify({
                                        Title = kind == 'Moderator' and 'Moderator Detected' or 'Mod Friend Detected',
                                        Description = description,
                                        Persist = true,
                                        TitleColor = Options.P10S2C1.Value,
                                        DescriptionColor = Options.P10S2C1.Value,
                                    })
                                end)
                                if ok and created then
                                    StaffDetector.Notifications[kind] = created
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                function StaffDetector.RunActions(detection)
                    if not StaffDetector.Enabled or not detection or not detection.Player then return end
                    local kind = detection.Kind
                    local actionPrefix = string.format('%s:%d:', kind, detection.Player.UserId)

                    if StaffDetector.IsActionSelected(kind, 'Kick') then
                        local actionKey = actionPrefix .. 'Kick'
                        if not StaffDetector.ActionCache[actionKey] then
                            StaffDetector.ActionCache[actionKey] = true
                            pcall(LP.Kick, LP, string.format(
                                'Staff Detector: %s detected (%s).',
                                detection.Player.Name,
                                kind == 'Moderator' and 'moderator' or 'moderator friend'
                            ))
                        end
                        return
                    end

                    if StaffDetector.IsActionSelected(kind, 'To Lobby') and game.PlaceId ~= StaffDetector.LobbyPlaceId then
                        local actionKey = actionPrefix .. 'To Lobby'
                        if not StaffDetector.ActionCache[actionKey] and os.clock() >= StaffDetector.EscapeCooldownUntil then
                            StaffDetector.EscapeCooldownUntil = os.clock() + 5
                            local ok = pcall(
                                StaffDetector.TeleportService.Teleport,
                                StaffDetector.TeleportService,
                                StaffDetector.LobbyPlaceId,
                                LP
                            )
                            if ok then
                                StaffDetector.ActionCache[actionKey] = true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                function StaffDetector.QueueClassification(player, delaySeconds)
                    if not StaffDetector.Enabled or not player or player == LP then return end
                    local userId = player.UserId
                    local retryGeneration = (StaffDetector.RetryGeneration[userId] or 0) + 1
                    StaffDetector.RetryGeneration[userId] = retryGeneration
                    local detectorGeneration = StaffDetector.Generation

                    task.delay(delaySeconds or 0, function()
                        if not StaffDetector.Enabled or StaffDetector.Unloaded
                            or detectorGeneration ~= StaffDetector.Generation
                            or retryGeneration ~= StaffDetector.RetryGeneration[userId]
                            or player.Parent ~= Players
                            or StaffDetector.ClassificationInFlight[userId] then
                            return
                        end

                        StaffDetector.ClassificationInFlight[userId] = true
                        local isStaff = StaffDetector.IsStaff(player)
                        local detection = nil
                        local unavailable = isStaff == nil
                        if isStaff == true then
                            detection = {Player = player, Kind = 'Moderator'}
                        elseif isStaff == false then
                            local isModFriend, staffFriendName = StaffDetector.IsModFriend(player)
                            unavailable = isModFriend == nil
                            if isModFriend == true then
                                detection = {
                                    Player = player,
                                    Kind = 'ModFriend',
                                    StaffFriendName = staffFriendName,
                                }
                            end
                        end
                        StaffDetector.ClassificationInFlight[userId] = nil

                        if not StaffDetector.Enabled or StaffDetector.Unloaded
                            or detectorGeneration ~= StaffDetector.Generation
                            or retryGeneration ~= StaffDetector.RetryGeneration[userId]
                            or player.Parent ~= Players then
                            return
                        end

                        StaffDetector.Detections[userId] = detection
                        StaffDetector.UpdateNotifications()
                        if detection then
                            StaffDetector.RunActions(detection)
                        elseif unavailable then
                            StaffDetector.QueueClassification(player, StaffDetector.FailureRetryDelay)
                        end
                    end)
                end

                function StaffDetector.Refresh()
                    if not StaffDetector.Enabled then
                        StaffDetector.UpdateNotifications()
                        return
                    end

                    local activeUserIds = {}
                    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if player ~= LP then
                            activeUserIds[player.UserId] = true
                            StaffDetector.QueueClassification(player, 0)
                        end
                    end

                    for userId in pairs(StaffDetector.Detections) do
                        if not activeUserIds[userId] then
                            StaffDetector.Detections[userId] = nil
                        end
                    end
                    StaffDetector.UpdateNotifications()
                end

                function StaffDetector.DisconnectPlayers()
                    for key, connection in pairs(StaffDetector.Connections) do
                        pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end)
                        StaffDetector.Connections[key] = nil
                    end
                end

                function StaffDetector.Start()
                    if StaffDetector.Enabled or StaffDetector.Unloaded then return end
                    StaffDetector.Enabled = true
                    StaffDetector.Generation = StaffDetector.Generation + 1
                    StaffDetector.Connections.PlayerAdded = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(
                        GuardRivalsCallback('StaffDetector_PlayerAdded', function(player)
                            StaffDetector.QueueClassification(player, 0)
                        end)
                    )
                    StaffDetector.Connections.PlayerRemoving = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(
                        GuardRivalsCallback('StaffDetector_PlayerRemoving', function(player)
                            local userId = player.UserId
                            StaffDetector.RoleCache[userId] = nil
                            StaffDetector.FriendCache[userId] = nil
                            StaffDetector.Detections[userId] = nil
                            StaffDetector.ClassificationInFlight[userId] = nil
                            StaffDetector.RetryGeneration[userId] = nil
                            for actionKey in pairs(StaffDetector.ActionCache) do
                                if actionKey:find(':' .. tostring(userId) .. ':', 1, true) then
                                    StaffDetector.ActionCache[actionKey] = nil
                                end
                            end
                            StaffDetector.UpdateNotifications()
                        end)
                    )
                    StaffDetector.Refresh()
                end

                function StaffDetector.Destroy(unloading)
                    StaffDetector.Enabled = false
                    StaffDetector.Generation = StaffDetector.Generation + 1
                    StaffDetector.DisconnectPlayers()
                    for _, kind in ipairs({'Moderator', 'ModFriend'}) do
                        StaffDetector.DestroyNotification(kind)
                    end
                    table.clear(StaffDetector.Detections)
                    table.clear(StaffDetector.ActionCache)
                    table.clear(StaffDetector.ClassificationInFlight)
                    table.clear(StaffDetector.RetryGeneration)
                    if unloading then
                        StaffDetector.Unloaded = true
                        table.clear(StaffDetector.RoleCache)
                        table.clear(StaffDetector.FriendCache)
                        table.clear(StaffDetector.StaffUserIds)
                    end
                end

                function StaffDetector.ActionsChanged()
                    StaffDetector.UpdateNotifications()
                    if StaffDetector.Enabled then
                        for _, detection in pairs(StaffDetector.Detections) do
                            StaffDetector.RunActions(detection)
                        end
                    end
                end

                function StaffDetector.ColorChanged()
                    for _, kind in ipairs({'Moderator', 'ModFriend'}) do
                        StaffDetector.DestroyNotification(kind)
                    end
                    StaffDetector.UpdateNotifications()
                end

                Library:OnUnload(GuardRivalsCallback('StaffDetector_Unload', function()
                    StaffDetector.Destroy(true)
                end))

                ;(function(PlayerTabRef) -- Avatar Changer (ported from the Yokai Named script's mise tab)
                local Players = game:GetService('Players')
                local Config = { AvatarCharacterId = 0, AvatarAutoLoad = true, RobloxAvatarUsername = '' }
local AvatarChanger = {}
do
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    local YOKAI_NAMED_ID = 11394787504
    local FIXED_ID = 62536494

    local currentTargetId = LocalPlayer.UserId
    local targetModelCache = nil
    local targetHeadColor = Color3.fromRGB(248, 217, 184)
    local applySerial = 0
    local running = true

    local loadVersion = 0
    local function isValidUserId(id)
        return type(id) == "number" and id >= 1 and id % 1 == 0
    end

    local function loadTarget(id)
        if not isValidUserId(id) then return false, "Invalid UserId" end
        local ok, model = pcall(function()
            return Players:GetCharacterAppearanceAsync(id)
        end)
        if not ok or not model then
            return false, "Failed to load avatar"
        end
        targetModelCache = model
        loadVersion = loadVersion + 1
        targetHeadColor = Color3.fromRGB(248, 217, 184)
        for _, item in pairs(model:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("BasePart") and item.Name == "Head" then
                targetHeadColor = item.Color
                break
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    local function clearVisualAvatar(char)
        if not char then return end
        for _, obj in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:IsA("Accessory") or obj:IsA("Shirt") or obj:IsA("Pants")
                or obj:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or obj:IsA("BodyColors") then
                pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function applyAvatarToModel(char, force)
        if not char or not targetModelCache then return end
        local mark = tostring(currentTargetId) .. ':' .. tostring(loadVersion)
        if not force and char:GetAttribute('__AvatarMark') == mark then return end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:WaitForChild("Head", 3)
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 3)
        if not head or not root then return end

        pcall(function() char:SetAttribute('__AvatarMark', mark) end)
        pcall(function()
            local bodyColors = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyColors")
            if not bodyColors then
                bodyColors = Instance.new("BodyColors")
                bodyColors.Parent = char
            end

            bodyColors.HeadColor3 = targetHeadColor
            bodyColors.LeftArmColor3 = targetHeadColor
            bodyColors.RightArmColor3 = targetHeadColor
            bodyColors.LeftLegColor3 = targetHeadColor
            bodyColors.RightLegColor3 = targetHeadColor
            bodyColors.TorsoColor3 = targetHeadColor

            for _, part in pairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    part.Color = targetHeadColor
                end
            end

            clearVisualAvatar(char)

            local modelClone = targetModelCache:Clone()
            for _, item in pairs(modelClone:GetChildren()) do
                pcall(function()
                    if item:IsA("Shirt") or item:IsA("Pants") or item:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
                        item.Parent = char
                    elseif item:IsA("Accessory") then
                        local handle = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                        if handle then
                            handle.CanCollide = false
                            handle.Transparency = 0
                            local att = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
                            if att then
                                local charAtt = char:FindFirstChild(att.Name, true)
                                if charAtt and charAtt.Parent and charAtt.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then
                                    local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
                                    weld.Part0 = handle
                                    weld.Part1 = charAtt.Parent
                                    weld.C0 = att.CFrame
                                    weld.C1 = charAtt.CFrame
                                    weld.Parent = handle
                                end
                            end
                            item.Parent = char
                        end
                    elseif item:IsA("SpecialMesh") or item:IsA("Decal") then
                        item.Parent = head
                    end
                end)
            end
            modelClone:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    local function avatarUrls(id)
        return
            "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. tostring(id) .. "&w=420&h=420",
            "rbxthumb://type=Avatar&id=" .. tostring(id) .. "&w=420&h=420"
    end

    local hookedImages = setmetatable({}, { __mode = 'k' })
    local function processImageGui(gui)
        if not (gui:IsA("ImageLabel") or gui:IsA("ImageButton")) then return end
        if hookedImages[gui] then return end
        hookedImages[gui] = true
        local function checkAndUpdate()
            pcall(function()
                local headUrl, avatarUrl = avatarUrls(currentTargetId)
                local img = gui.Image
                if string.find(img, tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId), 1, true)
                    or string.find(img, "AvatarHeadShot", 1, true)
                    or string.find(img, "Avatar", 1, true) then
                    local targetUrl = (gui.AbsoluteSize.X <= 100) and headUrl or avatarUrl
                    if gui.Image ~= targetUrl then
                        gui.Image = targetUrl
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        checkAndUpdate()
        gui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"):Connect(checkAndUpdate)
    end

    local function hookPlayerGui(playerGui)
        for _, child in pairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
            processImageGui(child)
        end
        playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(child)
            processImageGui(child)
        end)
    end

    local function applyCurrent()
        applySerial = applySerial + 1
        local mySerial = applySerial
        if not loadTarget(currentTargetId) then return false end
        if mySerial ~= applySerial then return false end
        if LocalPlayer.Character then
            applyAvatarToModel(LocalPlayer.Character)
        end
        return true
    end

    function AvatarChanger:SetTarget(id)
        id = tonumber(id)
        if not isValidUserId(id) then
            return false, "UserId must be a whole number"
        end
        currentTargetId = id
        return applyCurrent()
    end

    function AvatarChanger:YokaiNamed()
        currentTargetId = YOKAI_NAMED_ID
        return applyCurrent()
    end

    function AvatarChanger:Fixed()
        currentTargetId = FIXED_ID
        return applyCurrent()
    end

    function AvatarChanger:Reset()
        currentTargetId = LocalPlayer.UserId
        return applyCurrent()
    end

    function AvatarChanger:GetTargetId()
        return currentTargetId
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
            hookPlayerGui(LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10))
        end)

        LocalPlayer.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if child.Name == "PlayerGui" then
                pcall(function() hookPlayerGui(child) end)
            end
        end)

        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.3)
                if running then
                    pcall(function() applyAvatarToModel(char) end)
                end
            end)
        end)

        -- Keep the same visual-sync behavior as the uploaded source:
        -- local character, preview/win models, and avatar images are kept in sync.
        while running do
            if currentTargetId ~= LocalPlayer.UserId then
                pcall(function()
                    local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
                    if playerGui then
                        for _, gui in pairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
                            if gui:IsA("ImageLabel") or gui:IsA("ImageButton") then
                                processImageGui(gui)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if LocalPlayer.Character then
                        applyAvatarToModel(LocalPlayer.Character)
                    end
                    for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                        if obj:IsA("Model") and obj ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
                            if obj.Name == LocalPlayer.Name or string.find(obj.Name, LocalPlayer.Name, 1, true) then
                                applyAvatarToModel(obj)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                task.wait(1)
            else
                task.wait(3)
            end
        end
    end)

    -- Preload the default avatar target so Reset works immediately.
    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function() loadTarget(LocalPlayer.UserId) end)
    end)
end
do
    local LEFT = PlayerTabRef:AddLeftGroupbox('Avatar Changer')
    local RIGHT = PlayerTabRef:AddRightGroupbox('Avatar Presets')

    local customIdInput = LEFT:AddInput('MiseAvatarUserId', {
        Text = 'Character ID',
        Default = tostring((Config.AvatarCharacterId and Config.AvatarCharacterId > 0) and Config.AvatarCharacterId or Players.LocalPlayer.UserId),
        Numeric = true,
        Finished = true,
        ClearTextOnFocus = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            local id = tonumber(v)
            if id and id > 0 and id % 1 == 0 then
                Config.AvatarCharacterId = id
                if Config.AvatarAutoLoad then
                    local ok, err = AvatarChanger:SetTarget(id)
                    if ok then
                        pcall(function() Library:Notify('Character avatar loaded: ' .. tostring(id), 3) end)
                    else
                        pcall(function() Library:Notify('' .. tostring(err or 'Avatar change failed'), 4) end)
                    end
                end
            else
                pcall(function() Library:Notify('Enter a valid Character ID.', 4) end)
            end
        end
    })

    LEFT:AddToggle('MiseAvatarAutoLoad', {
        Text = 'Auto Load Character Avatar',
        Default = (Config.AvatarAutoLoad ~= false),
        Callback = function(v)
            Config.AvatarAutoLoad = v
            if v then
                local id = tonumber(customIdInput.Value)
                if id and id > 0 and id % 1 == 0 then
                    Config.AvatarCharacterId = id
                    AvatarChanger:SetTarget(id)
                end
            end
        end
    })

    -- Roblox username avatar loader (separate from Character ID).
    local avatarHistory = {}

    local function addAvatarHistory(id, username)
        id = tonumber(id)
        if not id or id <= 0 or id % 1 ~= 0 then return end

        local name = tostring(username or '')
        if name == '' then
            local ok, result = pcall(function()
                return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(id)
            end)
            if ok and result then
                name = tostring(result)
            end
        end
        if name == '' then name = tostring(id) end

        for i = #avatarHistory, 1, -1 do
            if avatarHistory[i].Id == id then
                table.remove(avatarHistory, i)
            end
        end

        table.insert(avatarHistory, 1, { Id = id, Name = name })
        while #avatarHistory > 20 do
            table.remove(avatarHistory)
        end
    end

    local function applyRobloxUsername(v)
        local username = tostring(v or ''):gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
        if username == '' then
            pcall(function() Library:Notify('Enter a Roblox username.', 4) end)
            return
        end

        Config.RobloxAvatarUsername = username

        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, userIdOrErr = pcall(function()
                return Players:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(username)
            end)

            if not ok or not userIdOrErr then
                pcall(function() Library:Notify('Roblox username not found: ' .. username, 5) end)
                return
            end

            local userId = tonumber(userIdOrErr)
            if not userId then
                pcall(function() Library:Notify('Could not resolve username: ' .. username, 5) end)
                return
            end

            local okAvatar, err = AvatarChanger:SetTarget(userId)
            if okAvatar then
                addAvatarHistory(userId, username)
                pcall(function()
                    Library:Notify('Avatar loaded: ' .. username .. ' (ID: ' .. tostring(userId) .. ')', 4)
                end)
            else
                pcall(function() Library:Notify('' .. tostring(err or 'Avatar change failed'), 5) end)
            end
        end)
    end

    local robloxUsernameInput = LEFT:AddInput('MiseRobloxUsername', {
        Text = 'Roblox Username',
        Default = tostring(Config.RobloxAvatarUsername or ''),
        Numeric = false,
        Finished = true,
        ClearTextOnFocus = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            applyRobloxUsername(v)
        end
    })

    LEFT:AddButton('Load Roblox Avatar', function()
        applyRobloxUsername(robloxUsernameInput.Value)
    end)

    LEFT:AddButton('Avatar History', function()
        if #avatarHistory == 0 then
            pcall(function() Library:Notify('Avatar history is empty.', 4) end)
            return
        end

        local lines = {}
        for i, entry in ipairs(avatarHistory) do
            lines[#lines + 1] = string.format('%d. %s | ID: %d', i, tostring(entry.Name), entry.Id)
        end
        pcall(function()
            Library:Notify('Avatar History\n' .. table.concat(lines, '\n'), 10)
        end)
    end)

    RIGHT:AddButton({
        Text = 'Yokai Named',
        Func = function()
            local ok, err = AvatarChanger:YokaiNamed()
            if ok then
                Config.AvatarCharacterId = 11394787504
                pcall(function()
                    if customIdInput and customIdInput.SetValue then
                        customIdInput:SetValue(tostring(Config.AvatarCharacterId))
                    end
                    Library:Notify('Yokai Named avatar applied.', 3)
                end)
            else
                pcall(function() Library:Notify('' .. tostring(err or 'Avatar change failed'), 4) end)
            end
        end
    })

    RIGHT:AddButton({
        Text = '62536494',
        Func = function()
            local ok, err = AvatarChanger:Fixed()
            if ok then
                Config.AvatarCharacterId = 62536494
                pcall(function()
                    if customIdInput and customIdInput.SetValue then
                        customIdInput:SetValue(tostring(Config.AvatarCharacterId))
                    end
                    Library:Notify('Avatar 62536494 applied.', 3)
                end)
            else
                pcall(function() Library:Notify('' .. tostring(err or 'Avatar change failed'), 4) end)
            end
        end
    })

    RIGHT:AddDivider()

    RIGHT:AddButton({
        Text = 'Character Reset',
        Func = function()
            local ok, err = AvatarChanger:Reset()
            if ok then
                Config.AvatarCharacterId = Players.LocalPlayer.UserId
                pcall(function()
                    if customIdInput and customIdInput.SetValue then
                        customIdInput:SetValue(tostring(Config.AvatarCharacterId))
                    end
                    Library:Notify('Character reset.', 3)
                end)
            else
                pcall(function() Library:Notify('' .. tostring(err or 'Character reset failed'), 4) end)
            end
        end
    })

    pcall(function()
        SaveManager:RegisterCustom('avatar_changer', function()
            return {
                id = tonumber(Config.AvatarCharacterId) or 0,
                username = tostring(Config.RobloxAvatarUsername or ''),
                auto = Config.AvatarAutoLoad ~= false,
            }
        end, function(data)
            if type(data) ~= 'table' then return end
            Config.AvatarAutoLoad = data.auto ~= false
            Config.AvatarCharacterId = tonumber(data.id) or 0
            Config.RobloxAvatarUsername = tostring(data.username or '')
            pcall(function()
                if Config.AvatarCharacterId > 0 then customIdInput:SetValue(tostring(Config.AvatarCharacterId)) end
                robloxUsernameInput:SetValue(Config.RobloxAvatarUsername)
            end)
            local char = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
            if not char then Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait() end
            task.wait(0.5)
            if Config.RobloxAvatarUsername ~= '' then
                applyRobloxUsername(Config.RobloxAvatarUsername)
            elseif Config.AvatarAutoLoad and Config.AvatarCharacterId > 0 then
                AvatarChanger:SetTarget(Config.AvatarCharacterId)
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- Re-apply the chosen avatar to every new character (next match / respawn).
    Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(1)
        pcall(function()
            if Config.RobloxAvatarUsername ~= '' then
                applyRobloxUsername(Config.RobloxAvatarUsername)
            elseif Config.AvatarAutoLoad and (tonumber(Config.AvatarCharacterId) or 0) > 0
                and Config.AvatarCharacterId ~= Players.LocalPlayer.UserId then
                AvatarChanger:SetTarget(Config.AvatarCharacterId)
            end
        end)
    end)
end
                end)(P10)

                return P10
            end

            function RivalsRuntime.ResetState()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.Destroy()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.Destroy()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.Destroy()
                RivalsRagebotState.RespawnBinding = nil
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.Sink.Destroy()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.Spinbot.Destroy()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.MainRagebot.Destroy()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.MiniHubSupport.Destroy()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.SkinChanger.Destroy()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.Movement.Destroy()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof.Destroy()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.Destroy()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.Destroy()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.Destroy()
                if RivalsRuntimeBridge.DestroyKiciaRagebot then
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.DestroyKiciaRagebot()
                end
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.CombatFeedback.Destroy()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.ResetRivalsCosmetics()
                RivalsModsState.RestoreHooks()
                AimbotBridge.ResetAimbotRuntimeState()
                AimbotBridge.ResetTriggerbotReactionState()
                AimbotBridge.ResetCameraAimRandomState()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.ResetFlickbot()
                RivalsRagebotState.Target = nil
                RivalsRagebotState.HoldCFrame = nil
                RivalsRagebotState.LastHoldUpdateAt = 0
                RivalsRagebotState.LastRespawnRequestAt = 0
                RivalsRagebotState.PhaseClockSec = 0
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.ResetAutoLoadoutState()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.ResetAutoBanState()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.ResetTripmineAutomation()
                LocalPickupObserver.ResetDropTracking()
                AimbotTriggerbotLastShotAt = 0
                MeleeFastFire.LastShotAt = 0
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.DestroyAimbotStatusNotification()
                AimbotInputState.LeftMouse = false
                AimbotInputState.RightMouse = false
                AimbotInputState.TouchCount = 0
                AimbotFovCircle.Visible = false
                pcall(function() AimbotFovCircle:Remove() end)
                DestroyAllESP()
                WorldESPState.DestroyAllThrowable()
                WorldESPState.DestroyAllHazard()
                WorldESPState.DestroyAllSoundVisualizer()
                DestroyRuntimeIssueNotification()
            end

            function RivalsRuntime.RegisterPlayerLifecycle()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.NextESPReconcileAt = 0
                if EspRenderSettings.Enabled then
                    ReconcileESPPlayers()
                end

                Library:GiveSignal(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Player_Removing', function(player)
                    DestroyESP(player)
                end)))

                EnsureWeaponInfoTracking()
            end

            function RivalsRuntime.RegisterWorldLifecycle()
                for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
                    WorldESPState.RegisterThrowable(child)
                    LocalPickupObserver.ObserveDrop(child)
                end
                Connections:register('Throwable_Added', Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Throwable_Added', WorldESPState.RegisterThrowable)))
                Connections:register('Throwable_Removed', Workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Throwable_Removed', WorldESPState.DestroyThrowable)))
                Connections:register('PickupDrop_Added', Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('PickupDrop_Added', LocalPickupObserver.ObserveDrop)))
                Connections:register('PickupDrop_Removed', Workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('PickupDrop_Removed', LocalPickupObserver.UnobserveDrop)))

                for _, descendant in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    WorldESPState.RegisterHazard(descendant)
                end
                Connections:register('Hazard_Added', Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Hazard_Added', WorldESPState.RegisterHazard)))
                Connections:register('Hazard_Removed', Workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Hazard_Removed', WorldESPState.DestroyHazard)))
                WorldESPState.SetSoundVisualizerEnabled(Toggles.P1S3T1 and Toggles.P1S3T1.Value == true)
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.BindTripmineAutomation()
            end

            function RivalsRuntime.RegisterInputLifecycle()
                Connections:register('Aimbot_InputBegan', UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Aimbot_InputBegan', function(input, gameProcessed)
                    if gameProcessed then
                        return
                    end

                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                        AimbotInputState.LeftMouse = true
                    elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
                        AimbotInputState.RightMouse = true
                    end
                end)))

                Connections:register('Aimbot_InputEnded', UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Aimbot_InputEnded', function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                        AimbotInputState.LeftMouse = false
                    elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
                        AimbotInputState.RightMouse = false
                    end
                end)))

                Connections:register('Aimbot_TouchStarted', UserInputService.TouchStarted:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Aimbot_TouchStarted', function(touch, gameProcessed)
                    if gameProcessed then
                        return
                    end

                    AimbotInputState.TouchCount = AimbotInputState.TouchCount + 1
                end)))

                Connections:register('Aimbot_TouchEnded', UserInputService.TouchEnded:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Aimbot_TouchEnded', function()
                    AimbotInputState.TouchCount = math.max(AimbotInputState.TouchCount - 1, 0)
                end)))
            end

            function RivalsRuntime.WaitForInitialLoadInSettle()
                -- Wait for the spawn-shield readiness signal before any
                -- character/camera setup. In lobby (no fighter, no shield)
                -- the readiness check stays false forever, so the timeout
                -- is the deliberate exit path; 10s is a generous ceiling
                -- that real spawn shields beat by orders of magnitude and
                -- a safety net if the shield system ever regresses.
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.WaitForLocalReady(10)
                InitCharacter()

                if RivalsRuntimeBridge.IsAutoQueueLobby and RivalsRuntimeBridge.IsAutoQueueLobby() then
                    if type(RivalsRuntimeBridge.RefreshAutoQueueDropdownValues) == 'function' then
                        pcall(RivalsRuntimeBridge.RefreshAutoQueueDropdownValues)
                    end
                    -- The toggle's OnChanged fired during SaveManager autoload (in prepare_setup) and
                    -- already issued JoinQueue if the saved toggle was true. Only fire here as a
                    -- fallback when belief is still 'idle' (i.e., the earlier attempt was rejected
                    -- with not_in_lobby because the lobby hadn't settled yet).
                    if Toggles and Toggles.P8S6T1 and Toggles.P8S6T1.Value == true
                        and type(RivalsRuntimeBridge.FireAutoQueueJoin) == 'function' then
                        local belief = type(RivalsRuntimeBridge.GetAutoQueueBelief) == 'function'
                            and RivalsRuntimeBridge.GetAutoQueueBelief() or 'idle'
                        if belief == 'idle' then
                            pcall(RivalsRuntimeBridge.FireAutoQueueJoin)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            function RivalsRuntime.StartLoops()
                Connections:register('ESP_Render', RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('ESP_Render', RivalsRuntimeBridge.UpdateESP)))
                Connections:register('Throwable_Render', RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Throwable_Render', WorldESPState.UpdateThrowable)))
                Connections:register('Hazard_Render', RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Hazard_Render', WorldESPState.UpdateHazard)))
                Connections:register('CombatFeedback_Render', RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('CombatFeedback_Render', RivalsRuntimeBridge.CombatFeedback.Update)))
                Connections:register('ViewmodelVisuals_Render', RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('ViewmodelVisuals_Render', RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.Update)))
                Connections:register('Movement_PreSimulation', RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Movement_PreSimulation', RivalsRuntimeBridge.Movement.Update)))
                Connections:register('MainRagebot_Heartbeat', RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('MainRagebot_Heartbeat', RivalsRuntimeBridge.MainRagebot.Update)))
                Connections:register('Spinbot_PreSimulation', RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Spinbot_PreSimulation', RivalsRuntimeBridge.Spinbot.Update)))
                Connections:register('Sink_PreSimulation', RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Sink_PreSimulation', RivalsRuntimeBridge.Sink.Update)))
                Connections:register('MovementRecorder_PreSimulation', RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('MovementRecorder_PreSimulation', RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.Update)))
                Connections:register('Movement_BlankFlight', RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Movement_BlankFlight', RivalsRuntimeBridge.Movement.BlankFlightVelocity)))
                Connections:register('AnimationPlayer_Render', RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('AnimationPlayer_Render', RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.Update)))
                Connections:register('CameraModifiers_Render', RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('CameraModifiers_Render', RivalsModsState.UpdateCameraModifiers)))
                Connections:register('MovementRecorder_Render', RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('MovementRecorder_Render', RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.UpdateRender)))
                Connections:register('Flickbot_Render', RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Flickbot_Render', RivalsRuntimeBridge.UpdateFlickbot)))
                Connections:register('CameraAim_Render', RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('CameraAim_Render', RivalsRuntimeBridge.UpdateCameraAim)))
                Connections:register('Aimbot_Render', RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Aimbot_Render', RivalsRuntimeBridge.UpdateAimbot)))
                Connections:register('Ragebot_Heartbeat', RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Ragebot_Heartbeat', RivalsRuntimeBridge.UpdateRagebot)))
                Connections:register('TripmineAutomation_Heartbeat', RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('TripmineAutomation_Heartbeat', RivalsRuntimeBridge.UpdateTripmineAutomation)))

                local AutoQueueRemotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('Remotes')
                local AutoQueueMatchmaking = AutoQueueRemotes and AutoQueueRemotes:FindFirstChild('Matchmaking')
                local AutoQueueStatus = AutoQueueMatchmaking and AutoQueueMatchmaking:FindFirstChild('UpdateQueueStatus')
                if AutoQueueStatus and AutoQueueStatus:IsA('RemoteEvent') then
                    Connections:register('AutoQueue_StatusUpdate',
                        AutoQueueStatus.OnClientEvent:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback(
                            'AutoQueue_StatusUpdate', RivalsRuntimeBridge.HandleAutoQueueStatusUpdate)))
                end
                Connections:register('AutoQueue_MatchmadeGameOver',
                    workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal('MatchmadeGameOver'):Connect(GuardRivalsCallback(
                        'AutoQueue_MatchmadeGameOver', RivalsRuntimeBridge.OnAutoQueueMatchmadeGameOverChanged)))
                Connections:register('AutoQueue_LobbyReturn_Teleport',
                    game:GetService('TeleportService').LocalPlayerArrivedFromTeleport:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback(
                        'AutoQueue_LobbyReturn_Teleport', RivalsRuntimeBridge.OnAutoQueueLobbyReturn)))
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.CombatFeedback.RefreshBinding()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.MovementRecorder.BindRoundSignal()
            end

            function RivalsRuntime.RegisterCharacterLifecycle()
                RefreshLocalPickupHealthObserver()
                AttachWeaponInfoObservers(LP)
                RivalsModsState.EnsureHooks()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.ApplyRivalsCosmetics()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.RegisterAutoRespawnSignals()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.RegisterAutoBanSignals()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.RegisterAutoQueuePlayAgainSignals()

                RivalsRuntimeBridge.RunPickupSpawnSetup = function()
                    task.defer(function()
                        -- Wait for the spawn-shield readiness signal before any
                        -- per-spawn setup. Replaces the legacy fixed-time
                        -- fighter wait -- the shield-driven wait stays
                        -- patient until the character is actually loaded and
                        -- the round is live, then proceeds. 30s safety ceiling
                        -- covers lobby spawns (no shield + no fighter ever) so
                        -- the deferred coroutine doesn't leak on lobby cycles.
                        if not RivalsRuntimeBridge.WaitForLocalReady(30) then
                            RivalsRuntimeBridge.LogDiagnosticEvent('Spawn', 'WaitForLocalReady timed out; per-spawn setup aborted')
                            return
                        end

                        local fighter = ResolveLocalFighter()
                        if not fighter then
                            RivalsRuntimeBridge.LogDiagnosticEvent('Spawn', 'Local fighter unavailable after readiness; per-spawn setup aborted')
                            return
                        end

                        FighterDataCache.AttachLocalDuelWatchers(fighter)
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.RegisterAutoRespawnSignals()
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.RegisterAutoBanSignals()
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.RegisterAutoQueuePlayAgainSignals()
                        if not InitCharacter() then
                            RivalsRuntimeBridge.LogDiagnosticEvent('Spawn', 'InitCharacter failed after fighter ready; per-spawn setup aborted')
                            return
                        end

                        if not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                            RivalsRuntimeBridge.LogDiagnosticEvent('Spawn', 'Humanoid missing or dead at per-spawn; setup aborted')
                            return
                        end

                        RefreshLocalPickupHealthObserver()
                        AttachWeaponInfoObservers(LP)
                        RivalsModsState.EnsureHooks()
                        UpdateRivalsPickupFeatures()
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.ApplyRivalsCosmetics()
                    end)
                end

                if LP.Character then
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.RunPickupSpawnSetup()
                end

                Library:GiveSignal(LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(GuardRivalsCallback('Pickup_CharacterAdded', function(newChar)
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.LogDiagnosticEvent(
                        'CharAdded',
                        'LP.CharacterAdded fired (new: ' .. tostring(newChar and newChar.Name or '<nil>') .. ')'
                    )
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.ResetLocalShieldLatch()
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.RunPickupSpawnSetup()
                end)))
            end

                    { idx = 'P10S4S4', type = 'Slider', value = 35 },
                    { idx = 'P10S4S5', type = 'Slider', value = 0.2 },
                    { idx = 'P10S4T4', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                    { idx = 'P10S4T4K', type = 'KeyPicker', mode = 'Toggle', key = 'Unknown', modifiers = {} },
                    { idx = 'P10S4T5', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                    { idx = 'P10S4T5K', type = 'KeyPicker', mode = 'Toggle', key = 'Unknown', modifiers = {} },
                    { idx = 'P10S4I1', type = 'Input', text = '' },
                    { idx = 'P10S6T1', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                    { idx = 'P10S6D1', type = 'Dropdown', value = 'Floss Dance' },
                    { idx = 'P10S6S1', type = 'Slider', value = 1 },
                    { idx = 'MN1R1', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                    { idx = 'MN1R2', type = 'Toggle', value = true },
                    { idx = 'MN1R3', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                    { idx = 'MN1R4', type = 'Dropdown', multi = true, value = {attackers = true, ['voided players'] = true} },
                    { idx = 'MN1R5', type = 'Dropdown', value = nil },
                    { idx = 'P10NS1T1', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                    { idx = 'P10NS1I1', type = 'Input', text = '' },
                    { idx = 'P10S7T1', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                    { idx = 'P10S7D1', type = 'Dropdown', value = 'VR' },
                    { idx = 'P10S2T1', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                    { idx = 'P10S2D1', type = 'Dropdown', multi = true, value = {} },
                    { idx = 'P10S2D2', type = 'Dropdown', multi = true, value = {} },
                    { idx = 'P10S2C1', type = 'ColorPicker', value = 'faaa46', transparency = 0 },
                    { idx = 'P5S1T2', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                }
                local ConfigProfileDefaults = {
                    Legit = {
                        { idx = 'P2S1T7', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                        { idx = 'P8S4T1', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                        { idx = 'P8S4T2', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                        { idx = 'P8S5T1', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                        { idx = 'P8S6T1', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                        { idx = 'P4S1T3', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                        { idx = 'P4S1T4', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                        { idx = 'P8S4T4', type = 'Toggle', value = false },
                    },
                    Rage = {
                        { idx = 'P2S1T7', type = 'Toggle', value = true },
                        { idx = 'P8S4T1', type = 'Toggle', value = true },
                        { idx = 'P8S4T2', type = 'Toggle', value = true },
                        { idx = 'P8S5T1', type = 'Toggle', value = true },
                        { idx = 'P8S6T1', type = 'Toggle', value = true },
                        { idx = 'P4S1T3', type = 'Toggle', value = true },
                        { idx = 'P4S1T4', type = 'Toggle', value = true },
                        { idx = 'P8S4T4', type = 'Toggle', value = true },
                    },
                }

                local function CloneRivalsConfigProfileValue(value)
                    if type(value) ~= 'table' then
                        return value
                    end

                    local copy = {}
                    for key, child in pairs(value) do
                        copy[key] = CloneRivalsConfigProfileValue(child)
                    end
                    return copy
                end

                local function CloneRivalsConfigProfileObject(object)
                    local copy = {}
                    for key, value in pairs(object) do
                        copy[key] = CloneRivalsConfigProfileValue(value)
                    end
                    return copy
                end

                local function BuildRivalsConfigProfileDefaultObjects(config_name)
                    local profile_defaults = ConfigProfileDefaults[config_name]
                    if type(profile_defaults) ~= 'table' then
                        return nil
                    end

                    local objects = {}
                    local indexes_by_id = {}
                    local function upsert(object)
                        if type(object) ~= 'table' or type(object.idx) ~= 'string' then
                            return
                        end

                        local cloned = CloneRivalsConfigProfileObject(object)
                        local existing_index = indexes_by_id[cloned.idx]
                        if existing_index then
                            objects[existing_index] = cloned
                        else
                            indexes_by_id[cloned.idx] = #objects + 1
                            objects[#objects + 1] = cloned
                        end
                    end

                    for _, object in ipairs(SharedConfigDefaultObjects) do
                        upsert(object)
                    end
                    for _, object in ipairs(profile_defaults) do
                        upsert(object)
                    end

                    return objects
                end

                local function WriteRivalsConfigProfileDefault(config_name)
                    local objects = BuildRivalsConfigProfileDefaultObjects(config_name)
                    if not objects then
                        return false, 'unknown RIVALS config profile: ' .. tostring(config_name)
                    end

                    local settings_folder = ScriptPaths.storage_root() .. '/settings'
                    if not isfolder(settings_folder) then
                        makefolder(settings_folder)
                    end

                    local ok, err = pcall(function()
                        writefile(ScriptPaths.config_path(config_name), HttpService:JSONEncode({ objects = objects }))
                    end)
                    if not ok then
                        return false, err
                    end
                    return true
                end
                RivalsConfigProfiles.WriteDefault = WriteRivalsConfigProfileDefault

                -- Preset pickers are one-shot actions; configs save the values they set,
                -- so re-loading a config must not replay the preset over saved tweaks.
                SaveManager:SetIgnoreIndexes({ 'P1S32D1', 'P1S26D6', 'P1S14D1' })

                local SharedUI = GameBootstrap.create_standard_shared_ui({
                    ui_settings = UISettings,
                    window = Window,
                    library = Library,
                    theme_manager = ThemeManager,
                    script_paths = ScriptPaths,
                    save_manager = SaveManager,
                    current_config_name = 'RIVALS',
                    default_config_name = 'RIVALS Default',
                    config_names = RivalsConfigProfiles.Names,
                    use_global_config_names = true,
                    toggles = Toggles,
                    options = Options,
                    local_player = LP,
                    defaults = {
                        auto_show = false,
                        show_notification = true,
                        show_keybind_states = true,
                        auto_execute_on_teleport = true,
                        auto_load_config = true,
                        auto_save_config = true,
                        load_config_name = 'Legit',
                        menu_keybind = 'LeftControl',
                    },
                    persist_menu_keybind = false,
                    queue_on_teleport = queue_on_teleport,
                    before_save = function(shared_ui, config_name)
                        local saveName = config_name or (shared_ui and shared_ui:resolve_save_config_name()) or 'Legit'
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.SetRivalsCosmeticsConfigName(saveName)
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.SetAutoLoadoutConfigName(saveName)
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.CaptureSavedRivalsCosmeticsSelections()
                    end,
                    on_save = function(shared_ui, config_name)
                        local saveName = config_name or (shared_ui and shared_ui:resolve_save_config_name()) or 'Legit'
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.SetRivalsCosmeticsConfigName(saveName)
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.SetAutoLoadoutConfigName(saveName)
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.SaveRivalsCosmeticsSelections()
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.SaveAutoLoadoutProfiles()
                    end,
                    on_load_saved = function(shared_ui, config_name)
                        local loadName = config_name or (shared_ui and shared_ui:resolve_load_config_name()) or 'Legit'
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.SetRivalsCosmeticsConfigName(loadName)
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.SetAutoLoadoutConfigName(loadName)
                        task.defer(GuardRivalsCallback('Cosmetics_LoadSavedSelections', function()
                            RivalsRuntimeBridge.LoadSavedRivalsCosmeticsSelections()
                            RivalsRuntimeBridge.RefreshRivalsCosmetics()
                            RivalsRuntimeBridge.ApplyRivalsCosmetics()
                        end))
                        task.defer(GuardRivalsCallback('AutoLoadout_LoadSavedProfiles', RivalsRuntimeBridge.LoadAutoLoadoutProfiles))
                    end,
                    on_load_default = function(shared_ui, config_name)
                        local loadName = config_name or (shared_ui and shared_ui:resolve_save_config_name()) or 'Legit'
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.SetRivalsCosmeticsConfigName(loadName)
                        RivalsRuntimeBridge.SetAutoLoadoutConfigName(loadName)
                        task.defer(GuardRivalsCallback('Cosmetics_LoadDefaultSelections', function()
                            RivalsRuntimeBridge.LoadSavedRivalsCosmeticsSelections()
                            RivalsRuntimeBridge.RefreshRivalsCosmetics()
                            RivalsRuntimeBridge.ApplyRivalsCosmetics()
                        end))
                        task.defer(GuardRivalsCallback('AutoLoadout_LoadDefaultProfiles', RivalsRuntimeBridge.LoadAutoLoadoutProfiles))
                    end,
                    reset_config_to_default = function(shared_ui, config_name)
                        return RivalsConfigProfiles.WriteDefault(config_name)
                    end,
                    reconcile_loaded_state = function()
                        if ReconcileLoadedState then
                            ReconcileLoadedState()
                        end
                    end,
                })
                local initialRivalsConfigName = (SharedUI:should_auto_load_config() and SharedUI:resolve_load_config_name()) or 'RIVALS Default'
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.SetRivalsCosmeticsConfigName(initialRivalsConfigName)
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.SetAutoLoadoutConfigName(initialRivalsConfigName)
                ReconcileLoadedState = function()
                    RefreshEspRenderSettings()
                    RivalsModsState.EnsureHooks()
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.RefreshAll()
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.RefreshAll()
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.RefreshAll()
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.Movement.RefreshAll()
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof.RefreshAll()
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.RefreshAll()
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.RefreshAll()
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.RefreshRivalsCosmetics()
                    RivalsRuntimeBridge.ApplyRivalsCosmetics()
                end

                GameBootstrap.prepare_setup({
                    save_manager = SaveManager,
                    script_paths = ScriptPaths,
                    current_config_name = 'RIVALS',
                    default_config_name = 'RIVALS Default',
                    shared_ui = SharedUI,
                    toggles = Toggles,
                    options = Options,
                    reset_config_to_default = function(shared_ui, config_name)
                        return RivalsConfigProfiles.WriteDefault(config_name)
                    end,
                })
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.LoadSavedRivalsCosmeticsSelections()
                task.defer(GuardRivalsCallback('AutoLoadout_LoadInitialProfiles', RivalsRuntimeBridge.LoadAutoLoadoutProfiles))
                EnsureEspRenderSettingsTracking()
                RefreshEspRenderSettings()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.WorldVisuals.RefreshAll()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.ViewmodelVisuals.RefreshAll()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.NativeRemovals.RefreshAll()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.Movement.RefreshAll()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.DeviceSpoof.RefreshAll()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.PlayerSpoofer.RefreshAll()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.AnimationPlayer.RefreshAll()

                -- =============================================
                -- Lifecycle
                -- =============================================

                Library:OnUnload(GuardRivalsCallback('Runtime_Unload', function()
                    RivalsRuntime.ResetState()
                    Connections:disconnect_all()
                end))

                RivalsRuntime.WaitForInitialLoadInSettle()
                RivalsRuntime.RegisterPlayerLifecycle()
                RivalsRuntime.RegisterWorldLifecycle()
                RivalsRuntime.RegisterInputLifecycle()
                RivalsRuntime.RegisterCharacterLifecycle()
                RivalsRuntime.StartLoops()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.EnsureMatchBoundaryDetection()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.BindRivalsCosmetics()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.BindAutoLoadoutControllers()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.ApplyRivalsCosmetics()
                RivalsRuntimeBridge.QueueAutoLoadoutSubmission()

                SharedUI:notify_loaded(5)
            end

            -- Startup must not abort the GUI just because the game's EnumLibrary
            -- is late/unavailable. Build the menu first; runtime features are
            -- individually guarded below.
            pcall(function()
                local enumLibrary = ResolveEnumLibrary()
                if enumLibrary and enumLibrary._enum_builder_complete ~= true then
                    local builderDeadline = os.clock() + 8
                    while os.clock() < builderDeadline and enumLibrary._enum_builder_complete ~= true do
                        task.wait(0.1)
                    end
                end
                if enumLibrary and enumLibrary._enum_builder_complete == true
                    and type(enumLibrary.WaitForEnumBuilder) == 'function' then
                    enumLibrary:WaitForEnumBuilder()
                end
            end)

            local __uiBuilt = false
            local __uiOk, __uiErr = pcall(function()
                BuildRivalsUi(Window)
                __uiBuilt = true
            end)
            if not __uiOk then
                warn('[Mini Hub] UI build error: ' .. tostring(__uiErr))
            end
            if __uiBuilt then
                local __runtimeOk, __runtimeErr = pcall(function()
                    RivalsRuntime.Initialize(Window)
                end)
                if not __runtimeOk then
                    warn('[Mini Hub] Runtime initialize error: ' .. tostring(__runtimeErr))
                    pcall(function()
                        if Library and type(Library.Notify) == 'function' then
                            Library:Notify({Title='Mini Hub', Description='Runtime error: ' .. tostring(__runtimeErr), Time=6})
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
            end

-- =============================================================================
--  Footer - closes the bootstrap
-- =============================================================================
--  Closes the experience check opened by the feature module, the xpcall that
--  wraps it, and the outer function. Any error thrown anywhere inside the
--  feature module lands here with a full traceback rather than killing the
--  script silently.
-- =============================================================================

    else
        if Library and type(Library.Notify) == 'function' then
            Library:Notify({ Title = 'KiciaHook', Description = 'This script only supports RIVALS.', Time = 5 })
        end
    end

    end, function(e)
        return debug.traceback(tostring(e), 2)
    end)

    if not __game_ok then
        if ErrorReporter and type(ErrorReporter.report) == 'function' then
            ErrorReporter.report(__game_err, nil, 'game_init')
        end
        if Library and type(Library.Notify) == 'function' then
            Library:Notify({ Title = 'KiciaHook', Description = 'Fatal error: ' .. tostring(__game_err), Time = 8 })
        end
    end

end)()
